articleTitle: Fault injection methodology and tools
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Fault injection has been recognized as a powerful technique to evaluate the dependability of computer systems. This paper describes the concept and principle of fault injection. Several techniques and their tools of fault injection are reviewed in detail.

articleTitle: An improved apriori algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In this study, it proposes a new optimization algorithm called APRIORI-IMPROVE based on the insufficient of Apriori. APRIORI-IMPROVE algorithm presents optimizations on 2-items generation, transactions compression and so on. APRIORI-IMPROVE uses hash structure to generate L2, uses an efficient horizontal data representation and optimized strategy of storage to save time and space. The performance study shows that APRIORI-IMPROVE is much faster than Apriori.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of PID controller based on FPGA and genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In this paper, an innovative design method of PID controller based on genetic algorithm tuning parameters, VHDL description and FPGA implementation is proposed. The parameters of the PID controller are optimized by using genetic algorithm. The intelligent PID controller based on genetic algorithm is realized by using FPGA. During the realization process, the functional modules of the system are divided based on top-down design method. Each module of the system is described with VHDL language. Finally, the closed loop tests of the intelligent PID controller based on FPGA and genetic algorithm are implemented by means of DSP Builder and Matlab/Simulink. Simulation results have shown that the design method of the intelligent PID controller based on FPGA and genetic algorithm is verified, and it has some advantages such as design flexible, self-tuning on line, high reliability, short cycle of technical development, high running speed and so on. This intelligent PID controller based on FPGA and genetic algorithm can be applied in high control precision digital control system with high speed responsibility and high stability.

articleTitle: Silver-coated zinc oxide nanoantibacterial synthesis and antibacterial activity characterization
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In this article, a precipitation method is investigated to prepare nanoscale zinc oxide (ZnO) as the precursor of silver coated antibacterial nanocomposite. Subsequently, silver loadeded zinc oxide nanocomposites (ZnO/Ag) are prepared by hydrolysis method. The average diameters and morphology of ZnO nanocomposites before and after silver loaded were compared. The results showed that the zinc oxide powder presented good dispersibility and uniform size a average diameter of 170 nm. Silver was coated on the precursor successfully, and the diameter of ZnO nanocomposites increased slightly. Silver loaded ZnO showed strong antibacterial activity on Escherichia coli (E. coli) and Staphylococcus aureus (S. aureus), the inhibition zone diameter in 15.2mm and 20.8 mm respectively.

articleTitle: Research on new reduction strategy of SVM used to large-scale training sample set
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: It has become a bottleneck to use Support Vector Machine (SVM) due to such problems as slow learning speed, large buffer memory requirement, low generalization performance and so on, which are caused by large-scale training sample set. Concerning these problems, this paper proposed a new reduction strategy for large-scale training sample set. First authors train an initial classifier with a small training set, which is randomly selected from the original samples, then cut the vector which is not Support Vector with the initial classifier to obtain a small reduction set. Training with this reduction set, final classifier is obtained. Experiments show that the learning strategy not only reduces the cost greatly but also obtains a classifier that has almost the same accuracy as the classifier obtained by training large set directly. In addition, speed of classification is greatly improved.

articleTitle: Image denoising based on Haar wavelet transform
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Wavelet transform has widely applied in image denoising, and how to select the threshold is the key to wavelet image denoising. The paper put forward the algrithm for image denoising based on harr wavelet transform. Fisrt, The image with noise is decomposed by Haar wavelt transform, then select the soft threshold to clean the image noise. Experiments show that the algorithm can reduce image noise effectively and improve the detail effect of picture and raise the PSNR value of image.

articleTitle: Intrapulse modulation recognition of radar signals based on statistical tests of the time-frequency curve
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In the field of radar electronic surveillance, intrapulse modulation recognition of the intercepted signals is an important intermediate operation between signal detection and demodulation. A simple decision-theoretic approach, based on the properties of the linear regression of time-frequency curve (TFC) of the intercepted signal, is proposed to recognize the common intrapulse modulation of radar signals. The main advantageous of the method is that we simplify the recognition problem to two kinds of statistics tests for the linear regression of the TFC. Computer simulation results show that the performance of the proposed method achieves overall correct recognition rate of 98% at signal-to-noise ratio(SNR)without any a priori knowledge and training data.

articleTitle: A simulated annealing- new genetic algorithm and its application
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In this paper, a new kind of algorithm was opposed combined with simulated annealing algorithm and new genetic algorithm. The simulated annealing (SA) method was brought into the genetic algorithm (GA), which combined the two methods into a new global optimization algorithm. The use of SA reduces the stress to choose for GA. Father more, the combination can reduce the search area and avoid the premature convergence problem existing in genetic algorithm, so to improve the convergence of the algorithm. The crossover operator in genetic operation plays a more important role in this algorithm. Through computer simulation, we can see there are advantages in this algorithm compared with traditional genetic algorithm and other pre-existing simulated annealing-genetic algorithm.

articleTitle: The research of metal detectors using in food industry
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In this note, we consider a model of metal detector consisted of one transmitting loop, receiving loop and compensating loop. For distortion of the received signal is associated with the frequency of the transmitting signal through researching of mathematical model, it is feasible to increase the frequency of the detection signal to improve the sensitivity of metal detectors in order to meet food safety requirements. Feasibility of the system has been proved.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of image acquisition system based on ARM and Linux
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Traditional image acquisition system has all the disadvantages of complex, bulky and inconvenient to carry. The embedded image processing system integrates all the functions of image capturing, displaying and processing as well as takeing the advantages of small size and low power consumption. According to the need of modern security monitoring system, a kind of image acquisition system based on ARM and Linux was designed. The system takes S3C2410(ARM9) as core to construct image acquisition and processing system with USB camera, LCD monitor and memory, and builds the necessary peripherals and communication interfaces to complete the design of hardware platform. Then drivers were composed and embedded Linux operating system was transplanted, eventually the functions of image data collection, display and storage were realized. The test results showed that acquisition images were clear and the system turned out to meet the requirement.

articleTitle: Application of virtual instrumentation which based on labview in electronic measurement technology course
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Electronic measurement technology course is a public basic course which has relations with electronic measurement principles and methods, and the common typical electronic measurement instruments' operating principles, performances and applications. It has such outstanding characteristics as theory has close relations with practices, outstanding practices and wide applications. By using LabVIEW developing software which based on computer visual virtual instrumentation to program the Virtual Instruments with traditional instruments' functions, we can demonstrate them in classroom by combing with PowerPoint conveniently. So, the many principles related with electronic measurement technology can be demonstrated by means of LabVIEW software developing platform. So, the theory teaching and experiments demonstration can be realized in classroom at the same time. This is the application by combing multimedia technology with virtual instrumentation, and it is the renovation about electronic measurement technology course class teaching.

articleTitle: Identification of deer in thermal images to avoid deer-vehicle crashes
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Car accidents due to deer vehicle-crashes (DVCs) are constantly a major safety issue for the driving on rural roads in Europe and North America. Many attempts have been made to avoid these accidents, but few have been succeeded. One of the options is to use thermal images to identify the presence of deer, then to warn the drivers to slow down. In this research, we proposed using thermal images to determine whether deer are present or not. The histogram of orientated gradient (HOG) method and the support vector machine method (SVM) have been used to identify deer. In this algorithm, based on the calculation of the HOG on the thermal images of thousands of samples (deer thermal images), SVM method is firstly used to get the pattern of deer to generate deer description, called descriptor. Then the descriptor is used to compare with the HOG of the current image. The comparing result will tell the existence of deer in the current image. In order to improve accuracy, the second training, where the false positive images are used as training samples, has been performed. The lab and field test results have shown up to 85% accuracy. By achieving this goal, deer can be identified and warning signal to drivers can be issued. Thus the possibility of deer - vehicle crashes can be reduced.

articleTitle: Design of embedded gateway software framework for heterogeneous networks interconnection
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: With the development of embedded technology and network technology, various networks become more and more interconnected and integrated. The gateway is one of very important device of networks combination, which realizes many functions such as protocol conversion and data buffer. Based on this demand, this paper designs an embedded gateway which can interconnect all kinds of heterogeneous networks. Firstly, its software framework is given, and then, the main data structures including internal data packet format, Internet client-side data format and information record tables are introduced, finally, the key point of main software modules of the gateway is discussed. This gateway has many characteristics of modularization, customizable and instantaneity. It can interconnect Internet, industrial field bus, wireless networks based on Zigbee or Bluetooth etc and can be applied to intelligent home network, remote measurement and control system and the applications of Internet of things.

articleTitle: Asynchronous FIFO implementation using FPGA
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: We introduce a design of asynchronous FIFO on FPGA for the purpose of high-speed, steady data transmission between asynchronous clock domains. In the design, the memory address was organized into one ring list, using gray code as its address code, making uses of double jump technology to finish two asynchronous clock regions between address signals transmission, avoiding the meta-stability well.

articleTitle: A study of robot control technology based on stereo vision
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The thesis delves into the realization policies of six DOF manipulator teleoperation and flexible control functions. According to binocular stereo visual system, robots are rendered to adapt themselves to the open working conditions, fully utilize their own intelligent calculation methods to achieve independent accurate positioning, automatic grasping control without human participation, a real independent visual servo control system and the function of tracking and navigation.

articleTitle: Analysis on development trend of electric vehicle charging mode
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: With the increase of global environmental problems, the electric vehicle has become development trend of car and one of the hotspots, but the charging mode become the focus in the development process of electric vehicle. the advantage and disadvantage of three kinds of electric vehicle charging modes and the factors of affecting vehicle charging mode are analyzed in this paper. On this basis, the author thinks that changing electric mode is optimal charging mode, and analyzes the reasons. Finally also puts forward the concept of double battery configuration.

articleTitle: A wireless sensor network environment monitoring system based on TinyOS
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: A wireless sensor network in a greenhouse area environment monitoring system based on TinyOS is designed in this paper. A design approach of the wireless sensor network environment monitoring system of greenhouse, which is based on TinyOS, is presented in this thesis. The design of the hardware and software of the monitoring system is based on the using of the MSP430 microcontroller and NesC language. And the control application program on PC is designed with Visual Basic, which realizes the remote control between the PC and the monitoring system. It also enhances the efficiency, accuracy, reliability and has higher value of applications.

articleTitle: Design of intelligent fire alarm system based on GSM network
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In order to solve the problem of complex cabling, misdeclaration and missing alarm of traditional fire alarm system, an intelligent fire alarm system based on GSM network is designed. MSP430F149 is adopted as main control chip, and the remote alarming and data exchanging are achieved by using GSM module TC35I. By adopting smoke detector and temperature detector and using a variable threshold alert algorithm with temperature compensation, the accuracy of fire alarm is improved. The result of test shows this design has characters of real-time and good reliability, and will be widely used.

articleTitle: Research of temperature and humidity monitoring system based on WSN and fuzzy control
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Aiming at the features of environmental information monitoring, a multi-parameter monitoring system is designed based on low-power ZigBee wireless communication technology to improve overall the level of system automation and monitoring. By wireless sensor networks the data is collected and processed real-time and at the receiving end the data is received, saved and displayed to achieve temperature and humidity monitoring. The implementation of system software and hardware are given, including the design of wireless node and the implementation principle of data transmission and communication modules. This system overcomes the limitations of wired sensor networks and has the properties of flexible networking for monitoring equipment, convenient removing, low cost nodes and high capacity. The monitoring results for temperature and humidity have shown that this system is stable, high reliable in data transmission and easy to use, and can be widely used in various areas of automatic monitoring of environmental parameters.

articleTitle: The theoretical and experimental exploration of a novel water-vapor concentration measutrment scheme based on scanning spectrometry
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: According to the near infrared absorption spectrum, a novel water-vapor concentration detection scheme based on scanning spectrometry is proposed. The experiment device adopts narrowband illuminant distributed feedback laser diode (DFB - LD) as the source and uses the method of taking the average value of multiple stacking signals to improve the signal-to-noise ratio. The accuracy and resolution which are verified by the micro-water generator reach 20ppm and 10 ppm respectively. In addition, the variation of the absorption coefficient of the water-vapor spectral center wavelength with different pressures is analyzed, and based on that, we get the conclusion that the line-shape function can be fitted by Lorenz line-shape and Gaussian line-shape when the pressure is more than 0.4atm and less than 0.005atm respectively. Besides, the method of using the integral area of absorption spectrum to measure gas concentration is elaborated for the first time. Especially when the pressure is higher than atmospheric pressure, this method which could improve the resolution and accuracy is a feasible one to calculate gas concentration in engineering.

Author Keywords: The integral area of absorption spectrum

articleTitle: Research on PID controller based on RBF neural network
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: RBF neural network is a kind of feedforward neural network with good performance, which is proposed based on the brain's neurons to external reaction and it has the capability of strong nonlinear mapping, it can with arbitrary precision approaches a nonlinear function global, it has the advantage of simple structure, fast learning etc. Neural network with arbitrary nonlinear expression ability can realize the best PID control by system performance study, by RBF network, the self-learning PID controller can been built with parameters Kp, Ki, Kd, the simulation results show that the system has good dynamic and static performance.

articleTitle: A wavelet-based image resolution enhancement technique
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Wavelet transform is the result of inheritance and development of Fourier transform, which has a certain capability to analyze non-stationary signals. It is particularly suitable for image processing, such as non-stationary signals. In this paper, we propose an image resolution enhancement technique based on wavelet transform. The edges are enhanced by introducing an intermediate stage using stationary wavelet transform (SWT). The quantitative and visual results show the superiority of the proposed technique over the conventional image resolution enhancement techniques based on interpolation.

articleTitle: All-fiber-optic sensor for relative humidity measurement
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: A novel relative humidity (RH) sensor based on single-mode-multimode-single-mode (SMS) fiber structure is presented. The sensors are created through coating a thin layer of polyvinyl alcohol (PVA) on the multimode fiber deleted the cladding trough HF solution cauterization as the sensitive cladding film, whose refractive index varies as a function of humidity level. Due to the SMS fiber structure's sensitivity to ambient refractive index, the spectral properties of SMS fiber structure coated PVA sensitive film are modified under exposure to different ambient humidity levels ranging from 50%~89%RH. The related theoretical analysis and the numerical simulation of spectral transmission of SMS fiber structure with different surrounding refractive index are also proposed. The sensitive of the RH measurement of 0.18nm/%RH in the range from 80%-89%RH is experimentally achieved. The experimental results obtained are consistent with the conclusion obtained by numerical simulating.

articleTitle: Phase characteristics of fiber Bragg gratings and fiber Fabry-Perot cavities
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Phase spectra of fiber Bragg gratings (FBGs) have significant impacts on spectral characteristics of FBG based Fabry-Perot (F-P) cavities. A concise and comprehensible expression of phase spectra of FBGs was derived from the general arctan function for both weak and strong FBGs. Then spectral features of FBG based Fabry-Perot cavities (FBG-FP) were investigated by introducing a new conception of the equivalent cavity length similar to general F-P cavities. Finally, an experimental scheme to measure and analyze spectra of FBG-FP cavities was proposed and conducted, which was proven to be capable of measuring spectral curves with a high accuracy.

articleTitle: Analysis of three-phase voltage source PWM rectifier with variable frequency supply
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: This paper presents a novel analysis method for the three-phase voltage source PWM rectifier (VSR). And the new method is employed to analyze a VSR with variable frequency supply. The simulation results are presented. And they show that the proposed analysis method is simple and effective.

articleTitle: A FPGA-based low-cost real-time wavelet packet denoising system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Most existing wavelets are irrational, which are inefficient in hardware implementation and have expensive cost of resources. Based on rational wavelets, we establish a real-time wavelet packet denoising system, which greatly improves the implementation efficiency on FPGA chips. The experimental results reveal that rational 9-7 wavelet decomposition hardware area in slices is less than 1/6 of the pipelined 9-7. To get further decrease in resources of the denoising system, we put forward a new threshold algorithm on denoising the coefficients, and it performs nearly the same as Donoho universal threshold algorithm, while consuming much less resources when implementing on FPGA.

articleTitle: Temperature control of electric furnace based on fuzzy PID
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: To electric furnace's characters as non-linear and time-varying, we designed a fuzzy PID controller, and made some simulation through MATLAB, at the same time we used a traditional PID controller and simulated, then compared the result of traditional PID controller with fuzzy PID controller's result and analyzed the property. The result of simulation shows that the speediness, stability and anti-interference ability of fuzzy PID control are superior to those of traditional PID control.

articleTitle: Attention bias during processing of facial expressions in trait anxiety: An eye-tracking study
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Behavior research indicates that Personality may affect facial expression processing. 36 participants were taken into high or low trait anxiety groups (HTA, LTA, in short), the current study probed the eye movement characteristics of anxiety participants by using Tobii120 eye-tracker. The results showed that, (1) recognition time of individuals in HTA group was smaller than that of LTA group significantly, and pupils sizes of former were bigger than those of latter significantly in expression of surprise and contemn. (2) fixation start-points of individuals in HTA group for different expressions were different, mostly located at nose and eyes; path of shape during processing mostly were the shape of Arabic numeral 7. (3) pupils sizes and recognition time for all participants differed among expressions. It suggested that individuals in HTA group were more sensitive to negative facial expressions in social and biological meaning, and had specific eye-movement characteristics and path of processing shape was mostly Arabic numeral 7.

articleTitle: Study of sensing coil errors in the in-line sagnac interferometer current transducer
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The polarization error of the in-line sagnac interferometer current transducer is studied by using the Jones Matrices formalism. This paper presents theoretical results showing the effects of linear and circular birefringence on the sensing coil. The simulation result shows that the linear birefringence could be restrained by adding a larger amount of circular birefringence in the sensing fiber.

articleTitle: Harmonic analysis method for input current of traction system applied in High-speed Electric Multiple Unit
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The harmonic analysis of traction system input current will provide a solid theoretical basis to improve the power quality of High-speed Electric Multiple Unit (EMU). Taking CRH3 EMU for example, the input current harmonic characteristic in single-phase voltage source PWM converter is firstly analyzed based on the double Fourier series method. And then, the setting method of the carrier phase difference in the rectifier is presented. The analysis results show that the input harmonic current of traction system could be effectively reduced by controlling the carrier phase of different rectifier. The feasibility of this method is proved by the measured results at last.

articleTitle: Research on self-tuning PID control strategy based on BP neural network
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Neural network has strong learning ability and adaptability based on back-propagation algorithm. This paper describes the principle of BP algorithm and the proved BP neural network is used in the traditional PID controller, to overcome the hortcomings of the over-reliance the system model in the parameter of adjustment. Simulation results show that good control effect of Approximating the optimal parameters based on the BP neural network in traditional auto-tuning PID control in MATLAB.

articleTitle: The influence of driving current on emission spectra of GaN-based LED
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The InGaN/GaN multiple quantum wells (MQWs) light emitting diodes (LEDs) were grown by metalorganic chemical vapor deposition (MOCVD) on sapphire substrates. The emission spetrum, chromaticity coordinates of the GaN-based blue LED have been measured under varied driving current. The results indicated that as the driving current increases from 1 mA to 20 mA, the peak wavelength of EL spetrum has slightly shifted toward short-wavelength (blue-shift) due to radiation recombination of the donor-acceptor pairs localized energy state in the InGaN well layer, the x value increases, but the y value decreases. When continuatively increasing forward current, a slowly red-shift of the emitting peak wavelength has been observed due to the temperature dependence of band-gap energy, the x value decreases, but the y value increases. The FWHM of EL spetrum increases as the driving current increases.

articleTitle: Multi-sensor data fusion based on environment database for airport surface surveillance
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The ADS-B (Automatic Dependent Surveillance - Broadcast) and MLAT (Multilateration) are becoming the leading surveillance techniques in the field of ATC (Air Traffic Control), and will play important roles in the future's tracking system. It is inevitable to need a framework to fuse the data from these modern techniques. However, traditional fusion method dose not provide sufficient precision in the surface surveillance and easily brings out saw-shaped trajectory. This paper designs a hybrid fusion framework based on environment database. The hybrid framework includes centralized filters and distributed filters to deal with the relations among different sensors. The environment database is used to better the settings of adaptive IMM in each sensor. Under such framework, ADS-B and MLAT data are processed intensively to achieve high accuracy. Experiment results based on simulation and practical data illustrate the algorithm can achieve high precision.

articleTitle: The research of electromagnetic conducted coupling in transmission-line networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The electromagnetic topological theory has important applications value in analyzing the problem of electromagnetic interference (EMI). The BLT equation of the line network and the method of calculation in engineering are presented. The electromagnetic topology model of single transmission-line networks is built. The responses on junctions of the transmission-line networks with impulse interference sources of different injected positions and numbers are studied. The responses of junctions are related to injected position and numbers. These results are proved to have an important significance in researching the law of conducted coupling to the electromagnetic pulse on complicated network.

articleTitle: An optical add-drop multiplexer design based on fiber Bragg gratings
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Optical add-drop multiplexers will play an important role in enabling greater connectivity and flexibility in dense wavelength-division multiplexing (DWDM) networks. In this paper, a reconfigurable optical add-drop multiplexer (OADM) architecture using a single multiport optical circulator (MOC) and several narrow band fiber Bragg gratings (FBGs) is proposed and demonstrated. The proposed OADM exhibits a lower insertion loss and lower through loss than existing OADMs. The proposed OADM may find important applications in DWDM systems and networks.

articleTitle: The design of PCI express-based multi-channel LVDS signal transfer card
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: This paper described a high-speed LVDS data transfer card design and implementation which is based on PCI Express Bus. The transfer card can receive multiple high-speed LVDS data outside and integrate the multi-channel data in the FPGA to be conversed to PCI data form and transmitted to the PCI-PCI Express bridge chip, which will eventually pass the data PCI Express bus as the carrier to the computer for data analysis. This article focuses on the key technology of the system hardware design and PCI bus control logic. The adapter data transfer and reliable performance, and the card has been successfully used in engineering practice.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of sequential filter based on unbiased converted measurements with doppler
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The Doppler measurements can be used to improve tracking accuracy efficiently. Based on unbiased converted measurements, the statistical character of the correlated range and pseudo range rate measurement errors is deduced and a sequential filtering algorithm with Doppler is progressed. The performance such as tracking accuracy, evaluation consistency and calculation complexity is studied comparing with the traditional extended Kalman filter with Doppler. The simulation results show that the new algorithm can accommodate longer distance and bigger measurement error situation, and has higher level of accuracy, faster convergence and more reliability.

articleTitle: An image retrieval method based on texture features of object region
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: An image retrieval method based on texture features of object region is presented in this paper, according to Otsu algorithm and local binary pattern (LBP) algorithm. First, it converts color image from RGB color space to gray space. Then the gray image are segmented into object region and background region by using Otsu algorithm and the texture features of object region are extracted by using LBP texture descriptor. Finally, the procedure of feature match is carried out and the retrieval results are listed to user by the descending order of similarity. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can effectively describe the texture feature of an image and achieve higher rates of precision and recall compared with the commonly used texture feature algorithms such as gray level co-occurrence matrix and traditional LBP texture descriptor.

articleTitle: Adaptive bit loading algorithm for OFDM underwater acoustic communication system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: A kind of improved adaptive bit loading algorithm for OFDM (Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing) underwater acoustic communication system is proposed. This algorithm improves the classical bit loading algorithm of Fischer algorithm, and it fixes the shortcomings of Fischer algorithm. For the underwater acoustic channel, the improved algorithm has a better BER (Bit Error Ratio) performance and less calculation than Fischer algorithm.

articleTitle: Zero bias Schottky diodes use in high performance detection circuits
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Zero bias Schottky diodes often used as microwave power detectors. The detection law is a function of frequency, temperature, power, DC bias and diode parameters such as n (ideality factor) and I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">s</inf> (saturation current). In order to get wider dynamic range, better thermal stability and more accurate square law response over the dynamic range we analyzed these characteristics of the Schottky diodes in MATLAB. Detailed characteristics analysis, related curves and solve methods have been shown in this paper.

articleTitle: Seafloor exploration using a 4-element towed fiber optic hydrophone array
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: This paper reports a demonstration trial for the seafloor exploration using a 4-element towed fiber optic hydrophone array system with 3×3 demodulation approach. The stability of the receiving signals of the array is discussed. A rough stratigraphic map is obtained. And the experimental result offers a good foundation for further investigation

articleTitle: Research on transformer chromatographic peaks quantitative analysis based on wavelet filtering
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Referred to the conventional chromatogram algorithm, this paper describes transformer chromatographic peaks quantitative analysis based on wavelet filtering; by component concentration test of field data, relative error of quantitative analysis is within 2%, complying with system design requirements.

articleTitle: The decision tree classification and its application research in personnel management
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The decision tree classification algorithm technique is a common forecasting mode, the judgment on the date of talents recruitments, which can be used as the best talent identification, providing the reasonable and scientific supports for the talent identification. The talents recruitment is great important for the development of universities. The talent identification is accomplished by certain rules; it is difficult to ensure a comprehensive, scientific and accurate recognition result. But, the decision tree classification obtained the advantages of visual expression directly, transforming into a standard database query easily and classification model precisely, so it is widely used in the massive data analysis.

articleTitle: 2-km-range and 2-cm-spatial-resolution Brillouin optical fiber sensor using a transient differential pulse pair
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: We report a long-range and high-spatial-resolution Brillouin optical time-domain analysis based on differential pulse-width pair technique. A 2-cm spatial resolution with a 2°C temperature accuracy is realized over 2-km sensing length by using an optimized 8/8.2 ns transient pulse pair.

articleTitle: Synthesis and size control of carbon quantum dots by tailoring laser parameters
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Carbon quantum dots (C-dots) were synthesized by laser irradiation graphite flakes in polymer solution and display size and excitation wavelength dependent photoluminescence (PL) behavior. Our studies show that the size distribution of C-dots can be controlled by tuning laser pulse width and affects fluorescence quantum yield (FQY) of C-dots. FQY of C-dots from 0.4 ms pulse width is above five times higher than that from 2.0 ms pulse width. The possible mechanism of one-step synthesis and size control of C-dots via laser irradiation was also proposed in the present work.

articleTitle: The combinational application of LZSS and LZW algorithms for compression based on Huffman
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: By introduction on the theories of the two dictionary compression algorithms of LZSS and LZW, this paper analyzes the pros and cons of these two algorithms for compression, on the premise of improvement on these two algorithms, designs the compression algorithm combining LZSS and LZW. Based on this, this paper further improves the combinational compression algorithm, introduces Huffman code to implement coding output for the compression result, and increases the compression rate of the combinational compression algorithm. Finally, comparison between these compression algorithms aforementioned was carried out; the combinational algorithm based on Huffman coding obtained relatively good compression effect

articleTitle: Based on single-chip microcomputer temperature and humidity data acquisition system design
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In the actural production of life in many cases are to consider the influence of temperature and humidity environment and precise control, Then came the data acquisition system. Because the CAN bus can improve anti-jamming ability and reliability of the data, corrective ability etc. Therefore, use the CAN bus interface to transfer data then monitored by the upper machine. This article introduced data acquisition system design composed of temperature and humidity sensor, the SCM system, computer, the can bus. After SHT75 digital temperature and humidity sensors collect the temperature and humidity measurement data in warehouse room, to send data to C8051F060 SCM system through the bus interface.C8051F060 SCM do simple rapid processing of data through the CAN bus interface to the computer for real-time monitoring. Through testing, the system can realize data acquisition, processing and communication.

articleTitle: Room and Low temperature photoluminescence properties of CdSe quantum dots synthesized rapidly in aqueous approach
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Thiol-capped CdSe quantum dots are synthesized rapidly in aqueous solution assisted by microwave irradiation without any poisonous materials. Room and low temperature photoluminescence is employed to investigate the excitonic emission from thiol-capped CdSe quantum dots between 83K and 293 K. The photoluminescence peak position of CdSe quantum dots shift to shorter wavelengths and the photoluminescence intensity first enhance and then quench with decrease of temperature. The temperature dependence of the PL spectra is demonstrated through thermal escape and thermal rectification of surface trap states.

articleTitle: Formation keeping of Micro-Satellites LQR control algorithms analysis
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Formation keeping of Micro-Satellites is one of the main issues about satellite formation flying control. Satellites may be perturbed by many perturbations in formation flying all the time and the life of the satellite is affected directly by perturbations, it needs to eliminate or reduce the influence which is caused by the methods of formation flying control. Firstly, Base on the HILL equation, use LQR theory to design the controller; then under the condition which is satisfied with the performance index requirements, choose the weighted matrix of Q and R in LQR design method; finally, analyzed the influence of the weighted matrix of Q and R on performance index system.

articleTitle: Decoding human right and left hand motor imagery from EEG single trials using Sample Entropy
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: This study aims to researching whether human intentions to move left and right hands can be decoded from Sample Entropy (SampEn) features in non-invasive EEG. Eleven healthy subjects participated in the experiment. We found the a waves SampEn value of imagined left hand movement is larger than imagined right hand movement in most of male electrodes, especially F3, C3 and T3, and the a waves SampEn value of imagined right hand movement is larger than imagined left hand movement in most of female electrodes, especially Fp1 and P3. Experiment results show that SampEn can express the EEG dynamic features of imagined left and right hand movement. Besides it has clear physiological significance. Fisher discriminator analysis is utilized to dynamically classify imagined left and right hand movement according to SampEn features. As a result, we gained a male average maximum classification accuracy of 76.97%. Lastly, we discussed the influence of different time length and t value on the classification accuracy.

articleTitle: The fuzzy controller designing of the self-balancing robot
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Referring to unsteady, nonlinear, and strong coupling of the self-balancing robot, This paper using Newtonian mechanics to build the steering movements of mathematical models which contain Fuzzy controller and Fuzzy control methods to control the self-balancing robot. At last, using Matlab to simulate the angle of swing link, angular velocity of swing link, velocity and displacement, the result of the simulation suggested that system has good balance and robustness, has advantage in immunity and adjusting the time.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Reserch on the newly-founded undergraduate college students' psychological healthe assessment and analysis
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Purpose: in order to investigate condition of psychological health of college students of the newly-founded universities', we conduct psychological health interventions to help cultivate the students' good psychological quality, and help them to be the right person the country and the community need. Methods: we made a study in 3 newly-founded universities among the students, who were in Grade-2008, Grade-2009 and the students in Grade 2010 by the self rating scale application symptoms evaluation analysis, and application of the college student's personality questionnaire evaluation analysis. Results: Results show that in these three newly-founded colleges, the psychological health level of the students is better than the general mode of the college students. The self-assessment lists of symptom is suspected about 14.10% of the students with psychological problems; 4.37% of whom were sure to have psychological problems; 1.60% of whom have obvious psychological problems. With college students' personality questionnaire,we found about 9.08% of the college students who were with mental illness or had psychological barriers, about 38.42% seemed to have general psychological problem; Psychological problems mainly displays in the forms of force symptoms, sensitive interpersonal relation, depression, paranoid, hostile, anxiety and psychoticism, etc. Male college students are more hostile to each other than female students. The latter are more sensitive to horror than male students; those students who come from one-child families have more advantages in psychological quality; The students from the cities have better psychological quality than those from the countryside; college running conditions and teaching level is better, the psychological health condition of the students is better. Conclusion: the newly-founded universities college students' mental health is much better than the general mode but, there is much work to do better, from all-sides and by all means to conduct the education of psychological health and implementation of multi-level interventions.

articleTitle: Interference mitigaion between femtocell and macrocell
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Femtocell is no longer a new concept to the public in the 21st century, which witnesses the tremendous advancement of high-tech. In terms of interference mitigation between networks, particularly, there are already a large amount of available measures, such as hybrid spectrum usage and self-optimizing that make great contribution to network optimization. This paper illustrates three types of interference in the cooperation of macro-femto cells from the aspect of the efficient spectrum utilization. Meanwhile, we also introduce an advanced version of Femtocell called Attocell, which shows the advantages of next generation Femto-communication by comparison.

articleTitle: Experimental measurement and numerical calculation of dispersion of ZBLAN fiber
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The ZrF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>-BaF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>-LaF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>-AlF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>-NaF (ZBLAN) fluoride glass is transparent in a wide wavelength region. Based on this property, it is suitable for many applications especially the sensing, fiber lasers and amplifiers , and infrared supercontinuum generation. All these applications are related closely with the dispersion characteristics of the ZBLAN fibers. In this paper, a novel method based on supercontinuum and interferometer to measure the dispersion of ZBLAN fiber was presented. The experimental and numerical calculation results were compared and found that they were matched well. The zero-dispersion wavelength was obtained around 1.49µm which is shorter than the material zero-dispersion wavelength 1.62µm of the ZBLAN fluoride glass.

articleTitle: A novel navy ship power system restoration using multi-agent approach
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: A reconfiguration system is needed to solve power balance problems and try to satisfy vital loads as much as possible. And it is important to restore the power system as soon as possible to a target network configuration after the fault, especially after combat damage occurs. Current reconfiguration techniques are centralized methods and cannot meet the Navy's needs for fight-through survivability and high reliability [1]. This paper presents a novel multi-agent based reconfiguration approach to perform system restoration for navy ship. Each zone agent in this system communicates with other agents. With the same global information and the same target, all zone agents use the same algorithm and collaborate with each other to achieve the reconfiguration objective as soon as possible.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation on magnetic flux leakage testing of the steel cable at different speed title
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The safety operation of steel cable is vital and the cable should be maintained through regular inspection. Magnetic flux leakage (MFL) method is a popular inspection technique. For the online nondestructive testing (NDT), the eddy current arises in the steel cable due to the relative movement of the cable and the MFL system, which affects the defect field and causes the difficulty in the defect inspection. In this paper, for axial MFL system with permanent magnet excitation at different speeds, the distribution of eddy currents, magnetic flux lines and magnetic leakage field are investigated by numerical simulation. The results provide a deep insight into the design of the MFL system.

articleTitle: A laser diode sensor for in-situ monitoring of H2S in the desulfurizing device
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Hydrogen Sulfide is a highly toxic and corrosive gas which is generated in many industrial processes. Gas detectors based on Tunable Diode Laser Absorption Spectroscopy (TDLAS) have been used in a wide variety of applications for safety and environmental field. In order to meet the requests of industrial field anti-explosion, a laser diode sensor for H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>S in situ monitoring has been developed, combining with wavelength modulation spectroscopy technology, White cell technology and current loop technology. The important features of the H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>S sensor are the speed of response, nonintrusive in-situ safety measurement, zero cross interference from background gases and long distance transmitting with the detection limit of 10ppm·m. The continuously monitoring results demonstrate that the sensor is suitable for application of H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>S monitoring in desulfurizing device.

articleTitle: Backscattering analysis of coated plate and coated dihedral corner reflector
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The electromagnetic scattering of a plane wave by a coated plate and a coated dihedral corner reflector are discussed in this paper. The solutions obtained here are based on the high frequency asymptotic method of Maliuzhinets method which is useful for diffraction problems. The two special functions used in this method, namely, Maliuzhinets function and Fresnel transition function are calculated by using tanh transformation and Jian-Ming Jing's method. Several numerical results are given and it is shown that the method is better in calculating coated objects. The results are in good agreement with the reference values, which proves the validity of the method commendably.

articleTitle: Review of explosive detection using terahertz spectroscopy technique
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: With the rapid development of the terahertz spectroscopy technique, it has been widely used in the field of safety inspection, aerospace, life science and chemistry. Most explosives and related compounds have characteristic absorption and many nonmetal and nonpolarity materials are transparent to terahertz wave, so it has shown significant potential for the safety inspection. This article firstly introduces the characteristics of terahertz and the progress of THz spectroscopy technique. Then the authors summarize the abroad research status of explosives detection using terahertz spectroscopy technique, and also sum up the research of our country. Finally this article outlooks the future development trend.

articleTitle: Fast detecting and tracking algorithm of Infrared target under complex background
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: A tracking algorithm of Infrared target is proposed that is the combination of non-linear edge detection and Mean Shift method. The non-linear edge detection algorithm employs dual-window arithmetic operators that has the advantage of few calculation amount, high speed, good image quality and so on. The result of edge detection is binary images. Based on these information, the Mean Shift method is improved to implement target tracking. The tracking algorithm of improved Mean Shift combines the information of the local standard deviation calculation of the target area, describes the target based on the probability density function about gray value and the local standard deviation and selects cascade kernel function to calculate the target density that make up the shortage only using gray to describe the target features. Experimental results show that the edge of infrared target under complex background is detected clearly and infrared target is auto-tracked accurately.

articleTitle: The combination method for different kinds of beliefs
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The evidential reasoning theory provides an important reasoning mechanism, and has been widely researched. However, the researches always focused on the combination for the same kind of beliefs. To solve the combination problems about different kinds of beliefs, this paper proposed a combination method for different kinds of beliefs. This method converts different beliefs to triangular fuzzy numbers or trapezoidal fuzzy numbers, and combines the beliefs by using the computation of fuzzy numbers. The beliefs including number beliefs, interval beliefs, linguistic beliefs and vague beliefs can all be converted to fuzzy numbers. According to the corresponding combination rules, the new method can realize the effective fusion of these different beliefs. The experimental results have proved the feasibility of the new method.

articleTitle: Study on attitude updating algorithm of SINS
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The attitude updating is the key technology of strapdown inertial navigation, whose precision has a great influence on strapdown inertial navigation system(SINS) that is short for strapdown inertial navigation system. So in order to increase the precision of the system, it is of great significance to choose an attitude updating algorithm of high-precision. The representative algorithms are Euler angle algorithm, direction cosine algorithm, quaternion algorithm, rotation vector algorithm and improved rotation vector algorithm. Based on the practical applying, this paper studies on the Euler angle algorithm, quaternion algorithm and three-sample improved rotation vector algorithm respectively and simulations were carried out to analyze the performance of each algorithm under the circumstance of coning motion.

articleTitle: All-fiber pulsed laser with narrow line width
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: An all-fiber pulsed laser with narrow line width is demonstrated which consists of a pulsed fiber laser seed, a narrow line width abstraction device and two stages of single mode ytterbium-doped fiber amplifiers (YDFA). The pulsed fiber laser seed is passively mode-locked by a semiconductor saturable absorber mirror (SESAM) with 3nm line width. The narrow line width abstraction device extracts only 0.2nm line width optical spectrum from the seed without changing the time-domain characteristics of the optical pulses. After two stages of single mode YDFA the laser has 163.3mW average output power with 0.86nm line width.

articleTitle: Experiment investigation of plasma plume deflection with MHD
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: This article presents a compositive MHD method to control high-velocity Plasma flows generate by alkali salts in combustion gas, demonstrates that MHD system can make the jet plume to deflect, and realizes the aeroengine thrust-vector purpose. Bases on analyzing and applying the MHD mathematical model, establish the MHD experiment system of plasma control, under the specific condition of experiment, with the analysis of physical-chemistry, puts some metal salt compound of low ionization energy into the combustion gas, gets the low temperature plasma flows, effectively realizes the MHD control of plasma jet plume deflection and thrust-vector, researches the ionization characteristic of the metal salt and combustion gas.

articleTitle: Microstructure and wear properties of self-lubricating MoS2/Ni coating by laser cladding
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Self-lubricating MoS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/Ni coating was prepared on a medium carbon steel substrate by CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> laser cladding using powder mixture of Ni60+50% (wt.%) Ni-coated MoS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>. The chemical compositions and microstructures of the coatings were analyzed using SEM, EDS and XRD. Microhardness was measured on a microhardness tester. The friction coefficient and wear properties were investigated using on a pin-on-ring wear tester. The results show that, during laser cladding process, MoS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> decomposes to generate some new lubricants such as Cr<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1+x</inf> and Fe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1+x</inf>. Most spherical blocks Cr<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1+x</inf> exist in the upper section, while white dots Fe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1+x</inf> disperse continuously on γ-Ni grain boundary from top to bottom of coating. The coating has a homogeneous microhardness distribution, which is higher than that of the substrate. The friction coefficient of the coating was reduced to 0.09∼0.22 in air. The coating wear mass and wear volume was 33.3% and 2.2% of the substrate, respectively.

articleTitle: SESQP-based semi-submersible platform thrust allocation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: This paper addresses thrust allocation optimization applied to semi-submersible platform for energy conservation. Here we suggest a sequential quadratic programming method based on simplex evolution technique (SESQP), where we consider thruster rate, forbidden sectors into simplex solution space and take account operational constraints into objective function minimized thrust typically. The method is illustrated by simulation experiment for a certain semi-submersible platform equipped with azimuth thrusters. The example shows flexible performance and reduced energy consumption.

articleTitle: Data association algorithm based on improved fuzzy C-means for multi-target tracking
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: A new data association algorithm based on improved fuzzy c-means (IFMC) for multi-target tracking in a cluttered environment was proposed. Firstly, the proposed algorithm was used to cluster the received measurements and then by introducing the conception of the fuzzy membership degree, the partition matrix of measurements to track is constructed. The proposed approach has a lower computational complexity in the expense of a little lower performance compared to the JPDA algorithm. Simulation results show that the arithmetic is an effective solution with less calculation to precision of association between measurements and measurements for multiple targets in a cluttered environment.

articleTitle: Experimental apparatus for simultaneous measurement of temperature and emissivity at medium-high temperature
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Based on the Kirchhoff's law, an experimental apparatus was configured and fabricated to facilitate accurate emissivity and temperature measurements at medium-high temperature. The apparatus consists of four parts: the sample heating system, optical receiving system, signal amplifying and controlling system, and display system. In order to validate the experimental device, the temperature and emissivity of SUS 201 is measured between 823K and 1373K at 1.5μm. The estimated uncertainty of temperature measurement is better than 0.3%. An instrument for practical temperature measurement can be developed according to the measuring principle.

articleTitle: An adaptive infrared image enhancement algorithm based on NSCT
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In this paper, an infrared image enhancement algorithm based on nonsubsampled contourlet transform (NSCT) and adaptive threshold is proposed. The enhancement is done in the transform domain. At first, coefficients in different scales and different directions are obtained by image decomposition using the nonsubsampled contourlet transform. And then, filter thresholds and enhancement functions are adaptively estimated according as these coefficients. Finally, image enhancement is implemented by reconstruction of these enhanced coefficients. The experiment results indicate that the algorithm proposed in this paper can get better effects compared with other algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on clustering based on short message text
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: This article firstly discusses the situation of Chinese vocabulary in semantic space (categorical space), then research short message text word by word, by which we can treat short message text as a vocabulary. Next, it discusses the meaning similarity of vocabulary and the selection of clustering features, and presents a method on short message text clustering.

articleTitle: Multiwavelength Brillouin fiber laser with EDFA
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The brillouin erbium-doped fiber laser (BEFL) is a novel kind of multiwavelength fiber laser, which can produce a laser comb with spacing of 0.088nm(11GHz). In this paper, the brillouin erbium-doped fiber laser with ring cavity is studied. The different coupling ratios of coupler are selected to investigate the laser output characteristic. A stable 7-wavelengths fiber laser is obtained by optimizing the coupling ratios of couplers. With the advantage of stabilization of adjacent wavelength peak, narrow linewidth and smooth of adjacent wavelength peak, simple structure, this multi-wavelength laser can be applied in the dense wavelength division multiplexing systems.

articleTitle: A research of virtual scene on synthesis systems technology
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: This paper discusses the work of a photo digital compositing, the use of electronic technology to obtain shooting scene lighting and camera position, focal length and other information that passed through the computer communication interface, 3DS file changes based on these data, in the three-dimensional software Platform for high-quality rendering, the final digital compositing of photo works.

articleTitle: The fiber-optic evanescent wave fluorescence sensor with a novel sensing architecture for determining penicillin G
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In this paper, we describe a specific fiber-optic evanescent wave (EW) fluorescence sensor with a naturally built-in high signal to noise ratio, including a novel sensing architecture. It includes two identical, low hydroxyl content, large core, multimode plastic-clad silica fibers that are positioned side to side, with a fiber for delivering incident exciting light and the other for receiving fluorescent light. By optimizing inclination of the incident fiber end-face, incident light illuminates perpendicularly receiving fiber after end-face reflection to excite fluorescent molecular in surrounding aqueous solution, and excited fluorescence couples into receiving fiber as the form of EW. Through increasing receiving fiber end-face's roughness, the total internal reflection of massive low-loss tunneling modes occurs on the end-face, providing a high signal to noise ratio without some filters in existence. Finally, by means of the fluorescence quenching analysis, we investigated the content determination of penicillin G on the fiber-optic evanescent wave sensing platform, and obtained corresponding standard working curve.

articleTitle: Structure optimization of heat sink for high power LED street lamp
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Light emitting diode (LED) is now widely used in many fields including traffic lights, vehicle backlights and liquid crystal display (LCD) displays because of their long life, good illumination efficiency and low energy consumption. For the high power LED street lamp, a low operating temperature is essential for LED chips. However, it's waste and meaningless to increase the size of heat sink for high power LED street lamp immoderately. In this paper, structure optimization of heat sink is studied on the condition that the heat sink is sufficient for cooling demand of 196W LED street lamp. 1/7, 2/7 and 3/7 length diminution of the heat sink are studied respectively. Results show that temperature of plate surface is increased 16°C with 3/7 bulk and weight reducing. And cross-sectional shape optimization of fin is also studied. The result show that the bulk and weight of fins are reduced over 50% with only 0.42°C temperature rise. The results of this work provide useful guidelines for thermal management of the heat sink without affecting the cooling demand of high power LED street lamp.

articleTitle: Design of traffic lights with wireless control system based on STC89C51 and NRF905 module
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The system adopts MCU STC89C51 to control traffic lights at crossroads to function in a normal logical way. In the meantime, a wireless transceiver system based on NRF905 module is added to fulfill wireless control. And the traffic lights system can convert into a requested status by checking out the data package it has received when an emergency happens. Ultimately, the project has been testified feasible by experiment.

articleTitle: Modeling and performance evaluation of a high speed serial bus
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: ASE AS5643 is a high speed data bus which is a set of enhancements to the IEEE 1394b standard, and it is used for military and aerospace vehicle applications. In SAE AS5643, the standard asynchronous streams are used for communication on networks. The article aims at developing the model of data transmission in a single node with Deterministic and Stochastic Petri Nets (DSPN). Furthermore, the performances of the model is simulated by using TimeNet 4.0 software tool, and the relationships among bus throughput, data size, packet size, bandwidth which is pre-assigned and bus utilization are obtained. The article also illustrates the parameters compared with those of IEEE 1394b, and proves that SAE AS5643 meets the needs of military and aerospace vehicle applications much better.

articleTitle: Application of wavelet threshold filter in initial alignment of SINS for land vehicle
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In order to improve accuracy and convergence rate of alignment of SINS for land vehicle, with considering the SINS error model and analyzing the major noise sources, the wavelet threshold filter was applied to eliminate high frequency noise in signal effectively. Next, initial alignment was by completed adaptive Kalman filter to reduce the errors from the inaccurate mathematical models and statistical properties of noise. Finally, the experiment results show the methods with wavelet threshold filter and adaptive Kalman filter improve effectively the convergence rate and alignment accuracy. It can satisfy the demands of navigation for land vehicle in general environment, and has a greater practical engineering value.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Legislations and management of commercial chambers in western developed countries and the enlightment for China
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Low roll-off efficiency and chromatic-stable white organic light-emitting diodes based on excimer emission
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: White Organic light emitting devices (WOLEDs) based on excimer emission have been fabricated, using only a platinum [1,3-difluoro- 4,6-di(2-pyridinyl)benzene] chloride(Pt-4) doped in 1,3-bis(9-carbazolyl)benzene (mCP), a single emissive layer to obtain white emission which comprises red and blue light-emitting spectra. The maximum current-and power- efficiency values of white device are 11.5 cd/A and 9.21 lm/W, respectively. And we obtained low roll-off efficiency and stable Commission International d'Eclairage (CIE) chromaticity coordinates of (0.32, 0.39).

articleTitle: Thermal design based on thermosyphon heat sink of high-power LED street light
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: LED (light emitting diode) is called the fourth generation of lighting, which has already been used in illumination systems. In LED street light device, the temperature of high-power LED is an important parameter and it affects the entire performance of system. A method researching radiators based on finite element analysis was introduced. In this paper, the thermal model of LED street light based on thermosyphon heat sink was introduced, and simulated the changing of parameters of radiator by ANSYS. Research conclusions show this thermosyphon heat sink has a good performance.

articleTitle: Study of remote serial communication on PC & MCS51 in Kingview
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Kingview is better Configuration software in china. It is a development trend that using it design monitoring and control system, but in Kingview how to realize remote serial communication is a question between PC (Personal Computer) and MCS51. In this paper a method of serial communication was put forward between PC and MCS51 in Kingview6.51, and the interface circuit of PC and MCS51 was designed, a serial communication protocol was made up. We applied it to the copper single crystal wire process units which are controlled by many AT89S51, realized PC to the entire copper single crystal wire production process' monitoring and management. The practice proved that the method is feasible in kingview6.53.

articleTitle: Channel capacity and source encoding of quantum information transmission
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Quantum teleportation is a new kind of communication type which uses quantum entanglement effect to transmit information. We have studied the channel capacity and source encoding of quantum information transmission in this paper, and we have mainly studied quantum binary channel transmission rate and capacity. We also have studied such three kinds of encoding methods about quantum source encoding as Shannon, Huffman, and Fano, and compared these three methods.

articleTitle: Discussion on the properties of hilbert space adjoint operator on the orthogonal complement
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Consider any non-empty subset M of Hilbert space, Let M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">⊥</sup> is the orthogonal complement in Z, This article discusses some important properties of adjoint operator on orthogonal complement.

articleTitle: The experimental criteria for judging the maximum bubble radius of laser-iduced bubble in different ambient pressures
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The radius of laser-induced bubble in different ambient pressures is measured by a fiber-optic diagnostic technique based on laser-beam deflection probe (BDP). The experimental criteria for judging the maximum bubble radius are modified. The estimation value of the maximum radius is defined as the arithmetic mean of the value of the detecting distances at which the characteristic waveform signals appear. The estimation of root mean square error is also obtained. The maximum value and the expanding of bubble radius are obtained by means of the BDP signals and the modified criteria. The experimental results show that the less experiment is needed for obtaining the maximum radius, the maximum radius decreases with the ambient pressure increases. These results are useful to the investigations on cavitations and the measuring of bubble.

articleTitle: The design and application of automatic online monitoring system of algae based on fluorescent sensing technology
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Real-time measured algae data is significant for researches of early-warning model and formation mechanism and of water bloom. Building long-term and on-line monitoring system is one of most effective way of obtaining Real-time measured data. Based on sensing method of chlorophyll fluorescence in vivo, this paper presents design idea of algae on-line monitoring system and emphatically studies embedded control technology, real-time data acquisition technology and GPRS wireless transmission technology.

articleTitle: Study of the application of the turbine flowmeter
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Because of high accuracy, excellent repeatability and low pressure drop, turbine flowmeter is widely used in industry to measure gas or liquid flow. However, the disadvantage in linearity restricts its application. A new method, called piecewise linearity means, is discussed in paper. By using the new method, the flow range of the turbine flowmeter can be enlarged easily. A comparison between average meter factor and piecewise linearity means is present. This method can also be used in other sensors that output pulse signal.

articleTitle: The Design of RBF Neural Networks and experimentation for solving overfitting problem
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: One of the biggest problems in designing or training RBF neural networks are the overfitting problem. The traditional design of RBF neural networks may be pursued in a variety of ways. In this paper, we present a method for the design of RBF networks to solve overfitting problem. For a practical application, frequency information is usually available for designing RBF networks by frequency domain analysis, which has a sound mathematical basis.
