publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The ZnO-based ceramic samples containing Ag were prepared using the conventional solid-state reaction method. The experimental results showed that the non-ohmic and dielectric properties of the ZnO-based ceramic could be regularly changed by doping with Ag when the Ag percentages were more than 5.2% in volume. With the increase of the Ag fractions in the ceramic matrixes, the nonlinear voltage of the samples obviously decrease with a light decay of the nonlinear coefficient while the dielectric constants greatly increase with almost the same dissipation factors at 20Hz∼1MHz. This demonstrates a fact that the electrical and dielectric behaviors of the ZnO-based ceramics can be improved by optimizing the content of Ag in the ceramic matrix.

articleTitle: Approximate entropy analysis of alpha wave evoked by mental arithmetic tasks
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The major purpose of this study was to explore the relationship between cognitive workload and Approximate entropy (ApEn). Mental arithmetic tasks with the different interval were assigned to the 40 subjects of different genders. ApEn method was used to analyze alpha wave at the electrode P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>, P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>, O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> and O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> from EEG data. It is one of nonlinear dynamics parameters to measure the complexity of sequence and quantify statistics as long as the relatively short data points are provided. Moreover, ApEn has good anti-noise and anti-jamming capability. The results show that ApEn value of about 3 / 4 the participants is higher in the 2s mental arithmetic task than in the 3s task. So it can be concluded that most of the people, whether male or female, have higher ApEn value of alpha wave at the cerebral top and occipital if their brain have more workload. It suggests the more workload increase the work complexity of the human brain. Additionally, this suggests that people should distribute reasonably workload as the human brain should not always be in a disorder conditions.

articleTitle: A method of tip-sample distance control based on electrostatic force in maskless microplasma scanning etching
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In cantilever-based microplasma etching system proposed by our group, the controlling of tip-sample distance is important for maskless canning etching. This paper presents a tip-sample controlling method based on electrostatic force. Theoretical model to calculate the electrostatic force between the conductive probe and the sample is established. The relationship of the electrostatic force and the tip-sample distance under different bias voltages is investigated by experiments based on AFM. Both the theory and experiments prove that this electrostatic force is feasible for maskless scanning plasma etching with the etching distance of 1–2µm.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of initiation of metal/explosive structure under laser irradiation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Based on the heat conduction equation and the theory of thermal explosion of high explosive, a numerical model was presented to simulate the initiation of metal/explosive structure irradiated by high energy laser, considering the temperature dependences of the energy coupling coefficient and the material properties of the metal. We first compared the numerical results with the analytical results, and the program was proved effective. Then we described an experiment which validated our numerical model. Finally, we calculated the initiation times for a range of laser intensities and thicknesses of the metal casing. Their relations were described by two simple formulas which can be employed for rapid estimates in engineering applications.

articleTitle: A novel online ion spectrometer for efficient detection of laser-accelerated ions
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: An online ion spectrometer was developed mainly based on a Thomson parabola and plastic scintillators. The sensitivity of the spectrometer to the proton has been calibrated on an electrostatic accelerator. The diagnostics has been successfully tested in laser-driven ion acceleration experiments. The calibration data obtained from the DC accelerator are applied during the deconvolution process to obtain the ion spectrum. This online spectrometer provides us an efficient diagnostics for the ion spectra in high-repetition-rate laser acceleration experiments.

articleTitle: Research noise of image acquisition system on CCD
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The purpose of CCD signal processing is to eliminate the noises and interferences as much as possible under a precondition of not losing any image detail, and improve the signal to noise ratio to obtain high quality images. The main source of noise is analyzed in accordance with the species and nature of noise in this paper. All kinds of the process are adopted against corresponding noise and designing the electrical system.

articleTitle: A vertex tracking technique based on airborne opticalequipment
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: After analyzing the advantages and disadvantages of photoelectric tracking system with horizontal gimbal and X-Y double-axis gimbal, a vertex tracking method based on airborne photoelectric equipment has been presented. The method, which combines advantages of horizontal gimbal and X-Y double-axis gimbal, can effectively track target in the blind area. experiments show that the tracking method is simple, tracking accuracy is 3', meet the technical requirements.

articleTitle: Integral representation for the partial sum and establishes Lerch's formula
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In this paper, we shall study application of integral representation for the partial sum of the Hurwitz Zeta Function, form above two asymptotic formula, relevant connection of the results obtained with those considered in many other works are also discussed.

articleTitle: The non-rigid surface acoustic concave mirror model and sound field analysis
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The focused acoustic field of impedance surface acoustic concave reflector was studied by theoretical calculation. The influence of the different material parameters of reflector covering layers to the focused intensity and the beam partner were analyzed. The results showed that the main influencing factors to the focused acoustic field characteristics are the real part of admittance when the real part increase, the reflector focus ability reduced largely. But it is less influenced to the width of main lobe, and the side-lobe is decreased.

articleTitle: The language expression skills of technology cartoon soundtracks
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: With cartoon industry warming, animation dubbing creation is paid attention by more and more voice language researcher, it is also a new task of researchers the broadcast and host research field. Dubbing cartoons includes original slice and dubbed portion dubbing, the original piece includes early and later dubbing. Early dubbing is done after screenwriter is completed the cartoon, dubbing actor watch four animated cartoon under the guidance of the director or by script. Later dubbing is completed by actor and director and screenwriter together, dubbing actors watched generally on the screen and created according to mouth shape. The space for voice actors is larger in early dubbing. The voice actors can make a small change and big play according to actual circumstances, at present technology cartoons is used mostly this dubbing forms, such as “Avatar” and “transformers 2: comeback”, etc. There is a certain limitation in later dubbing, voice actors say actor's lines according to mouth shape appeared in cartoon and act out facial motions by language, such as “the lion king” and “Undersea round-up”, etc.

articleTitle: Measuring and study of the total intensity of the radiation side-scattered by the multiple particles' field
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: An experimental study on the properties of the total intensity of radiation side-scattered by the multiple particles when using linearly polarized incident light was undertaken. The scattering medium is the suspending liquid consisting of various concentrations of particles which are 0.065µm, 0.123 µm, 0.220 µm, 0.360 µm, 0.494 µm or 1.240 µm in diameter and which were mixed into filtered, distilled water. The experimental results show that the intensity variation is regular as particles' sizes, concentrations, or detecting depths varying and in the detected plane the intensity distribution of each component of the side-scattered light is angular-symmetric.

articleTitle: The hybrid refractive-diffractive optical system design of preposition of aperture LWIR
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The LWIR (Long Wave Infrared) used for observation heat. The influence of background radiation caused the sensitivity of the system decreased. The article uses subzero refrigeration detector, and require the efficiency of luminescence railing reaching 100%. The paper deduce the design formula of preposition of aperture LWIR, and the wave band 10~12μm, diameter 50mm, F/2, field 8.2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sup>×8.2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sup>. This paper based on the principle of binary diffractive optical elements, the unique dispersion properties have the incomparable advantage compared with traditional optical components in calibration system. Design results show that the hybrid refractive-diffractive Optical System compared with the traditional infrared optical system, not only use the fewer optical elements, and achieve the purpose of the lightweight, and the system performance also have significantly improved.

articleTitle: Preparation and properties research on glass dustproof coating
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Through the comparisons with the testing resultes of solidified resins, conceived and designed a new formula after repeated orthogonal experiment analysis. The film-forming materials are fluorine carbon resin and organic silicon modified acrylic resin.Same additives are added to improve it's physical and chemical characteristics. By experiment, the viscosity, solidifying time, adhesion, water resistant, hardness, abrasion resistance, thickness and contact angle were tested.

articleTitle: An efficient immunization strategy for scale-free networks based on random-walk betweenness
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: A novel and effective immunization strategy for controlling epidemic spreading on scale-free networks is proposed in this paper. It is performed by immunizing edges in proper order according to their weights which are defined as the product of the random-walk betweenness of two nodes of the edge. In contrast to other traditional immunization strategies which mainly focus on how to immunize nodes to control the epidemic spreading, our immunization strategy is more effective in realizing the control of epidemic, moreover, such a strategy can better retain the integrity of scale-free networks.

articleTitle: Influences of sinusoidal component on typical phase masks used to realize wave-front coding technique
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The key of wave-front coding lies in the design of suitable phase masks. In our recent research, by combining a sinusoidal component with the cubic phase mask, a new mask called cubic sinusoidal phase mask, abbreviated as CSPM is proposed and can enhance the DOF (depth of field) extension capability of cubic mask. However, that work needs further expansion. First, only the cubic phase mask is selected to demonstrate the effectiveness of sinusoidal component in improving the performance of wave-front coded imaging system, but this is not enough; second, several constraints, which are adopted to simplify the CSPM optimization, should be eliminated. In this paper, the researches have been expanded based on the two points mentioned above and the sinusoidal component is indeed useful for improving DOF extension capability of existing phase masks.

articleTitle: PCM self-test module based on RS422 interface
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In order to test PCM signal output from the acquisition module, a PCM self-test module based on RS422 interface is designed. The design of PCM simulation signal source and PCM decoding receiver module is to test the correctness of its output and reception. The connection between the transceiver module using RS422 interface. Decoded data transfer to PC by USB interface and check PCM self-test module working situation.

articleTitle: Electron field emission characteristics of nano-carbon needle films fabricated by microwave plasma CVD
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In this work, nano-carbon needle films (NCNFs) were prepared on p-type Si (100) substrates by means of quartz-tube type microwave plasma chemical vapor deposition (MWPCVD) in a hydrogen and methane mixture. The influences of total gas pressure on the nano-needle structure of carbon films were studied by field emission scanning electron microscope (FESEM). The field emission (FE) test indicated that the threshold electric field of NCNFs was reduced and the highest emission current density at an electric field of 5 V/µm was increased with increasing the total gas pressure. The good field emission properties with a low threshold field of 2.3 V/µm and a highest current density of 128.6 mA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> were obtained from NCNFs deposited at the total gas pressure of 60 Torr. A modified F-N model considering statistic effects of FE tip structures was proposed and the FE data in the low E region were reasonably interpreted.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Job burnout, social support and coping style state in prison police and their correlation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Neural-PID visual tracking of moving object
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In this paper, an adaptive approach is presented to nonlinear system for real-time robotic visual tracking of a moving polyhedral object. A light stripe vision system consists of a laser-stripe sensor and a CCD the camera fixed to robot end-effector, and projects planar light on the polyhedral object. The geometric conditions can be provided to assure location of features of the polyhedral faces. The objective is to predict the location of features of the object on the image plane based on the light stripe vision system and then to determine an optimal control input that will move the camera so that the image features align with their desired positions. We first give the equations of observation and state-space by using the motion rules of the camera and the object. Then, the system can be represented as an MIMO ARMAX model and an efficient estimation model. The estimation model can process on-line estimation of the 3D related parameters between the camera and the object. Those parameters are used as on-line train values of neural network. The control scheme adopts a neural-PID controller that can adjust the PID controller parameters. The paper concludes with the simulation results and the computer simulation shows that the proposed method is effective to visual tracking of combining vision and control.

articleTitle: The haar-CWT analysis of hyperspectral reflectance data to evaluating soil carbon and nitrogen
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The assessment of greenhouse gas emissions from soils requires an accurate knowledge on the fate of carbon and nitrogen in soils. Traditional analysis can not be used to evaluate carbon and nitrogen over large geographical areas. For this reason, hyperspectral remote sensing techniques for predicting soil organic carbon and nitrogen on a large scale have received much attention. This study mainly focused upon capturing the feature values of soil organic carbon (SOC) and total nitrogen (TN), and evaluating SOC and TN by applying wavelet analysis to reflectance spectra. Results of this study indicated that the maximum correlation coefficient between SOC, TN, and wavelet coefficient were more than 0.96 compared to the relationship between SOC, TN, and spectral reflectance (r=−0.79 for SOC, r=−0.40 for TN), especially for TN (the maximum negative correlation coefficient r=−0.964). For SOC+TN and SOC/TN, due to SOC contents accounted for a large proportion of soil composition compared to TN, their spectral feature were affected by SOC in soil sample. In addition, wavelet analysis also enhanced the features of SOC+TN and SOC/TN obviously. These results suggested that wavelet analysis was a better method for capturing the absorption features of soil composition using hyperstpectal remote sensing data.

articleTitle: Holographic interfermetry based on fulgide film
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Holographic interfermetry was realized in a 3-indoly-benzylfulgimide/ PMMA film by using double exposure method and single exposure method for the first time. The structures of an optical wedge and an optical axicon, the rotation angle of the optical wedge and the movement distance of the optical axicon were successfully measured. It is proved that fulgide films can be used as recording medium in holographic interfermetry. As a recording medium in holographic interfermetry, the 3-indoly-benzylfulgimide/PMMA films have many advantages such as low cost, easy to use, rewritable, long life time, and higher signal to noise ratio (with small particles) and higher sensitivity etc. Then using the photoinduced anisotropy property of the 3-indoly-benzylfulgimide/PMMA film, the polarization multiplexing holographic interfermetry was realized, which can be used in particle field's dynamic measurement. This method is told for the first time, and it is proved that using this method, not only the size but also the directions of the objects' movement velocities can be got.

articleTitle: Digital audio watermarking based on holographic nonlinear limiter
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: A new approach of digital audio watermarking by use of nonlinear amplitude limiting computer-generated hologram (CGH) is proposed to significantly improve the robustness than traditional CGH method. The amplitude and phase are extracted on the basis of traditional Fourier transform holography. Binary Fourier hologram was formed by nonlinear amplitude limiting algorithm when the phase information as input function and the amplitude information transferred into a bias function. The robustness of audio watermarking is much high because the binary hologram has stronger anti-interference property than the normal hologram. And because of the small amount of data in binary hologram, redundant embedding method can further improve the robustness. The CGH is embedded into audio signal by quantification technology and discrete-cosine-transform (DCT) algorithm. It can be extracted without the original audio signal and the security key provides good security. Experimental results show that the algorithm has more robustness than audio watermarking algorithm based on general CGH against common signal manipulations and attacks, such as lossy compression, re-sampling, low-pass filter, noise, and so on.

articleTitle: The conduction current and displacement current in a Terahertz antenna
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: A semiclassical Monte Carlo model is presented to study the time-varying conduction current and displacement current in a Terahertz photoconductive antenna after photoexcitation. We analyzed conduction current and displacement current in a biased GaAs photoconductive antenna after fs laser pulse excitation as a function of bias voltage, pump pulse energy. While we analyzed conduction current and displacement current contribute on THz wave radiation. The simulation results show that the light-intensity dependence mainly influences the pulse amplitudes of the conduction current and the displacement current and THz wave. At the same light-intensity, higher bias field gives larger conduction current. The simulation results show that conduction current and displacement current are source of THz waveform radiated by bias photoconductive current.

articleTitle: Synthesis of 2-butanone in carbon dioxide-enriched near-critical water
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: 2-Butaneone was synthesized from pinacol rearrangement of 2,3-butanediol (BDL) dehydration by using a cleaner and more environment benign approcah, which reaction systhem was in near-critical water (NCW). The result showed that the addition of carbon dioxide was benefit for the conversiotn of BDL while was not advantageous for the yeild of 2-butaneone. According the experimental results, the mechanism of dehydration of BDL in NCW was proposed.

articleTitle: Main functions about accounting software
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: We have introduced the main three system functions and data safety about accounting software. And we mainly studied the accounting data's input, such as the input of accounting vouchers and the input of original vouchers; we also have analyzed how to use accounting software, such as accounting, reconcile accounts with the bank, prepare statement automatically, settling accounts. At last, we have studied the output about counting data, such as the screen output function, print function, data storage and the safety of accounting data which are all provided by accounting software. What we have studied must be valuable to use accounting software.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Study on the relationship between the self-concept and mental health of Mongolian and Han high school students
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Some results on Word-oriented Nonlinear Feedback Shift Registers
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: This paper is devoted to the Word-oriented Nonlinear Feedback Shift Registers, we give some results about word oriented NFSRs through computer search, the main results is some cryptographic properties of sequences generated by word-oriented NFSRs. Our results are useful to the design of stream cipher systems using NFSRs.

articleTitle: Difference-frequency-based laser spectrometer for trace CH4 detection
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: A laser spectrometer based on difference-frequency generation in periodically poled LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> (PPLN) has been developed. The mid-infrared laser source was pumped by complementally two commercial narrow linewidth diode laser, to produce about 1μw of output power in the tuning region from 3.2μm to 3.7μm. The spectrometer was used for trace CH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> measurement, a CH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> absorption line at 3028.751 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> of v<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> band was chosen as this line is relatively free of interference by other gas species. The selected absorption line was verified using a single-pass cell detection. The detection sensitivity is estimated to be 0.8ppm for 10cm optical path length at atmospheric pressure, and is limited mainly by the etalon noise of optical surfaces.

articleTitle: Status and application prospect of surface nanocrystallization of metal materials
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Summarize the research status of surface nanocrystallization of metal materials, including the fundamental principle of surface nanocrystallization,its structural feature, preparation methods and functional characteristics, Surface nanocrystallization of research has extensive application prospect in the future.

articleTitle: Design of welding system in three-dimensional numerical control using laser with dual-wavelength and four-focus
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Laser welding has attracted so much attention in the field of processing, welding system in three-dimensional numerical control using in laser with dual-wavelength and four-focus is designed in this paper, the principle of multi-focus is described, the composition and control flow of control system of laser welding are analyzed.

articleTitle: Absolut pressure sensor based on amorphous alloy ribbon
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In this work, an absolute pressure sensor is designed. The ring core of the probe is made of Fe-rich amorphous alloy ribbon. The dual inductance coils wound on the ring core is asymmetrical and derived by the multivibrator circuit. The sensor final output shows that the maximum sensitivity is 172 mV/atm and the error of repeatability is less than 3%.

articleTitle: High-speed polarization coding in a quantum key distribution system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: We present a high-speed polarization-coding method, which makes use of phase modulation, for use in a quantum key distribution (QKD) system. This technique has been introduced into a QKD system for the first time. A completely quantum mechanical method is employed to describe quantum information processing here. Experiments on a balanced element for polarization coding by phase modulation are described in detail. The experimental results demonstrate that this technique can encode or decode polarization at high speed (with feasibility in the GHz range) and low voltage (a few volts) successfully.

articleTitle: The design and application of low power consumption distributed triaxial magnetic monitoring system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: SCM based on MSP430 design the low power dissipation distributed triaxial magnetic monitoring system, and it can fulfill magnetic data acquisition and transmission of the multi-channel triaxial component which is controllable and real-time. To reduce system power dissipation makes a further research in terms of choosing appropriate microprocessor, reasonable power-supply modes, clock frequency and optimization software design in the hardware and software system design. Experiment verify the systematic low power dissipation and better magnetic detectability, and it can realize the magnetic field detection and monitoring for large scope, wide range, high precision, low power dissipation in the whole system.

articleTitle: Image reconstruction of sparse fan-beam projections using a hybrid algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Image reconstruction from sparse fan-beam projection data would result in image error. In this paper, a hybrid imaging algorithm from sparse fan-beam projections is proposed. The first, high exact sparse spectrum data is extracted from image reconstruction from sparse fan-beam projections by filtered back-projection (FBP), and then image is reconstructed from the data using the iterative next-neighbor regridding (INNG) algorithm combined with total variation (TV) gradient descent method. The INNG step can restrict image distortions around the model and the TV gradient descent step can remove small oscillations in the model while preserving edges. The combined method is compared with the original INNG algorithm and TV gradient descent method. Computer simulation results demonstrate that the hybrid algorithm is effective for sparse fan-beam projection reconstruction.

articleTitle: Incoherently coupled photovoltaic soliton pairs
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: We investigate the existence and the properties of incoherently coupled bright-gray and gray-gray photovoltaic soliton pairs in unbiased photovoltaic crystals. The discussions of bright-dark, dark-dark, and dark-gray soliton pairs are involved in these two configurations. Some relevant examples are presented where the photovoltaic-photorefractive crystal is of lithium niobate type.

articleTitle: Study on the attitude control for High-speed Rotary Missile based on neural networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In the thesis, a new attitude control methods with neural network is set up for forcasting High-speed Rotary Missile. When considering the fix-errors, output equation is complex and nonlinear. The system is identified with BP neural network based on LM algorithm. Simulation results show that these attitude control methods can implement efficiently precise attitude control of rotary missile and identified effectively. It is possible that the integrated navigation system will be used in theory.

articleTitle: Switchable and tunable dual-wavelength Yb-doped fiber lasers with asymmetric exposure phase-shifted long-period fiber gratings
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: A switchable and tunable dual-wavelength Yb-Doped fiber laser was implemented with an asymmetric exposure phase-shifted long-period fiber grating inserted in the ring cavity. The asymmetric exposure phase shifted long-period fiber grating, which was fabricated by a CO2 laser, acts as a dual-wavelength filter with anisotropic transmission spectrum under different states of polarization. The wavelength switching and tuning is attributed to the polarization and bending characteristics of the asymmetric phase-shifted long-period fiber gratings respectively. It shows the possibility to achieve simultaneously switchable and tunable dual-wavelength Yb-Doped fiber lasers in an all-fiber format.

articleTitle: Analysis of infrared character of the temperature stratification sea surface disturbed by the propeller
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The surface temperature distribution of stratified sea water is different from the surroundings disturbed by the propeller and it can express a particular infrared character. The surface temperature distribution disturbed by a propeller in the negative temperature gradient sea is studied by numerical simulation and infrared imaging. The experiment is carried out through infrared camera imaging and the temperature character of the sea surface is obtained. The results show that there is high comparability between the numerical simulation and the infrared imaging. The mechanism of the sea surface temperature difference is explained and the feasibility of monitoring the sea surface temperature by the infrared camera is also validated.

articleTitle: Effect of transition metal ion on aroma compounds generation from model reaction of L- ascorbic acid and L-cysteine
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The identification of aroma compounds, generated from model reaction of L-ascorbic acid and L-cysteine was performed using a solid-phase microextraction-gas chromatography-mass spectrometry technology. The effects of the small amount of Fe<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>-ions, Zn<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>-ions or Cu<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>-ions on aroma compounds generation from model system of L-ascorbic acid and L-cysteine were investigated. The classification of aroma compounds was not affected much by Fe<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>-ions, Zn<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>-ions or Cu<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>-ions, but the yield of each type of aroma compounds was decreased observably. The yield of each type of aroma compounds appeared to be affected much more by Cu<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>-ions than by Zn<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>-ions or Fe<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>-ions depended on the different ions concentration. A plausible explanation for this phenomenon was that Fe<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>-ions, Zn<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>-ions or Cu<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>-ions depressed the thermal degradation of L-cysteine, on the other hand, but stimulated the active intermediates to convert high molecular weight compounds.

articleTitle: Applications of boundary value problem and impulsive effects to control harmful species
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: A predator-prey model with impulsive effect concerning biological strategy as well as chemical strategy is proposed and analyzed, at the same time, the application of boundary value problem to the system of two species with impulsive control in finite time are investigated. In this paper, the short-term managements of species are investigated by means of the theory of impulsive differential equations and boundary value problem, the comparison principle, the upper and lower solutions. By the comparison principle, the conditions under which the model has a solution are found by a series of the upper solutions and the conditions under which the model has no solution are also given by a series of the lower solutions.

articleTitle: Ejection and pulverization of vehicle diesel motor
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In this paper, we have studied the rules during the process of oil ejection and ejection performance of oil by means of hydromechanics principle. And we also have analyzed the reasons which cause abnormal oil ejection. What we have studied must be helpful to analyze vehicle diesel motor's ejection and pulverization phenomenon, increase the combustion efficiency of motor, and decrease the degree of pollution of oil combustion.

articleTitle: Application of intelligent control technology in robot
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In this paper, we have built evaluating structure of robot ability by means of robot control. On the basis of evaluating structure, we also have built a mathematical model which controlled by neural network. Depending on this mathematical model, we have optimized control factors and studied such main robot control technology as mission planning, path planning and motion control. We have mainly studied fuzzy logic and robot control problems.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A comparative study of screen reading and paper reading among primary school students
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Study on a call model based on the M/M/ S/k queuing system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Introduces the design of a new M/M/S/k queuing system model, On the basis of simulation using c + +, blocking rate of a new service request in each state k is calculated, and the relation curves of the arrival rate-blocking rate is drawn. At last, this paper compare simulation value and theoretical value.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of adaptive flow control by means of magnetohydrodynamic force: Part II
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Electromagnetic forces, i.e. Lorentz forces may be used to influence the flow of electrically conducting fluids. The present paper investigates the application of Lorentz forces to the control of separation at hydrofoil. Aiming at realizing the process of the on-line optimization of magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) active flow control, an adaptive control algorithm is adopted and a collaborative simulation scheme is proposed based on MATLAB and FLUENT.

articleTitle: Application of intelligent control method in magnetic bearing
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Active magnetic bearing (AMB) is a new kind of base mechanical component that can supply contactless support. Its working principle involves contactless support of the axle by the bearings through electrical magnetic force. So, AMB has some good features, such as no touch friction and wear, small motion resistance, lower power supply and long utility time. Overseas, AMB technology has reached mature level and increasingly products, which set up with AMB, can be found. The ways of design and process AMB rotor system are described. Here a number of design methods of AMB are dealt with, mainly includes the features in the systematic design, methods of design for the system controller, rigid shaft system and flexible shaft system. Some numeric results are presented also.

articleTitle: A query optimization algorithm of database based on layered backtracking
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Based on basic ideas of DP algorithm and backtracking method, a new query optimization algorithm based on layered backtracking is proposed, in optimization of simple query, “optimal” solution can be provided; As for some complex applications, it achieve balance between complex enumerative algorithm and quality of solution based on algorithm, and get the “second best” optimal result to improve efficiency of algorithm and save resources needed in operating environment.

articleTitle: Research on the optical characteristics of one-dimensional photonic crystal of the materials of positive and negative refractive index
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: With the optical transfer matrix method, this Thesis has presented the characteristic matrix the one-dimensional photonic crystal of the material of positive and negative refractive index and has researched the energy band structure characteristics. Through numerical simulation calculation, we have obtained the result that, the optical thickness and the negative refractive index of the photonic crystal material affect the forbidden band width and the location of the transmission spectrum central wavelength; the forbidden band central location will move toward the direction of the long wave as the optical thickness increases, and the band gap width will increase as the material thickness and refractive index increase; after foreign substances are incorporated into the photonic crystal of the material of positive and negative refractive index, the forbidden band will have defects, and the center of the defect mode and the frequency width will change with the change of the foreign substance absorption coefficient. These conclusions drawn herein will provide new methods for optical utilization, transmission and control…

articleTitle: Based on GSM network of intelligent telemetry water system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Intelligent telemetry water system is using GSM network platform, with single-chip microcomputer control technology and wireless network technology as the core, the intelligent information acquisition, processing to the user service terminals, to realize water level, water information sharing data telemetry. Realize remote data collection and the GSM wireless data transmission technology, combined with complete remote water level of telemetry, make the grassroots units get rid thoroughly artificial observation of water level in history.

articleTitle: An efficient multi-cue fusion based sequential monte carlo method for image sequence-based tracking
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: This paper presents an efficient image sequence tracking method based on multiple cues fusion in the sequential monte carlo method. we combine background-weighted color histogram with edge histogram into sequential monte carlo algorithm for tracking. The color-based histogram is robust against noise and partial occlusion, but suffers from the presence of the confusing colors in the background. So, background-weighted color histogram is used to describe objects color feature. The edge feature may provide complementary information for tracking as well. Color histograms and edge histograms are used to model the object observations likelihoods function. These observations are used to obtain a posterior probability distribution for the location of the object in the sequence images based on sequential Monte Carlo method. The experiments on real image sequences have shown that the combination of color for tracking with other image feature can achieve more robust tracking.

articleTitle: Affection of rheological property which caused by average molecular weight of macromolecule material
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: On the basis of molecule chain model of macromolecule material, we have studied the affection of rheological property which caused by macromolecule material chain structure, macromolecule material average weight and macromolecule material viscosity. We also have studied the affection which caused by macromolecule material molecular weight. What we have studied is very important to study macromolecule material rheological property and science of macromolecule material.

articleTitle: Error correction of theory model in process-stress accelerated test
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: To correct the error in theoretical model of process-stress accelerated test, a new calculation method is proposed. The new method, based on computer-aided calculation, can significantly reduce the error of the model. Theoretical data is calculated using both the novel model algorithm, which is the root test method, and the old model algorithm. The results show that the old model algorithm can generate errors more than 13% in the activation energy, and of errors more than 150% in the extrapolated lifetime(Q≤1.0eV), While the novel model algorithm generates errors in less than 1% in activation energy, and errors less than 4.1% in the extrapolated lifetime.

articleTitle: Image stitching for Airborne Staring LIDAR by vertical range-gated registration
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: A simulation process for Airborne Staring LIDAR is introduced. Factors are taken into account such as illumination distribution, shot noise, flying route and pose, and so on. Target intensity image is calculated firstly, and the range image is figured out by method of dual-gain modulation. Errors caused by slant will influence the image match for multi-frame average which is helpful for increasing S/N ratio. A vertical range-gated strategy for registration is proposed, which is able to correct such error and stitch up all range images seamlessly. Simulation Results with this method show a high accuracy in image stitching and good noise immunity.

articleTitle: Surface enhanced Raman scattering analysis of Ag nanoparticles in different sizes synthesized by NaBH4 induced nucleation method
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: This work is based on experiment setup used to synthesize silver nanoparticles (NPs) with different sizes using NaBH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> induced nucleation method. Since Surface enhancement Raman scattering (SERS) has become one of the most highly sensitive technologies to study the interface effects, with relatively good selectivity and high sensitivity, and Ag has the best SERS effect that is used most commonly in present days, we have carried out SERS analysis of Ag NPs and then the data has been compared and analyzed for different sizes in this study. Finally, it has been found that the surface-enhanced Raman scattering (SERS) intensity is higher for Ag nanoparticles that can be produced by the lower concentration of NaBH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> during the synthesis process.

articleTitle: Rough sets based on concept lattice method of filling the system risk assessment
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Filling system risk evaluation model, based on rough set of concept lattice, was produced. The corresponding relation of rough set equivalence and concept lattice extension was studied. Based on the dependence relation of the filling system risk sources, risk sources were chosen, which can reduced the size of the concept lattice. Minimum regulation set was picked up from plenty of filling system example data, with this the filling system risk evaluation was evaluated. Besides, the arithmetic in the paper was compared with classic Godin arithmetic experimentally, and the results showed, the rising range of dissipative time was small. Thus, space-time performance can be enhanced by using progressive implementation algorithm concept case arithmetic in filling risk evaluation model.

articleTitle: Barrier layer effect on photoelectric properties of MSM photodetectors based on black silicon
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: This paper focuses on the influence of barrier layer on photoelectric properties of MSM photodetectors based on black silicon. Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> barrier layers with different thickness were added between the black silicon layer and electrodes in the MSM structure by PECVD. According to the results, the thickness of barrier layer plays a crucial role in reducing the dark current and increasing the Signal Noise Rate(SNR) of the detector. In the end, we obtained an optimum thickness that could not only ensure a high SNR but also lead the photodetector to a great responsivity.

articleTitle: A method of blind source separation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The paper proposed the definition of signal energy change degrees and proved the properties of signal energy change degrees. Based on the new definition and properties, a blind source separation method has been proposed in this paper. The purpose of separated signal has been achieved by using the generalized eigenvalue theory of the matrices, setting the generalized eigenvalue of signal energy change degrees and solving the generalized eigenvalue of eigenvector. Experimental simulations show that the new method is valid, efficient, and easy to implement in practice.

articleTitle: Linear CCD data acquisition and storage in spatial object's exterior attitude measurement system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: It is important of data acquisition and storage in the spatial object's exterior attitude measurement system. A data acquisition and storage system of linear CCD (Charge Couple Devices) based on CPLD (Complex Programmable Logic Devices) and DSP is designed. Take the TCD1708D which is selected by the exterior attitude measurement system as an example, the principle of linear CCD driver is analyzed. And it is introduced that the implementation method to acquire and store the data of linear CCD with CPLD and DSP. Experimental results indicate the system is high reliability, flexible and general.

articleTitle: Study and application of magnetic bubble manufacturing equipment
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In this paper, we have discussed the manufacturing process of magnetic bubble device which including magnetic bubble storage and semiconductor integrated circuit manufacturing technology, especially the method about how to make magnetic bubble uropatagia. We have taken GGG uropatagia for example, and have studied garnet magnetic single crystal film's growing, evaporating, photoetching, flaking and assembling. By studying magnetic bubble's performance, we have discussed the application of magnetic bubble devices.

articleTitle: Highly efficient grating coupler between optical fiber and silicon-on-insulator waveguide
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In or der to increase the coupling efficiency between single mode optical fiber and SOI waveguide, in this paper we present the design of a diffractive grating structure and then get the optimal parameters which can reach 67% coupling efficiency though FDTD simulation. The grating is fabricated on the SOI waveguide by focused ion beam (FIB) lithography. Because side wall roughness caused by fabrication tolerances and extra losses finally we measured a 17.5% coupling efficiency of the grating coupler between optical fiber and silicon waveguide.

articleTitle: The sum of all distances and average distance on two kinds of trees
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: As an important direction of graph theory, the research on tree has been a greatly active branch according to its application, It has remarkable theoretic and applied value. And because of its diversity and flexibility many researchers have fall in it. In this paper we have calculated the sum of all distances and average distance on banana trees and firecrackers.

articleTitle: Focus shaping of tightly focused axially symmetric polarized beams by diffractive optical elements
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: We study the focus shaping of tightly focused axially-symmetric polarized beams by diffractive optical elements, introduce the basic theory of beam shaping and derive the mathematical expressions of focusing field in a high-NA focusing system. We further design two DOEs to achieve an optical chain and an optical distribution of multiple ultrasmall focused spots with a long depth of focus respectively, which may find wide applications in optical tweezers, optical storage, microscopy and so on.

articleTitle: Vibration data acquisition and analysis system based on aximatic design
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: This paper developed a vibration data acquisition and analysis system based on axiomatic design. Based on axiomatic design theory and the knowledge of traditional design theory, it firstly introduced the hardware structure of the system, then presented functions of the system software, which was mainly focusing on drawing method of signal time-domain waveforms. Finally, this system was tested by the signal generator and QPZZ-II rotating machinery fault test system. Experiment shows that this method not only meets the functional requirements of the system, but also ensures the independence between the functions. The program is clear and modularity, which has high portability and reusability.

articleTitle: Study on imaging simulation of telescopefor space target
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The imaging process of the telescope is studied through numeric simulation; the lay tracking modeling of this process is established through the lay tracking theory. Based on the linearity strain-wave theory, the MTF of every buildup unit in the imaging system is analyzed and presented; the MTF modeling is also established. Combining the lay tracking modeling and the MTF modeling, a physics modeling of the telescope for space target is established, the simulation flow is presented. the simulation model is studied and carried out, and the gray curve, theory MTF and the image is presented, which proved that the model is reasonable.

articleTitle: Application of ASEGMF in refinement of rotor center's orbit
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Aiming at the refinement of rotor center's orbit, a novel method was proposed based on the adaptive structure element for generalized morphological filtering (ASEGMF). At first, the sine structure element was selected, and the length scale and the height scale were defined according to the feature of vibration signal. Then, the peak interval and the peak height were defined by signal's local characteristic, and the length scale and the height scale of sine structure element were gotten by adaptive method. In the end, rotor center's orbit was refined by the generalized morphological filter cascaded by one small and one big adaptive structure elements. This method conquers the selective random of current morphological filter, the structure element are gotten adaptively by signal's local characteristic without artificial interference. Simulation and practical results show that this approach has better effectiveness in refinement of rotor ceter's orbit.

articleTitle: A numerical method for resistance extraction of conductors with patered cross section and random rough surface
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Interconnect play a crucial role in integrated circuit. As such, accurate interconnect modeling and characterization are key to the design and verification of integrated circuit. Copper (Cu) has became a mainstream material for interconnects and Cu interconnects are generally formed using the “dual damascene” process which cause the shape of line irregular. The paper analysis the impact of conductor surface roughness and the tapered line shape on the resistance of interconnects. In order to quantify these effects on the interconnect performance we develop the boundary elemental method (BEM) to calculate the frequency-dependent resistance. The results demonstrate that dimensions, RMS and the correlation length are important factors impacting on the variation of interconnect resistance.

articleTitle: Optimization of 4H-SiC separated-absorption-charge-multiplication (SACM) avalanche photodiode with low avalanche breakdown voltage
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: 4H-SiC avalanche photodiode with a separated absorption region, a charge adjustment region and a multiplication region is proposed and its optoelectronic performance is modeled. By properly designing the doping concentration of each layer, the avalanche breakdown voltage and photo-response of the device is found to be dependent of the thickness of the multiplication region. The avalanche breakdown voltage shows a minimum and the photo-response shows a maximum at certain thickness of the multiplication region. The results are explained by the electric field distribution of the device and the impact ionization theory.

articleTitle: Research on the peculiar flashover phenomenon of the PCSS in SF6
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Flashover severely restricts the development of the photoconductive semiconductor switch (PCSS) in high-voltage and high power. This paper reported the peculiar phenomenon that the current pulse, when the flashover occurred, was lower and wider than the normal value. Based on the photon-activated charge domain model and semiconductor flashover mechanism, the reason, the influence of secondary electron emission avalanche on the output wave, was analyzed. The dipole domain was imported to describe the critical state where the lower and wider current pulse occurred during the flashover.

articleTitle: Application of regularized least-squares algorithm in PET image reconstruction via a new anisotropic diffusion
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The traditional iterative reconstruction algorithms of positron emission tomography cannot effectively suppress the noise. In order to solve the problem, a new anisotropic diffusion term are introduced into the least-squares algorithm, and with median filter the regularized least-squares algorithm in PET image reconstruction based on anisotropic diffusion come into being. Results of computer simulated demonstrate that compared with the other classical reconstruction algorithms, LS_NewAD not only availably suppress the noise and reconstruct a higher quality image, but also Effectively retains the edge of the image edge structure.

articleTitle: Research on robustness of BP neural network based inverse model for induction Motor Drives
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Since the well design of inverse model is very important for inverse decoupling control of induction machine (IM) drives, the robustness of BP neutral network based inverse model is deeply researched by simulation experiments in the paper. First, the dynamic model for IM drives is constructed with the use of state space theory. Second, the inverse model for IM drives is set up by inverse system theory. However, the analytic inverse model is hardly applied in the engineering field since it excessively depends on the parameters. Third, an artificial neural network (ANN) based inverse model, which synthesizes artificial intelligent method and analytic method, is suggested in this paper. To accelerate the convergence speed of ANN and enhance its generalization ability, the nonlinear parts are realized by the analytic expressions and the corresponding results act as the inputs of ANN so that the complex-nonlinear mapping relation become a simple-linear mapping and the structure of ANN is simplified by the greatest extent. A three-layered feed-forward ANN with 12-10-2 structure is introduced to approach the inverse mode of IM drives. Lastly, the robustness of ANN based inverse model is verified by comparative experiments in the case of parameter variance.

articleTitle: Influence of optical axis orientation on the birefringence light in biaxial crystal
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Take advantage of index ellipsoid relevance of light travelling in crystal, the influences of optical axis on electric field strength E and electric displacement vector D when wave propagating in a dual-axis lens were analyzed. Then the relationship of wave vector direction and wave energy propagation direction with the orientation of optical axis of biaxial crystal were deduced. Selecting KTP biaxial crystals, using MATLAB software, the numerical calculation is running on the direction of propagation and the orientation of biaxial crystal. The numerical results is accordance with the experimental results.

articleTitle: Synthesis and Crystal Structure of 10-(4-nitrophenymethylidyne)-9,10-dihydrofluorene
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: A novel compound of 10-(4-nitrophenymethylidyne)-9,10- dihydrofluorene (C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">20</inf>H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">13</inf>NO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, Mr=299.31) was synthesized via Knoevenagel reaction in the resence of sodium hydroxide under solvent-free condition. The advantages of this procedure were mild reaction conditions, simple protocol, and high yield(93%). Its structure was determined IR, 1H NMR, MS, elemental analysis and X-ray diffraction. The crystal of the new compound is Orthorhombic, space group Pbca with a = 11.6269(10), b = 7.6792(6), c = 33.862(3) Å, = 90, = 90, = 90o, V= 3023.4(4) Å3, Z=8, Dc=1.315g/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>, µ=0.085 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>, F(000)=1248, R=0.0589 and wR = 0.1284 for 2751 observed reflection with I>2σ(I). π-π stacking interactions contribute to the stability of the structure.

articleTitle: Quantitative analysis technology in processing image output
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: People are always used to assuming that image color effect displayed on computer monitors is just the actual effect of the final output image from output devices. But in fact, all sorts of equipments we are using now describe and process different color with different color model such as Adobe RGB1998, CMYK, HSB or Lab, etc. Because these devices have their own unique color spaces, so they explain the values of HSB, RGB or CMYK according to their color spaces. How do general professional image output workers achieve the result that the image color effect displayed on monitors is close to or in accordance with the final output effect from output devices in the work? This paper discusses how to solve different color model transformation and locate the accurate position of color by using the configuration files of color management.

articleTitle: Study on beam energy and impact on communication quality in space optical communications
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The beam energy is one of the important factors that affect space optical communications. The beam energy has a direct effect on communication link distance, detector SNR, communication BER and other parameters. To test and verify the related technologies in the space optical communications, the paper proposes a near-earth demonstration and verification experiment systems of emission and detection to the near-space optical communications, which have wavelength of 810nm-band, optical output power of 250mW, modulation ratio of 500Mbps, and achieve to link distance of 8-10 km and communication BER better than 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-8</sup>; analyzes the effect of collimator, electro-optic modulators and optical antenna elements on the beam power loss, beam diameter, divergence angle and other parameters in the system. Theoretical analysis and experimental results are basically consistent; the conclusions have great value on further research of the near-space and deep-space optical communications.

articleTitle: Design and characteristic analysis of giant magnetoimpedance sensor in Fe-based nanocrystalline ribbons
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: A magnetic sensor based on giant magnetoimpedance effect (GMI) was developed. The basic element of the sensor is a Fe-based nanocrystalline ribbon of composition Fe73.5Cu1Nb3Si13.5B9. A sensitivity of 0.6691 V/Oe for the linear sensor was obtained, and the linear correlation coefficient reaches 0.9657 in the range of ±4.5 Oe.

articleTitle: Preparation of novel azo polyurethane with chiral atoms and its optical properties
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: A new azo polyurethane with chiral atoms was synthesized with 4-nitroaniline, sodium nitrite and S(-)-α-methylbenzylamine by diazo coupling reaction. The absorption spectrum of this novel azo polyurethane with chiral atoms was characterized by UV-Vis spectroscopy. The solubility was measured with different kinds of organic solution. And the thermal property was characterized by X-5 micro melting point apparatus, by which the melting point is 165°C. This result showed that the new azo polyurethane had excellent thermal stability. Mechanical properties of the novel polyurethane with chiral atoms, such as tensile strength and hardness, were also studied. The refractive index of the polymer waveguide thin film was detected by attenuated total reflection (ATR) method at different temperature, wavelength and mode of the incident light. The results showed that the refractive index of the material decreases with the temperature rising. Compared with inorganic materials, the new material has a bigger thermo-optic coefficient. At the same time, the dispersion coefficient was calculated by the Sellmeyer equation. The thermo-optical coefficients of the material for TM (transversal magnetic) and TE (transversal electric) modes were also studied and they are obviously different, which can be used to design and develop the novel thermo-optic switch and even all-optical switch in the future.

articleTitle: Three-dimensinal display with addressable focal plane using MEMS devices
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: A deformable membrane mirror is being used to generate multiple focal planes within a head mounted display. The MEMS deformable mirror changes the focal plane of the display by varying the wavefront of the optical beam entering the eye. Dynamically changing the focal plane will allow the viewer to see 3-D objects using the natural accommodative response of the eye, unlike current stereographics that rely on retinal disparity.

articleTitle: The study of job-shop scheduling problem of adaptive mind evolutionary computation algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: JSP is an complex problem in process. This paper brings up an adaptive mind evolutionary computation algorithm, which is based on the researched algorithm. The idea of this method is that useing adaptive convergence operation to adaptive adjustment evolution of the search range and precision. This method of operation can improve efficiency, enhance the direction of evolution, and improve the algorithm's search capabilities. The adaptive algorithm overcomes the prematurity and the poor results of average fitness and genetic algorithm. Simulation experiment results have shown the effectiveness of this algorithm.

articleTitle: Relation between ambient temperature and the output power of optical-contact crystal green lasers
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In this paper, from detailed experiment-based research on how ambient temperature influences the output power of optical-contact crystal green laser, it is showed that the output power of optical-contact crystal laser is directly affected by ambient temperature, and individual difference exists in the optical-contact crystals. The negative effect caused by low ambient temperature can be eliminated by temperature control sleeves. Most optical-contact crystal lasers work well at room temperature.

Author Keywords: output power of optical-contact crystal lasers

articleTitle: Thermal lens effects in the LD end-pump fundamental and self-Raman crystal laser
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Thermal lens effects in the LD end-pump fundamental and self-Raman crystal laser have been studied. The experiment of the pump beam waist position affect on the resonator stability was carried out. The results show that the resonator stability was sensitive to the pump beam waist position for the LD end-pump solid-state laser. Thermal focal length formulas for end-pump fundamental and self-Raman crystal laser were given out, in which both far-field half-angle and position of the pump beam waist in the active medium were considered.

articleTitle: A new method of COD testing with BP neural network
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: A new optical method of testing the chemical oxygen demand (COD) of wastewater with multi-wavelength at UV band is reported. The normal UV254 is based on the UV light absorption by wastewater at 254nm according to the Beer-Lambert law. But not all of the wastewater has obviously absorption at 254nm. The new method use back-propagation artificial neural network(BP network) to determine COD of the samples. After the BP network is training by a series wastewater's samples which have similar ingredient but different COD, the sample's absorbance at UV band(between 240~400nm) is analyzed, and the specific wavelength which is associative with sample's COD is picked out. These wavelength can be used to calculated the COD value, and the result is close to standard chemical method. Comparing with UV254, the new method is more stability and precise, and better adaptability to varied wastewater.

articleTitle: A Novel Switchable Dual-Wavelength Ring Erbium-Doped Fiber Laser Operating in single-longitudinal-mode
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In this paper, we demonstrate a simple switchable dual-wavelength ring erbium-doped fiber laser operating in single-longitudinal-mode (SLM) at room temperature. A pair of reflection type short-period fiber Bragg gratings (FBGs) is used as the wavelength-selective component of the laser. A segment of unpumped polarization maintaining erbium-doped fiber (PM-EDF) is acted as a narrow multiband filter. By turning the polarization controller (PC) to balance the gain and loss in the ring cavity, single-wavelength and dual-wavelength laser oscillations are observed. The output power variation is less than 0.6dB for both wavelengths over a five-minute period and the optical signal to noise (ONSR) is greater than 50dB.

articleTitle: Optimal switch for a class of system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: A class of system consists of the same creatures or the same model man-made machines, and the power consumption of this system only depends on the total efficiency and ideal power. The optimal switch method is given for this class of system.

articleTitle: Design of wavelength converter based on cross-phase modulation in high-nonlinear fibers
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In this paper, a wavelength converter based on cross-phase modulation (XPM) in the high-nonlinear fiber is designed. A theoretical model for wavelength conversion is established. How to choose nonlinear fiber length and input optical power is important for wavelength conversion, an expression is obtained after theoretical analysis. Also the performance of wavelength conversion is simulated and analyzed. The simulation results show that wavelength conversion based on XPM can be realized, and it has a good performance.

articleTitle: A new single crystal fiber preparation technology based on the method of LHPG
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Single crystal fiber, as a key component of high temperature sensor, has been widely applied in the fields of aerospace and military. The main growth parameters of single crystal fibers and their relationship are derivated and analysed in detail in this article. LHPG method abroad is introduced. Optical structures of LHPG method is simulated by Zemax software. At last, we put forward a new single crystal fiber preparation technology based on the method of LHPG and the optical simulation is operated. Through theoretical analysis and simulation results, we draw the conclusion that this technology can not only form the circular heat with variable length and more uniform temperature field in melting zone, but has the advantages of high thermal efficiency, the simple optical structure, and can be adjustment and realization. This work laid the foundation for exploring and growing single crystal fibers with higher melting point and higher-quality in the future.

articleTitle: Multi-channel and four-color laser induced fluorescence detection system and its application in DNA analysis equipment
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: A multi-channel and four-color fluorescence detection system was designed. It mainly consisted of a laser confocal scanning detection platform, an electrophoresis platform, an embedded control system and a data analysis processing system. A 16-channel capillary array, a scanning galvo and an f-θ lens were utilized to reach high-throughput capability. By switching filters and adjusting scanning speed, four-color function was achieved. The detection system was employed in a DNA experiment setup. Results indicate that the system is suitable for high-throughput DNA analysis equipment.

articleTitle: Influence of p-electrode on the characteristics of resonant-cavity light-emitting diodes
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The performance and characteristics of resonant-cavity light-emitting diodes (RCLEDs) are obviously affected by p-electrode shape, since the RCLEDs are lack of the current spreading layer. The oxide-confined RCLEDs with two types of p-electrode have been fabricated. By comparing characteristics of the two types of RCLEDs, the voltage at 20mA of the RCLED with single ring electrode is 0.5V greater than that with double rings. At 20mA, the light output power of the RCLEDs with the single ring electrode and the double ring electrode is respectively 1.228mW and 1.094mW. Light output power saturation rate of RCLED with the single ring is faster than that with the double rings. At low current, since the influence of heat effect on the device performance is not obvious and the single ring electrode has better light extraction for larger emitting area, the light output power of RCLED with the single ring is higher than that with the double rings. At high current, as the influence of heat effect is dominant as compared with light extraction and the single ring electrode has greater heat effect for smaller ohmic contact area, the light output power of RCLED with the single is lower than that with the double rings. The great heat generated affects the device reliability. In conclusion, RCLEDs with the single ring electrode has greater light output power at lowF injected current but worse device reliability for great heat effect.

articleTitle: Study on efficient algorithm of frequent item-set mining
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: To further improve the scalability of the algorithm for frequent item-set mining, studies on the frequent item-set search space and the FP-tree operation method were made. On this basis, an efficient algorithm for frequent item-set mining based on the a set of frequent-pattern list(FPL)is presented, which employs the strategy of incremental construction of a candidate itemset and Apriori property to reduce the searching space, and gets support-count of the frequent itemset by intersecting tid-list. Lastly the algorithm is realized on experiment and is proved to be valid.

articleTitle: Gold bonding reliability in high density FPGA devices
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
