abstract: The formation of intermetallic mass along the edge of the ball has been observed inherent to the gold bonded Aluminum pads. In a well-bonded sample, it occurs only near the edge of the ball resulting to still strong, reliable bonds after the parts have been exposed at a long duration to elevated temperature. Hence, the presence of intermetallic mass along the periphery of the ball is not an indication of unreliable bond.

articleTitle: Paper title temperature-independent surrounding refractive index sensing using a single weakly tilted fiber Bragg grating
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Using a single weakly tilted fiber Bragg grating in SMF, an optical fiber sensor capable of temperature-independent surrounding refractive index (SRI) was demonstrated. The experiment results showed that the “ghost mode” resonance and resonant Bragg wavelength have same temperature characteristics in the transmission spectrum. However, the width of high-order modes relatived to the wavelength change (Δw) which was immune to temperature could detect SRI range from 1.40 to 1.45 with a good linearity of SRI characteristic and correlative coefficient of 96.378%. These features of tilted Bragg gratings may possess prospects of application in biological and chemical fields‥

articleTitle: Effects of substrate temperature on structural and optical properties of S-doped ZnO films
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: S-doped ZnO films were fabricated on sapphire (0001) substrates by pulsed-laser deposition at different substrate temperatures. Effects of the substrate temperature on the structural and optical characteristic of S-ZnO films were studied by scanning electron microscopy (SEM), X-ray diffraction (XRD), UV-Vis spectrophotometer and fluorescence spectrometer. The results show that the S-doped ZnO thin films are wurtzite crystal structure. And the crystalline quality of S-doped ZnO films improves with increasing the substrate temperature from 400°C to 500°C. And the S/O ration is slowly decreased with substrate temperature elevation attributed to instability of S under the higher deposition temperature conditions. The absorption edges of S-doped ZnO thin films slightly shift blue as the substrate temperature increase from 400°C to 600°C. The photoluminescence (PL) spectra indicates that the visible emissions of S-doped ZnO films are enhanced, as well as the UV emission is weakened comparing to the pure ZnO thin film. It is illuminated that S-doping of ZnO can modify the optical properties of ZnO, which is promising for optoelectronic applications that work in the visible emission region.

articleTitle: Research on unwrapping of panoramic image and spatial coordinate transformation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: A panoramic image can be effectively and fast unwrapped without significant decrease in resolution of image details by using backward mapping and bilinear interpolation, with unwrapping taking 24ms, which satisfies the processing standard of 40 frames/s and can be applied in real-time monitoring systems. A transformation relationship between pixel and Pan-Tilt (PT) is also given by the pixel position in panoramic image and the angular transformation to PT of spatial imaging target. With coordinate transformation, we can control Pan-Tilt-Zoom (PTZ) camera to gaze the area which we concerned on in the panoramic image. The results indicate that the PTZ camera based on the location of the object in the panoramic image realizes automatic alignment and acquires image with small field of view to resolve details of the object.

articleTitle: Design of temperature control system of a heat exchanger at heating manifold based on host-guest architecture of double S7-200PLC
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: This article to a heater of the heating manifold to the heater for the use of Siemens double S7 - 200PLC host-guest architecture of the plc to solve external I/O terminals more problems and uses eview5000 the screen as a system of the upper and PID typed panel fulfilled the tune of four for a heat exchanger temperature control, with a manually controlled, the two ways to achieve the accuracy of its control book, system and low cost, friendly and control flexible.

articleTitle: Liquid-level sensor based on SMS fiber structure
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: This paper describes the design and implementation of a liquid-level sensor based on a single-mode-multimode-single-mode (SMS) fiber structure. The transmission spectrum of the SMS fiber structure is affected by the fraction of the length of the etched multimode fiber that is surrounded by the liquid. The numerical simulation of spectral transmission of SMS fiber structure with different liquid-level is proposed. The experiment shows that for a liquid-level variation of 4mm, the resonance wavelength generates a blue-shift about 4 nm. Meanwhile the optical power in the wavelength range from 1523 nm to 1534 nm is decreasing as the liquid-level increasing. Also in the linear region, high sensitivity of 1.02 nm/mm and 1 dB/mm are achieves, respectively.

articleTitle: The use of sliding time window in the real-time solution of ground-based GPS data
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: With the uses sliding time window to define the starting time and ending time of GPS data involved in the solution, the sliding time window makes the latest observed data added to the real-time data solution and raises efficiently the real-time property of the results of data analysis. Using time windows with fixed width, the ambiguity resolution accuracy can be guaranteed with the least occupation of computer resource. This paper, using the sliding time window and taking the example of data from 6 IGS stations in China, calculates parameters of troposphere of all these stations. Using the daily ZTD of the stations mentioned above that posted on the website of CODE as normal value, this paper calculates the standard deviation respectively and analyzes the influence exerted to the accuracy and real-time property of ZTD solution by time windows with different width. The operational system of “Ground Based GPS Real Time Water Vapor Retrieval” with the use of sliding time window can gain parameters of troposphere with high-accuracy and meanwhile meet the real-time demands of the operation. The best time window width is 6–8 hours.

articleTitle: Data acquisition system for NIR spectrometer based on DSP
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In order to realize the integration of measurement, scan control and analysis of spectrum in the portable Near-infrared spectrometer, the data acquisition system based on DSP TMS320F2812 has been developed. The components of system include the analog-to-digital conversion module, the grating scan driving module, the LCD display module, the external storage module and the keyboard control module. The software of system was built on Code Composer Studio with C program. The parameters of the system can be set and the commands can be sent using the keyboard. Then the stepper motor will be controlled to drive the grating to scan. At the same time, the analog-to-digital conversion module acquires the real-time spectrum data. And a low pass digital filter has been designed to reduce the noise of the data. The data will be shown as a spectrogram on LCD and saved in the NAND Flash.

articleTitle: Effects of strain and temperature change on the spectra of superstructure fiber gratings
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: For the superstructure fiber grating (SFG) consisting of a fiber Bragg grating (FBG) and a long period fiber grating (LPFG), a similarity transformation method for the coupled mode equations is presented, the effects of strain gradient and temperature gradient along the SFG on the transmission and reflection spectra of SFG have been investigated. The simulations show that the reflection spectrum and the transmission spectrum corresponding to v-order cladding mode will shift independently with the strain gradient or temperature gradient along the SFG according to a certain law.

articleTitle: A novel high-birefringence high nonlinear negative-dispersion crystal fiber with square mesh cladding
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: A novel photonic crystal fiber is proposed which is composed of a central defect core and a cladding with square mesh structure by introducing another air hole row between two air hole rows for every other line to a conventional rectangular lattice photonic crystal fiber. Its dispersion, birefringence, nonlinear and confinement loss are numerically investigated by full vector finite element method with anisotropic perfectly matched layers. And the novel PCF shows high birefringence high nonlinear negative dispersion effects which will be helpful to get admirable application in the field of polarization maintaining transmission system and dispersion compensation.

articleTitle: The experimental modal analysis of motorcycle structure
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Nature frequency is one of the most important dynamic characteristics of motorcycle structure. Detailed information has been acquired by the author using experimental modal analysis and mathematical modal analysis. According to the real situation, a simplified model was developed and constrains were loaded. With the aided of computer, a group of experimental nature frequencies and modal shapes were acquired. Meanwhile, a mathematical calculating was carried on by the ANSYS 9.0. Comparing the two groups of results indicates that: the simplified model of the motorcycle structure is reasonable and constrains applied to it are effective.

articleTitle: A study of EM backscattering of a target over two-dimensional oceanic surface based on a high frequency hybrid method
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: This paper studies backscattering properties of a target over a two-dimensional oceanic surface in high frequency. The backscattering radar cross section (RCS) of the oceanic surface is calculated by the Kirchhoff approximation (KA). The backscattered RCS of the target is computed based on the physical optics (PO) and taking the edge diffraction into account. In addition, the ray tracing method (RT) is used to simulate the coupling effect between the oceanic surface and target. The numerical results of the composite backscattering RCS from a schnabelia station above a two-dimensional oceanic surface are in good agreement with the experiment data.

articleTitle: The display and power attenuation control of bi-directional amplifier
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: BDA is developed to expand the scope of wireless devices especially among long-distance application. According to the need of different systems, BDA output requirements are also various. The output request of BDA is 0.5w in this issue. In order to achieve the design specifications, PIC16f88 chip is selected to constitute an AGC amplifier circuit of BDA. The process of automatic input level detection and automatic gain control of the export are written by MPLAB IDE software. Meanwhile, in order to meet concrete input signal requirements through the working condition of attenuation. IM4A5 chip is picked up to constitute the circuit of display. Software Quartus II is used to compile the procedures of displaying attenuation. It displays the change cases of attenuation that exported by SCM. It is suggested in this experiment that the design can meet the requirements of 0.5w output power by bi-directional amplifier in a certain range and display the value of attenuation.

articleTitle: The research on DNA multiple sequence alignment based on adaptive immune genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Sequence alignment is foundation of bioinformatics, and multiple sequence alignment is still one of challenging research problems in bioinformatics currently. In this paper, an immune adaptive genetic algorithm has been presented to solve multiple sequence alignment. In order to maintains diversity of individual in population and expedites convergence speed of algorithm, this method change crossover probability and mutation probability based on variety of population. Besides adopt superior strategy when selecting immune operator, that it is introduced into adaptive genetic algorithm, which accelerate performance of individual. This method generates better result by testing, which is proved to be feasible.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: On the aesthetic teaching of ancient poems in primary school
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Researches on low frequency source location based on partially adaptive subarray focused beamformer under finite sample-support
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: We introduce a partially adaptive subarray focused beamformer for measuring the distribution image of ship's noise sources in a reduced-dimensional space. When only a small number of snapshots is available for estimating the spatial correlation matrix, reduced-rank solutions provide high performance to common methods. We study the detection performance of the partially adaptive subarray detector compared with the full array detector and a reduced-rank method called Krylov subspace. It is demonstrated, via simulation, that the minimum-variance, partially adaptive subarrays beamformer is a solid approach in small snapshots, low signal-to-noise (SNR) situations. In addition, data of a fiber optic hydrophone array experiment has been used to validate the method.

articleTitle: Ab initio study of electronic properties of BxIn1−xP alloys
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Using first-principles calculations in the generalized gradient approximation (GGA), electronic properties of zinc-blende BP and B<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub>In<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1-x</sub>P were studied by CASTEP simulation program. The conduction-band sequence for BP at G point in Brillouin zone(BZ) is p-like Γ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">15c</sub> and s-like Γ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1c</sub> in magnitude sequence, the conduction band minimum (CBM) is along the Δ line between the Γ and X points-at approximately 0.8(1,0,0)2 π/a. Using 32-atom special quasirandom structure (SQS16) to model a random alloy, in the boron concentration of 0-18.75% range for B<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub>In<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1-x</sub>P alloys, a large (6.5eV) and relatively composition-independent direct-gap bowing parameter is obtained, small addition of boron to InP will raise the direct-gap, the average increment in this range is about 12meV/%B.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The discussion of using an analogy way to achieve physical teaching effectively
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Absorption spectroscopy about area nocuous gas explorer
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Article dissertates the basic theory that how absorption spectroscopy is used in the long-distance nocuous gas intrusion exploration. It discusses about the technology of differential optical absorption spectroscopy (DOAS). It is put forward the actualization method of the nocuous gas detection in the long-distance area. It is introduced how the atmospheric trace intrusion gas is detected with the beam of wide spectrum light, a series of optical apparatus and DOAS computing. Also, the potential technologies and instrument in the future are prospected.

articleTitle: Research on the collaborative development of enterprise informationization and enterprise culture
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The 21st century is the era of information economy, enterprise informationization is the route that the modern enterprises must take. However, many of our businesses invested in a lot of money?human and material resources, but the harvest is very small, which can't enhance the competitiveness of enterprises. One important reason is that enterprises lack of or ignore the construction and implementation of enterprise culture which matching informationization. Through deep research on the relationship between enterprise informationization and enterprise culture, this paper argues that not only needs the business leaders to attach importance to and personally involved in the building of enterprise culture, but also need to strengthen the training on staff's change and innovation awareness, creating a good atmosphere to accelerate the integration of the two, so as to achieve coordinated development between them.

articleTitle: Wave beam control design for VM-based Phased Array Antenna
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: A low complexity wave beam control system for VM-based Phased Array Antenna was presented, which is capable of realizing real-time wide angle scanning. To decrease interface No. 2-stage layered system were adopted, all the necessary control data were generated in main board, then these datum were transmitted into several sub-board via high-speed Link bus, and further distributed into each antenna T/R component. Whole system processing core is Stratix II EP2S30 FPGA of Altera Corp. Maximum frequency achieved 168.56 MHz, while for current design, 80MHz work clock frequency is sufficient to attain real-time wave beam control, about 9334 ALUTs were employed in main board FPGA. Sub-board only completed data distributing via simple CPLD. This system has been verified on certain radar platform, so that proved its reliability and validity.

articleTitle: The simulation analysis of response about electronic module caused by Electromagnetic Pulse disturbance
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: To study the effects of a typical circuit under Electromagnetic Pulse (EMP) interference and research the methods of susceptibility forecasting with system identification theory. A base unit circuit is chose to simulation with circuit simulation software PSPICE. The input interference changed, the output pulse response is also different. According to system identification theory, a set of energy coupling circuit model established by input and output data. By changing the parameters of interference voltage, compare the fitting of model output and output of simulation experiments. The applicability of the model is tested by arbitrary interference. The results show that the peak and the trend of model output waveform can approximate the actual output; the larger magnitude of the parameters changes, the lower the fit. To a certain extent, this approach reflect the sensitivity of the circuit to the pulse interference, which lay the foundation to explore new method for predicting sensitivity of the circuit electromagnetic pulse effect.

articleTitle: Research and design of remote control system based on Web service
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: With the wide application of remote control technology in network, remote control became a popular technology. For this kind of application of network, it brings convenience to the equipment management, proposes a Web Service based remote control technology, and combines technologies such as WSE and MQ together to realize a remote control platform, which boasts of flexible operation and setup.

articleTitle: Calculation and simulation of the bending deformation of multilayer thin films microcantilever integrated with the microplasma reactor
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In order to realize maskless etching with the high resolution and high efficiency, a novel cantilever-based microplasma etching method is proposed in our previous work. The cantilever probe integrated with microplasma reactor is the multilayer structure. In the fabrication process of cantilever, the residue stress in multilayer thin films may cause undesirable bending of cantilever. This paper establishes the thermal stress calculation formula for the multilayer thin films microstructure and gets the relation between the cantilever deflection and internal stress. The stress in each film is experimentally measured. The deflection of cantilever is calculated by theoretical formula and simulated by ANSYS software as well. The accuracy error of the calculated and simulation is within 5%. It proves that the model has good practicability and provides a theoretical basis for controlling the deflection of multilayer thin films microcantilever and structural optimization.

articleTitle: A novel interferometric fiber-optic magnetometer with double digital closed-loop detection scheme
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: A novel interferometric fiber-optic magnetometer with double digital closed-loop detection scheme is presented in this paper. The particular design of optical circuit is performed to the conventional Michelson interferometer based fiber-optic magnetometer. The digital correlation detection technique with double closed-loop is applied to demodulate the weak magnetic field. One digital closed-loop with square-wave phase modulation is realized to eliminate the low-frequency environmental phase drift. The other is utilized to suppress the hysteresis effects of the magnetostrictive material and recover the magnetic field to be measured. Simulation results on the digital closed-loop algorithms verify the feasibility of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Surface-enhanced Raman scattering of 4-dimethylaminoazobenzene on copper surface
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In this paper, surface-enhanced Raman spectrum of 4-Dimethylaminoazobenzene adsorbed on the copper surface was investigated. The normal Raman and surface-enhanced Raman peaks were assigned according to some reports. Based on the spectra analysis, the adsorption of DAB molecule on copper surface is proposed.

articleTitle: Testing technology for explosively formed projectile based on parallel screens
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: With the development of shaped explosive warheads, a new molding process has been put forward by the EFP. This design uses laser parallel screens as a test method. The paper describes the basic composition of laser parallel screens. The Fresnel lens and the test system are also discussed in detail. Explosively formed penetrator test has been the target shape and speed, and has achieved satisfactory results.

articleTitle: A lip reading method based on 3-D DCT and 3-D HMM
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Lip reading aims at recognizing what human says by analyzing visual speech information, such as lip movement. This technique is used to improve the recognition rate under the noise environment. Now, more lip feature extracting methods are developed, most of which are sensitive to lip positioning. To extract the features using Hidden Markov Model can be avoided such defect. Lip movement videos have 3-D structure. Therefore, we extend Hidden Markov Models to 3-dimensional space, construct a lip movement model using it. In order to consider lip dynamic features, we extract the feature vectors using 3-D Discrete Cosine Transform. 3-D DCT and 3-D HMM based lip reading method has following advantages: It can consider dynamic features of the lip movement. It can be robust on rotation, parallel shift and variant scaling. We tested its performance on VidTIMIT database compared with Pseudo 3-D HMM based method. Our method can increase the recognition rate about 2∼3% against P3-D HMM based method.

articleTitle: Analysis and discussion on impact shear experiment technique of composite laminate
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In this paper, aiming at the material properties and application characteristics of the composite laminates, the experimental technology of the impact shear dynamic mechanical properties of the “bar-tube” has been optimized based on technical analysis for impact shear test of HOPKINSON bar. And the problems of experimental technology, such as beating of input bar, difficulties in coaxial adjustment, large dispersion in results and so on, have been solved. According to the matching analysis among input bar, output tube and composite material samples, the constraint conditions of size among input bar, samples and output tube has been established. The influence law of the preset shear clearance to impact shear has been researched via the numerical analysis of finite element. The impact shear data of composite laminates reinforced by glass fiber indicates that the loading rate obviously influences on the mechanical properties of dynamic shear.

articleTitle: Analysis of internal and near-surface fields characteristics for plane wave from a chiral dielectric sphere
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Based on the spherical vector wave functions, we research the internal and near-surface fields of a homogeneous chiral dielectric sphere to a plane wave. The expansion coefficients of scattered fields and internal fields are obtained through the boundary condition at the sphere interface. The logarithmic derivatives of Ricatti-Bessel functions are introduced in order to avoid the numerical overflow of high-order terms or larger argument spherical Bessel function and the problem of the accumulative error in the matrix calculation when calculate the internal and scattering coefficients. Thus, the internal and near-surface fields of a homogeneous chiral dielectric sphere can be studied numerically.

articleTitle: Non-fragile robust H∞ control for a class of switched uncertain singular systems with uncertainties
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: This paper deals with the problem of robust H∞ control for uncertain switched singular systems. The problem we address is the design of a state feedback non-fragile robust H∞ controller, such that the resulting closed-loop system are not only robust but also satisfy H∞ performance, moreover, also satisfy proper performance when controller changes. and thus have better adaptability against variety of the environment parameters. Based on a proper Lyapunov function and strict linear matrix inequality (LMI) approach, A sufficient condition for the solvability of the non-fragile robust H∞ control via state feedback was proved and presented. Finally, a numerical example is given to demonstrate the applicability of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Surface modification and subsequent silver soating onto sanoscale calcium carbonate for antibacterial sabrication
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Calcium carbonate nanopowder is an important engineering material used for various painting and polymer-based composite additive and filler. The hydrophobic modification on surface of calcium carbonate nanopowder was performed by using three silane coupling agents: 3-aminopropyl triethoxysilane (APTES), 3-mercapto-propyl triethoxysilane (MPTES) and 3-Trimethoxysilyl-propyl-methacrylate (KH570). The Fourier Transform Infrared Spectrometry (FT-IR) was used to confirm the surface chemical coupling variations. The contact angle meter was used to determine its hydrophobic property. After KH570 modification, the sample of nanopowder showed the best hydrophobic property with a contact angle of 107°. The findings are of significance to enhance nano-calcium carbonate dispersibility and compatibility in organic media.

articleTitle: Optimization and fabrication of the photonic crystals for large absolute band gaps
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In the paper, Optimization algorithm is used to design two-dimensional photonic crystals for large absolute band gaps. By optimizing the location and radius of rods in the unit cell, we present tree designs considering different shape rods. The genetic algorithm finally yielded a photonic crystal with an absolute common band gap of 0.0796(2πc/a) at the mid-frequency of 0.3712(2πc/a). The result have been fabricated using e-beam lithography (EBL) and inductively coupled plasma (ICP). We can find a large absolute band gap can be obtained.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Implement of private enterprises' flexible absorbing talent strategy
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Design of plant growth status analyzer based on photoelectric technology
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: This paper presents a plant growth status analyzer based on photoelectric technology. The analyzer obtains the status of plant growth by analyzing the variation of chlorophyll content in leaves. The device makes the quantitative description of the chlorophyll content in leaves by comparing the change in intensity of the two light beams at 650 nm and 940 nm respectively. The hardware of the device is designed in modules with independent functions, including data acquisition, data communication, LCD display, temperature detection, real-time display and so on. The analyzer is also equipped with a miniature thermal printer in order to output the data immediately, so that the design is more practical. This design does no damage to the leaves during the whole progress. The device adopts common chips in the market at a relatively low price, so that it can be easy to spread in research or agriculture.

articleTitle: For village residential architectural layout the influence of energy saving in heating
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: With China's economic development and the people's living standard is increasing day by day, Especially in the countryside, the requirement to the living environment is enhances unceasingly. Cause such as heating and other environmental regulation system of energy consumption is becoming more than anyother time. So, Enhancing the efficiency of energy utilization, become a urgent problems. This paper is mainly discussed influence heating efficiency villages inhabited zone to be a key factor- the architectural layout, Hopefully through the architectural layout rationalization improve heating efficiency in order to achieve the purpose of saving energy.

articleTitle: Design of visible, infrared dual-channel optical system for space target detection
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: This paper designs a total of 250mm dual-channel optical system, including visible (0.5µm∼0.8µm), infrared (3µm∼5µm). The main system is a three-reflection system, and the primary mirror is designed as the first and the third reflecting surface with different figuring. The cooling infrared detector was choiced in infrared channel and achieves 100% cool shield efficiency of luminescence through the second imaging. The main benefits of this design are the large corrected and unvignetted FOV, an easily baffling of stray light, small encumbrance and an easy handing.

articleTitle: Observability analysis of four-position alignment for laser gyroscope strap-down inertial navigation system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In this paper, A laser gyroscope strap-down inertial navigation system (SDINS) error model with 12 system state parameters is derived, and the observability of SDINS is discussed by observability analysis of piece-wise constant system (PWCS) and observable degree analysis method based on the singular value decomposition (SVD). It is demonstrated that four-position alignment can make the system completely observable, and all the system state parameters can be estimated by Kalman filter. The simulation indicates the efficiency of the analysis results.

articleTitle: Nonlinear infrared transmission through and reflection off antiferromagnetic films under magnetic field
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: We present the nonlinear infrared transmission through and reflection off an antiferromagnetic film under the magnetic field. In the geometry with the anisotropy axis parallel to the film surface and normal to the plane, using TE wave obliquely incident upon the film, we find that the nonlinear modification for the transmission and reflection is very obvious, especially for the large incident angle.

articleTitle: Research of electronic medical record data mining method based on variable precision rough set
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: With the appearance of electronic medical records(E_MRs), it is possible to acquire and retrieve the medical and diag_nosis information. A variable precision rough set(VPRS)-based approach for electronic medical record data mining is proposed in this paper, the method overcomes the limitation of rough sets, inducting error accuracy to the model, improving fault tolerance. Finally the data mining experiment of electronic medical record is designed, the result shows that it is better to assist doctor to clinical diagnosis and treatment.

articleTitle: Ecological car design based on CAD technology
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Rapid development of automotive science and technology, promoting economic growth rapidly and improving human travel conditions greatly, led to serious ecological imbalance and environmental crisis. Such as oil resource depletion, urban traffic congestion, vehicle emissions, vehicles Garbage and so on. Thus, the current auto industry is becoming increasingly important for sustainable development. Concepts, such as eco-car, eco-car design, green manufacturing and technology, and ecological automobile industry chain, come into being. Ecological car design and manufacture will play a key role in building a sustainable home for human being. Eco-car and ecological vehicles (service) will become the leading product which will be liked by consumer in the future. As the primary design and manufacture methods of information era, CAD (computer aided design) technology will provide a reasonable efficient solution for ecological car design. Therefore, ecological car design based on CAD technology is not only the need for car companies to improve their product competitiveness, but also the need for sustainable development of post-industrial society and human society.

articleTitle: Application of fuzzy predictive control in adding medicament of water treatment
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The adding medicament control of water treatment is an important step of the whole precess of generating power in a thermal power plant. In the light of the limitation of the conventional Smith predictive control, the fuzzy set theory is introduced in this paper to keep the PH value of the circulating water in a predetermined range by regulating the amount of adding acid. In the end, an illustrative example of is presented to verify the effectiveness of the proposed intelligent control scheme.

articleTitle: Study on the measurement of the deformation of solid material in infrared radiation imaging
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Based on the thermodynamics and plastoelasticity, mechanics of the infrared radiation of solid material was investigated and theoretical explanation was given. The constitutive relation between temperature and principal strains was obtained. According to the theory we simulated the infrared radiation temperature field of the solid material subjected to external loading. Calculation results were in good agreement with experimental results, which verifying the validity of the theory and the feasibility of the measurement of deformation using infrared radiation imaging.

articleTitle: Velocity measurement of warhead fragments of parallel net target
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Current measurement method of warhead fragments velocity has some problems. Therefore, a new measurement method based on parallel net target is proposed. This test system consists of resistance, metal wire, circuit boards, frame and data acquisition display device component. The design of resistance nets is the core of this device. Each unit is connected by a resistor in series with a metal wire, number of these units parallel form resistance network. When the fragments fly through the parallel net target, the oscilloscope records the time and the voltage difference at which every fragment flies through the screen. According to the acquired waveform and the parallel net target parameters, the velocity vector and size of every fragment are calculated, and then the velocity vector of the fragments can be calculated accurately, which is helpful for calculating the accurate initial velocity and the attenuation coefficient of warhead fragments. This method is verified to satisfy the request of bullet velocity measurement.

articleTitle: Er3+/Yb3+ co-doped optical fibers: Fabrication and characteristics
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: A kind of single cladding highly Er<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>/Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> co-doped silica optical fiber (EYDF) for optical communications is fabricated using the new MCVD process. A highly quality soot phosphosilicate layer is deposited and the high absorption fiber is fabricated by using the appropriate temperature and doping phosphorus technique. The absorption ratio of the single cladding EYDF is as high as 588.8 dB/m at 976 nm, which is much higher than that of Er<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> doped fiber (EDF). The background loss is less than 0.1dB/m at 1200nm.

articleTitle: Testing techniques of fiber array projectile movement parameters based on highspeed CMOS camera
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: This paper introduces a plane array with single high-speed CMOS camera motion parameters for the collection of projectile testing technology. The system employs linear laser, Fresnel lens and optical fiber array to form the Optical structure. It uses a single high-speed CMOS area array camera and special data image processing software to collect and calculate image motion parameters. The paper describes in detail the testing techniques for projectile motion parameters - speed and coordinate measuring principle and the optical system, and the way getting the projectile to the image acquisition speed and over the target coordinates from the optical fiber array structure and image processing algorithms on a careful analysis and design. The proposed testing techniques and applications, not only over the target coordinates for the projectile to provide a reliable test methods and theoretical basis, but also solve the projectile velocity measurement. Due to changes in the projectile trajectory leave the actual target distance and target distance bias theory error caused by measurement. Further it improves the measurement accuracy of the projectile motion parameters. To improve the performance of weapons system, it provides important theoretical and practical research basis.

Author Keywords: the measurement of speed and coordinate

articleTitle: Camera surveillance system based on image recognition
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: This paper introduces a computer and camera-based intelligent monitoring system, achieving real-time site monitoring, intelligence. In the case of low-cost, relying on image recognition, the system begin to record when an intruder, and the record is to stop after the invasion, you can save a lot of storage space. And the system does not depend on the camera driver, suitable for any camera.

articleTitle: Simulation of a collimated Gaussian-beam propagating through an atmospheric turbulence
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: A Split-step method based on scalar Fresnel diffraction theory is used to emulate a collimated Gaussian-beam propagating through the Kolmogorov turbulent atmosphere in this paper. We acquire the distribution of irradiance and phase on the receiver aperture through choosing accurate simulation parameters. At last, the accuracy of simulation is verified through comparing the coherence factor of simulated beam field with that of theoretical field.

articleTitle: Parameter analysis of hot plate based on uniform design
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In lithography process, wafers need to be baked on the hot plate. There are very high requirement to the temperature uniformity of hot plate surface. To the problem of choosing design parameters, the uniform design method and the simulation software ANSYS were used, the design parameters were analyzed on the various conditions. Then a regression model was obtained by dealing with these simulation data in quadratic regression. Test proven that the calculation result of the regression model is highly consistent with the result of simulation. So, the obtained regression model can be useful to choose the design parameters, it has practical value in the engineering.

articleTitle: The application of the high performance DWT in the digital image saves
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: A kind of low memory DWT structure is proposed in the digital image storage by analyzing the principle of Discrete Wavelet Transform(DWT), the code block strip of wavelet transform is adapt in storage scheme, the code block strip of storage can been reused and effectively scheduled, which makes transformed image more advantage in compression efficiency and obtained image quality.

articleTitle: New method to measure the surface deformation of optics irradiated by high-power laser and new way to stimulate its influence on beam quality
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: A new method was proposed to measure the surface deformation, where the optics is irradiated by a high power laser when they are measured with ZYGO interferometer. The fiber with output shaper was used to transmit the laser. With this simple and convenient method, measuring k9, fused silica and antireflection coated silica windows, where a power of 200W doubled YAG laser was used. Also a new way was proposed to simulate the influence of the deformation on beam quality with the way of substituting normalized Zernike polynomial coefficients of all optics measured by former method into Zemax software. The results preferably reveal the beam transmission distortion by thermal deformation of optics on true application conditions.

articleTitle: Flat broadband birefringent retardation of the zero-order quarter-wave plates made from multi-birefringent materials
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: We present a theoretical model in order for flat broadband birefringent phase retardation (BPR) of the zero-order quarter-wave plates made from multi-birefringent materials by eliminating high-order wavelength-dependent BPRs. The BPR dispersions of the plates decrease monotonously when the wavelength moves close to a selected wavelength, so the plates are very suitable for controlling the polarization of the broadband light pulses which gather most of the light energy around the central. The criterion to choose material and the flexibility of the model are discussed.

articleTitle: Research regarding a measurement of corneal curvature based on image processing
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: An experiment instrument measuring corneal curvature parameters automatically was designed based on the principle of corneal reflected imaging in this research. The method is that to project three concentric circles to eye cornea, then catoptrics imaging through cornea on CCD, Binary imaging processing calculating by general threshold method, and select Binary image from key zone characteristics, detect the outline of ellipse circle by Sobel edge extracting method, and then obtain key region skeleton through boundary smoothing and Skeleton extraction method of mathematical morphology, finally calculate the curvature parameter by least squares fit curve. It experiments by measurement standard device for keratometer. The experiment results show that the tritus full-automatic corneal curvature device complies with the national metrology verification regulations. It is convenient, fast, accurate that measuring corneal curvature parameters by full-automatic corneal curvature device.

articleTitle: The alarm system of elder tumble at the geracomium based on ZigBee
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: This article present the alarm system of elder tumble based on ZigBee wireless sensor network technology. This core of system is MMA7260+CC2430 which is wireless RF module of three-axis accelerometer, we design it into a wearable node which collect the signal of tumble. The GPS positioning module, tumble signal and tumble location information is sent to the monitor station through the wireless network node. The system can rapidly and promptly help elder stand up, it protect the elder from long lying and have them stand away from life risk.

articleTitle: Model analysis and local stability research of synchronous structure of the fuel tank and steel wire rope in multi-stage telescopic boom
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In this paper, we improved the standard algorithm for telescopic boom by finite element method. The structure vibration stability of telescopic boom is obtained through model analysis, and then by comparison and analysis, the precise model was established. Thus through an example, we have tested and verified the characteristics of the telescopic boom that is easy to contended, and we found the location where the boom get its maximum vibration displacement. We have also established a rational mechanical model that take the local stability of steel cable system into account. Further more, we compared it with the output obtained by crane standard, and got that the dangerous cross-section chosen according to standard algorithm is not accurate. Because under the action of Wire rope pulley systems, the local stability of box structure has improved, so the algorithm recommended by crane design standard is safe but conservative.

articleTitle: Applied research on quantum particle swarm algorithm in autogenerating test paper
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In view of the low efficiency problem of extensively used genetic algorithm in large amount test code algorithm, this paper uses quantum particle swarm algorithm method to solve integer programming. Setting proper parameters and limiting the type and scope of particle position formula, this algorithm can solve large amount test code autogenerating problems. Experiments applying this algorithm have testified that it has stronger optimal ability and speed and better feasibility.

articleTitle: The simulation of penetrating distance algorithm based on DSP
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In order to obtain the real-time projectile penetration distance, to enable it to detonate at the predetermined depth, the study of the hardware control system for algorithm of penetration distance is conducted. Based on analyses and studies of penetrating distance algorithm, first use the ANSYS/LS-DYNA software to simulate to get the acceleration signals of projectile penetrating vertically into concrete targets, transform the simulation acceleration signals into emulation acceleration signals, then input the emulation acceleration signals into the designed DSP hardware control system, and then use hardware to simulate the penetrating distance algorithm. The results show that the calculated error is within the range of allowable error, the system also fully meets the real-time requirements, so the design of this hardware control system is reliable.

articleTitle: Single polarization output of erbium-doped DFB fiber laser by self-injection locking
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: A simple self-injection locking (SIL) configuration of DFB fiber laser is presented, which is composed of an optical circulator, a isolator and a polarization controller. By injecting the feedback laser into the DFB fiber laser, it can realize the stable single-polarization lasing with a degree of polarization larger than 0.98. And a high resolution phase-shift fiber grating transmission spectrum, output power, and optical spectrum characteristics of the laser are also measured. The results have potential application in optical communication and high sensitive fiber sensors.

articleTitle: Study on the content of active matter and inoxidizality of polygonum flaccidum meisn
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Traditional Chinese herbal medicine, polygonum flaccidum meisn, had a favourable development prospect on pesticide, medicine, veterinary drug and food additives. It was necessary to provide the theory evidence to make use of the valuable plant resources reasonably, promote the comprehensive development and utilization, and comprehend the content of active chemical composition and inoxidizality. In this paper, the active matter, naphtha, the content of polysaccharide and inoxidizality of polygonum flaccidum meisn were addressed. The experimental results show that the content of naphtha is 2.46 percent in fresh polygonum flaccidum meisn and the content of polysaccharide is 18.11 percent in dry one. The naphtha and the polysaccharide are able to remove the hydroxylradicals and superoxide anion radicals and the former works better the latter. Both perform worse than positive reference VC on inoxidizality. So we can draw a conclusion that polygonum flaccidum mesin is an efficient natural antioxidant and will be used on medicalhealthcare, medicine, industry of fine chemicals and agriculture widely.

articleTitle: The characteristics of ZnxCd1−xO films prepared by RF magnetron sputtering from powder targets
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Transparent conductive zinc and cadmium oxide films were prepared under closed-field unbalanced magnetron by RF from the targets, mixed by zinc oxide and cadmium oxide powder. The influences of Zn:Cd ratios on the structures and properties of the films were investigated. The compositions, morphological structures, crystallinity, optical and electrical properties of the films were analyzed using a range of techniques, including scanning electron microscopy, X-ray diffraction, Hall Effect Measurement and spectrophotometry. The morphological structure of the coatings changed from hexahedron to tetrahedron, the preferred orientations from ZnO (002), to mixed ZnO (002) + CdO (111), and to CdO (200) as the ratio of the cadmium in the films increased. The average transmittances within the visible wavelength varied from 40% to 90% as the ratio of the zinc in the films increased. The lowest resistivity of the film was 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−40</sup>cm, the concentration of charge carriers within 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">20</sup>, the mobility over 100cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/Vs.

articleTitle: Optimization and design of reference voltage for capacitive microaccelerometer
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: We develop the reference voltage for readout circuit of the capacitive microaccelerometer, and propose a novel optimization method for the reference voltage to ensure the stability of accelerometer. The optimal value of 1 V can be obtained by the optimization analysis. The reference circuit is implemented and verified using TSMC 0.35 µm CMOS process. Simulation results indicate that the circuit has a temperature coefficient of 7.54 ppm/°C from −25°C to 125°C. By analyzing the error sources of the proposed reference circuit, we find that the circuit inaccuracy is mainly caused by the offset-voltage of operational amplifier and the MOS mismatch, while the mismatch and tolerance of resistors have relatively smaller effect.

articleTitle: Application of the optical coupler in interference missile velocity measurement system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: It is necessary to test the speed of interference missile accurately. A diffuse reflection optical coupler velocity measurement system is introduced. The optical coupler is a sensor including an emitter and a receiver. When flying objects pass through the light emitter, the light is transformed by the receiver into electronic signal and sampled by data sampling card. Data-processing is finished by professional software in a computer. In this paper, the structure and principle of velocity measurement system, drive circuit of optical coupler is introduced. The response velocity of optical coupler is surveyed. It gives the typical sampled waveform and a series of speed data of interference missile measured. As a result, the velocity measurement method based on the optical coupler has advantages of convenience in optic adjustment and high sensitivity.

articleTitle: A new method of mineral particle size calculation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The grain size is an important quality index of granular materials. The accurate measurement of it has a guiding significance for technical performances and application of subsequent processing. There are many methods of Calculating mineral particle size, but it becomes relatively complicated because of the particles' irregular shape. The author proposed a new calculation method based on the vertical controlled, which can be get accurate size.

articleTitle: Study on a novel linear-cavity erbium-doped fiber laser using a 3 dB coupler as the reflecting mirror
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: A novel linear-cavity erbium-doped fiber laser is proposed and demonstrated. By using a 3 dB coupler as the reflecting mirror and an uniform fiber Bragg grating as the partial reflecting mirror and the wavelength selector, a stable laser output is obtained at room temperature. The full-width at half maximum, the side mode suppression ratio and the output power fluctuation are measured to be small than 0.014 nm, better than 40 dB and less than 0.43 dB, respectively. Furthermore, the lasing wavelength doses not drift in four hours.

articleTitle: The study of transmittance spectra of ZnO and indium doped ZnO films
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: ZnO and indium doped ZnO films were prepared by radio frequency magnetron sputtering under strong magnetic field. The structure and morphology of the films were measured by X-ray diffraction and SEM, and the transmittance spectra of the films were measured by a double-beam ultraviolet/visible/near infrared spectrophotometer in the range of 300–2400nm. It was found that ZnO and indium doped ZnO films are hexagonal wurtzite structure with c-axis perpendicular to the substrates. ZnO film shows a smooth surface with intense grains, while the surface of indium doped ZnO film is rough with loose grains. Both ZnO and indium doped ZnO show high transmittance in the visible range and exhibit sharp adsorption edge in the ultraviolet. The low transmittance of indium ZnO film in the infrared region is attributed to high carrier concentration in the films, which is different from ZnO film.

articleTitle: Relaxation spectrum of macromolecule which from experiment data
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: We have acquired the approximate method about how to get macromolecule's relaxation spectrum by means of experiment data. Depending on steady state stress relaxation experiment or dynamic shear experiment, we have gotten steady state relaxation modulus function G(t) or dynamic state modulus function G'(ω) and G"(ω). And then we have calculated all the approximate solutions of relaxation spectrum H(λ). Depending on the melt storage modulus G'(ω) data and power cost modulus G"(ω) data which from dynamic linear small swing shear oscillating experiment, we have calculated discrete relaxation spectrum in accordance with the approximate formulas which proposed by Schwarzl and staverman. At last, we also have discussed the affection of discrete relaxation spectrum which caused by some parameters and temperature.

articleTitle: The analysis and comparison of nitrite determinated methodsin meat product
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Nitrite is the common food additives in meat product, and they might induce bad impact on the human body. Therefore, the faster and more accurately of nitrite method is very important. In this study nitrite content used ultraviolet method of spectrophotometry, naphthyl ethylenediamine hydrochloride method and griess reagent colorimetric method, then three methods of repeatability, stability and recovery percent were compared. The results indicated that naphthyl ethylenediamine hydrochloride method showed good repeatability, remarkable stability and high recovery percent, so this method was the appropriate method when nitrite in meat product.

articleTitle: An improved control strategy for Doubly-fed Wind power Generation based on inverse system theory
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Vector control method is the common way in traditional Double-fed Wind Generation, but it is more dependent on motor parameters, once the operational situation changes, the effect of the system control will be affected. This paper proposes a control method based on inverse system, through the inverse system theory, the state equation of doubly-fed induction motor (DFIG) and power converter, to construct the structure of the DFIG wind power generation inverse control system. Finally, the corresponding wind power generation closed-loop control system is established. When the system operates in variable speed constant frequency (VSCF) and the phase voltage drops, the simulation results show that the control system can keep the DC link voltage steady, maintain unity power factor, achieve the decoupling of the active and reactive power. It proves that this control method used in VSCF wind power generation is feasible.

articleTitle: The design of Radio Frequency Identification system based on complex event processing
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In order to improve efficiency and accuracy of the Radio Frequency Identification system, a design of new system architecture is proposed, based on the complex event processing technology. This scheme introduces the layout of the system in detail, and through hardware simulation of real-time data collection, proves that this design is feasible.

articleTitle: The technique of camera scan control based on current loop control
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: As the crucial structure of aerial camera, sca reflector is always requested with high performance of control precision, stable running and rapid responding. The paper introduces a kind of method about current loop control system which is based on position and velocity dual-closed loop control system. This method improves effectively the performance of velocity closed loop control system and amplifies the gain of low frequency. The results show applying these control methods, the influence of the torque ripple has decrease 50% and the compensation rate precsion has promoted double.

articleTitle: An appraisal method of dynamic interpolation error for high precision encoder
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: This paper introduces an appraisal method of the dynamic interpolation error for the high precision encoder (Lissajou pattern calculation method). When the encoder is rolling, two groups of fine photoelectric signals whose phase difference are π/2 can be collected using data collected car. The shape and position deviation can be obtained through the comparison between Lissajou charts and the standard circle. Then dynamic interpolation error can be calculated out directly. This method is immune to the influence of encoder's speed and has no rigid demand to the test circumstances and test devices. The experimental results indicate that this method is feasible and important to the encoder's dynamic interpolation error checking.

articleTitle: A neoteric packeged structure to eliminate the spoiling effect from external environment
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: We proposed a novel dielectric silica packaged microsphere-taper coupling structure to protect the coupling system from damage and avoid the spoiling effects on the Q. Here, several factors such as water vapor and dust affecting the Q of optical microsphere cavities were analyzed theoretically and experimentally. Experiments demonstrated that the water vapor and dust around the microsphere cavity have great effects on the Q, which were mainly the optical absorption loss of water and scattering loss of dust. However, the packaged body isolated the microsphere-taper from the outside surroundings, and maintained the Q above 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup> for a long time. Therefore, it will greatly promote optical research from fundamental study to application research.

articleTitle: Simulation analysis of digital in-line holography for schistosoma cercariae detection
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The traditional focusing function and the experimental parameters in digital in-line holography for particle field detection is not suitable for schistosoma cercariae detection. The basic concept and procedure of digital in-line holography were shown mainly for schistosoma cercariae detection. A digital focusing method based on Laplacian operator was presented. The feasibility of schistosoma cercariae detection with digital in-line holography was confirmed through computer simulation. The results show Laplacian operator could be used as the automatic digital focusing function in digital holographic reconstruction. Furthermore, the range of recording distance was given by formula Δx·L/λ<z<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf><L<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/(160·λ) in digital in-line holography for schistosoma cercariae detection, and the best recording distance wasΔx·L/λ.

articleTitle: Cases of electromagnetic wave propagation in a complex medium
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The problem of how to differentiate between left-handed material and right-handed material has been analyzed in detail. The results show that the imaginary parts of permittivity and permeability will influence the sign of refractive index when the real parts of permittivity and permeability are opposite signs. Similarly, the real parts of permittivity and permeability will influence the variation of the amplitudes when the imaginary parts of permittivity and permeability are opposite signs. Therefore, it may has other choices to study the negative refraction except the double negative medium, and there should be some extra properties that can be related to the specific properties of the new materials.

articleTitle: Instabilities for quantum-cascade lasers under self-phase modulation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Theoretical analysis of lasing instability in quantum-cascade lasers was carried out. A mid-infrared quantum-cascade laser structure with triple resonance levels was chosen as the prototype of the lasing medium with high Kerr nonlinearity from optical transitions. The self-phase modulation effect induced by Kerr nonlinearity was found to possibly change the unstable frequency domain significantly, i.e., not only broaden the unstable domain but also drive it from single-mode to multi-mode. The instability mechanisms of quantum-cascade lasers include one like the coherent multi-mode Rishen-Nummedal-Graham-Haken instability and the spatial-hole-burning-induced single-mode instability.

articleTitle: The evaluation of matrix rank based on determinant-operation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The general method of evaluating matrix rank from the present teaching materials Advanced Algebra is that by using the method of elementary-transformation of row, the matrix is changed into its equivalent ladder-shaped matrix, whose number of non-zero row is the rank of the matrix. The method is concise, but it is difficult to be put into practice. The study introduces a new method of evaluating matrix rank based on the determinant-operation. The method is not only easy to understand but also convenient to master.

articleTitle: Prosthetic modeling of the femoral head based on mesh segmentation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: For the sake of getting the optimal femoral head prosthesis model, a novel modeling method is proposed. It can reconstruct the shape of the subsided femoral head owing to ischemic necrosis. In this paper, two male sufferers with different necrosis extent were chosen as the experimental subject for contrastive simulation. The prosthetic models highly presented the primary shape of the femoral heads. The results proved that the fitted models primely matched with the acetabulum.

articleTitle: The measuring of three dimensional dynamic force during FSW
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The measurement system is designed by using LabWindows/CVI as software developing environment to detect three dimensional dynamic force during friction stir welding. This study describes component and implementation of the hardware and software. It has the functions of data acquisition, processing, displaying and storage and so on. The experimental analysis indicates that the system can effectively acquire the signal and process related data.

articleTitle: Research on the intelligent var continuous compensator based on DSP
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: This paper will introduce an intelligent Var continuous compensator based on DSP. This system can be used to adjust the amplitude of variable voltage source, which not only can continuous compensate Var but also bring out pollution of harmonic. In addition, this system will ensure dynamic, timely and accurate intelligent control based on the core component of DSP chip TMS320F2812. This article will focus on the hardware project and software flow chart and then process the simulation which can verify the fundamental principle of this system.

articleTitle: DFT study on the clamped linear electro-optic effect in KH2PO4
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The clamped linear electro-optic (E-O) effect in KH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>PO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> (KDP) is studied employing the electronic density-functional theory. It is found that proton atoms in the hydrogen bonds that connect the PO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> units are much more flexible than the other atoms in KDP when an external electric field is applied. However, our results show that the main contribution to the clamped linear E-O effect in KDP crystals is from the relative displacements of the anions and cations in the phosphate group induced by a low frequency applied electric field, instead of the contribution of vibration of proton atoms. The ration Δn<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</inf>/Δl<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k</inf> indicating the relationship between the atoms displacement and the refractive index are found to be well consistent with experimental results.

articleTitle: Laser induced rear-surface-crack damage properties of HF etched fused silica
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The micro subsurface cracks of fused silica etched with HF solution were observed using AFM and optical microscope, and damage characteristics of crack at each etching state were studied. Experimental results show that inclusions in cracks play a important role in cracks' damage behavior. After HF etching, inclusions were eliminated completely, configuration was transformed, and the initial damage threshold (IDT) was greatly improved. Experimental results show that HF etching wouldn't change the damage growth properties of cracks.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Empirical research about psychodrama of the psychological healthy education in the western ordinary middle schools
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The dynamical behaviors of the predator - prey model with stage structure and impulsive effects
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In this paper, based on the theory of impulsive differential equations, we have studied a pre- dator-prey model with stage and impulsive effect. By use of the discrete dynamical system determined by the stroboscopic map, we obtain a predator-extinction's periodicsolution and sufficient conditions of the global attractivity. By using the theory on delay functional and impulsive differ- ential equation, we obtain sufficient condition for the permanence of the system. Results are confirmed by numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Based on the research of the chip electrode positioning system about machine vision in the LED chip automatic measurement
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The paper introduces the LED (Light Emitting Diode) chip electrode positioning and automatic measurement system that based on machine vision technology. The system is to use vision sensors to image incoming LED chip to the PC (Personal Computer), Processing of these images, in order to find the position of the LED chip electrode, then the electrode position feedback to the servo control system, by controlling the servo motor to achieve precise position of the LED chip electrode, and then light chip electrode to analysis the LED chip light-color parameters.

articleTitle: Variational investigation of dipole solitons in nonlocal thermal media
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: A variational approach is presented to deal with the propagation of dipole solitons in nonlocal media with infinite range of nonlocality. And the oscillation of beamwidth is analyzed by a potential. When the potential function has zero at beamwidth W=1, the dipole soliton will form and could propagate stably at an appropriate input power with a profile of xexp(-x<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/2) format. While the beamwidth would oscillate between a smallest and a maximum value when the input beam power does not equal to the soliton power. What is verified by the numerical simulations and results show that the input dipole beam would propagate with a periodic or quasi-periodic manner.

articleTitle: Comparision of the operation efficiency of three fiber optical interferometers
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The optical heterodyne method is widely used in various applications. However, the operation efficiency of the conventional Mazh-Zehnder interferometer utilized in the delayed self-heterodyne is rather low. To improve the operation efficiency, two modified interferometer (MZ loop interferometer and ring interferometer) are adopted. We take a simplified method to analyze the efficiency of all the interferometers theoretically, the results show that the efficiency of fiber ring interferometer is the highest while the efficiency of conventional Mazh-Zehnder interferometer is the lowest. The analysis above is confirmed by the unfiltered intensity noise and delayed self- heterodyne experiments.

articleTitle: Research on automatic analysis of multi- encoding schemes for Uyghur Information codes based on windows operation systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: On the basis of analysis with common encoding schemes adopted in Uyghur Information processing technology at present, this paper put forward analysis method based on Uyghur information encoding; And laid a necessary foundation for the Uyghur Information Extraction and content filtering in the process of computer forensics.

articleTitle: Monte Carlo simulation for fiber hemispherical micro-lenses
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The Monte Carlo model for a fiber hemispherical micro-lens is proposed. A hybrid method that uses both geometrical ray tracing and wave optics simulation is introduced for building the model of a fiber hemispherical micro-lens. The advantages of this method are that it can be taken into account the non-paraxial effects such as aberrations and diffraction effects. The properties of tapered-cladding single-mode fiber hemispherical micro-lenses are investigated by Monte Carlo simulation. And the simulation results show the waist and the maximum axial intensity are not located at the geometrical focal plane of the micro-lens, and their positions are not coincident with each other. And when the curvature radius of the fiber micro-lens is lager than 2 times of the fiber mode radius, the contribution of the spherical aberration on the spot size can be ignored.

articleTitle: The memory management and optimization of PCI driver
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Various memory allocation methods provided by PCI driver are analyzed and compared, the factors that affect the driver transmission performance are found and effective optimization program for the DMA transmission is made. In hardware configuration, please use the disk array to write to improve the computer's disk speed.
