In programming, please use multi-thread approach, set ping-pong buffer, combined with multi-core thread parallel processing technology to improve the efficiency of PC machines. These measures have been used successfully in data acquisition system, and then a good DMA transmission performance is obtained.

articleTitle: Injection parameters determination of proton-implanted VCSELs
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In the processing of proton implanted VCSELs, Au and SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> are used as the mask to protect the surface against bombardment. Under the guidance of the LSS theory, a series of parameters are designed and optimized, such as the dose, the energy and the thickness of the mask. SRIM are employed to simulation the designed parameters. It can be achieved to fabricating the proton implanted VCSELs under the condition of three times bombardment and suitable thickness of mask, where the energy are 330kev, 250kev, 160kev and the mask are 1.5μm, 0.5μm. When the parameters are used to fabricate the VCSELs, we get a device performance of 0.5mw output power, and the threshold current is 6.5mA, which is similar to the reported earlier.

articleTitle: Athermalization design of a dual field-of-view IR optical system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Infrared imaging optical system are often asked to have good imaging performance, especially while surrounding temperature varies in a large range. Because of infrared material's sensitivity to temperature, athermalization should be taken into account in its design process in order to meet different user's demand. In this study we undertake the design and construction of a dual field-of-view lenses optimized for use in the infrared waveband(3.5~5μm), of which the F/# is 2, and it offers a dual EFL of 200/400 mm. Analysis show the system has fine and steady imaging performance within the range of -40 ~60°C, and its MTF curves and spot diagrams show a good image quality , besides, its length and size are permitted, which is acceptable to a certain theodolite.

articleTitle: The comparison of the forms of ecological green roof based on the full life cycle theory
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The roof form types of urban housing were introduced in this paper, and compared with ecological green roof and common roof in many aspects, such as construction costs, resource consumption, the impact on the urban ecological environment and other aspects. This paper proposed should be based on full life cycle theory (LCA ) to the green roof selection, and enhance the basic research work of Green roof systems technology.

articleTitle: Existence of positive periodic solutions for the second order and fourth order nonlinear ordinary differential system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In this paper, by using the fixed-point index theory and product of topology degree theory, the existence results on positive solutions is established to the second order and fourth order nonlinear ordinary differential system with periodic boundary value. Our result is essential and do not require the nonlinear terms are superlinear or sublinear at ends (zero or infinty) and the system must have the same order.

articleTitle: Study on relative contents of principal components of different tea by infrared absorption spectroscopy
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Fourier transform infrared absorption (FTIR) spectroscopy has been used to study the relative contents of principal components of different tea. Middle infrared (MIR) spectra in the range of 400~4000 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> has been obtained, which included six kinds of brand tea, corresponding remains and four kinds of component molecular. Contents of components in different kind of tea have been obtained by a new method that made spectral reconstruction based on five principal component model, particularly the remains of tea considered as primary components, as well as anthocyanic, theanine, epi-gallocatechin-3-gallaet and caffeine. All the correlation coefficient between original spectra of tea and reconstructive spectra are beyond 99% in the range of 800-2000 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>. Meanwhile, the fitting results clearly showed that the relative contents and regularity of theanine, epigallocatechin-3-gallae and caffeine were consistent with the reported results in different kind of tea. Therefore, it was confirmed that this new method can be used to identify tea samples effectively.

articleTitle: Mapping the modal effective area in submicrometer strip and slot waveguides
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In this paper, the relationship between the nonlinear effect and the cross-section of the waveguide is studied by computing the modal effective area. And the structure of both wire and slot waveguide are optimized to enhance the nonlinear effect in waveguide core and cover. It is found out that the slot waveguide is a better candidate to take advantage of the nonlinear effect in the cover material and the optimized slot thickness is about 20nm to get the strongest nonlinear gain in slot.

articleTitle: Distribution of macromolecule chain's conformation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: We have built a physical model about macromolecule's chain conformation by applying the methods of physics, and then we have mainly simulated macromolecule chain's conformation. We also have studied the single chain system conformation's size which represented by mean-square end to end distance R2 and mean-square radius of gyration R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, shape and the variation of energy which acted between different chain lengths. The results shows that the average energy Ec and the size which represented by mean-square end to end distance R2 and mean-square radius of gyration R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> are proportional to the variation of chain's length. When the chain lengthens, the distribution of chain conformation in a small size area will be expanded and increased. When the chain length reaches from 10 to 16, chain conformations are mostly distributed the area with high energy and small size.

articleTitle: Point smoke density measurement system design based on photoelectricity
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Point smoke density measurement system plays the most important role while calibrating fire detector. Based on dimmer principle and photoelectricity technology, a measurement system is designed in this paper. As the emitting device, infrared LED provides light into the smoke measured. Corresponding driving circuit is designed to control On/Off of the LED and provide constant current. As the receiving device, photodiode is chosen to convert infrared light into weak current. The conditioning circuit converts the weak current into standard voltage to be measured. As the central unit, Sing Chip Microcomputer (SCM) acquires the standard voltage and communicate with PC by RS485 interface. The system designed possesses such advantages as high accuracy, more flexibility, lower power consume.

articleTitle: Relationship between electronic technology courses in equivalent view and the cultivation of the students' capability
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Equivalent view is both the basic ideas throughout the whole electronic technology curriculum, and important methods and thoughts of scientific research. It has great influence on students' ability to clarify the scientific thoughts and scientific research methods through analyzing the basic points.

articleTitle: Teaching reform of “ Signal and System ” in applied institute
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In this paper, the course characteristics of Signal and System are analyzed. According to the development goal of applied institute, this paper introduces teaching reform of the course,including the teaching contents, teaching methords, interaction in classes,experiment pattern and test pattern. The teaching practice demonstrates that those reform ways are beneficial to inspire the students'interest, practice their operational abilities, and improve the teaching quality.

articleTitle: The digitization of Michelson Interferometer
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: This paper addresses some most commonly observed issues of traditional Michelson Interferometer in processing the experiment and consequently delivers a proposition for a digital modification. In the modification, the photodiodes and processing circuits are manipulated to count the interference fringes; meanwhile a stepper motor is exerted in driving the adjusting wheel of the reflective mirror. The system, which applies MCU as its central processing unit, automatically manifests the wavelength of light through the relative calculation by exploiting the LCD real-time displayed number of fringes and the distance moved of the reflective mirror. The digitally modified Michelson Interferometer does simplify steps of the experiment and simultaneously improve the experimental precision substantially.

articleTitle: The optimal design of spectrum analyzer based on DSP
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The principle of Radix-2 fast Fourier transform (FFT) arithmetic according to decimation in time (DIT), and the accomplishment algorithms using TMS320C54x fixed-point digital signal processing (DSP) are introduced in this paper. The problems and resolving methods, such as data-overflow, spectrum leakage, fence effect, etc. and implementation of Radix-2 FFT algorithms by using fixed-point DSP are discussed. Also an approach for optimal design with hardware framework, software flowchart and result of digital simulation are given.

articleTitle: A color image match algorithm based on multi similarity measurements
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In this paper, an algorithm based on multi similarity measurements is proposed for stereo matching of color images. The composition of L_1 norm and L_2 norm is used for matching. The performance evaluation of algorithms is determined by CMSE value. The experiment results show that the stability and accuracy of stereo matching are partially improved after using multi similarity measurements.

articleTitle: Optical terminal error analysis for high-power laser pulses based on ZEMAX
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In the high-power laser, the pulse must be stretched in time, amplified, compressed in a grating compressor and subsequently focused by off-axis parabola in order to obtain high peak power. In the optical terminal, the grating compressor and off-axis parabola are the critical components to assemble. Some models in ZEMAX are used to characterize the spatially resolved far-field beam distributions for several different terminal optical designs that include mono-grating, array-grating and multi-beam compressor configurations. The various angular errors in the models are discussed for the optical assemblies of the grating compressor and parabola. The results show that the angular errors and piston error should be controlled under ±0.5µrad and ±λ/10µm respectively for different optical terminal.

articleTitle: A simple all-normal-dispersion mode-locking laser based on large-mode-area Yb-doped Photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Stable mode-locked operation in a simple normal-cavity dispersion laser oscillator that consists of only Yb-doped Photonic crystal fibers (PCFs) and SESAM saturable absorber is studied. Without any discrete dispersion compensation components or conventional spectral filters, the SESAM works with the strongly chirped pulse. The laser generates 55 nJ stable mode-locked pulses with 45.2 MHz fundamental repetition rate at 1030.8 nm central wavelength. This kind of mode-locked fiber oscillators can compete in terms of pulse energy and peak power with most advanced bulk solid-state Ultra-short pulsed lasers.

articleTitle: Design of portable semiconductor laser instrument
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Using 10mW semiconductor laser tube,and making AT89C2051 microcontroller, TPS76333 voltage stabilizer blocks, CA358 op-amp integrated circuit etc as the core, economical and practical laser instrument is designed, and the hardware circuit and programming method is given. Meanwhile, the rationality of the design of instrument and economical usability is demonstrated.

articleTitle: A study of data structure curricula for undergraduate education of Tibetan students
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: This thesis discusses the problem in data structure course and proposes the solution by applying it in real teaching situation according to the Tibetan students' characteristics and requirements of the job market at present. It aims at inspiring the Tibetan students' interest in learning and enhancing their ability of obtaining knowledge through computer, and makes them become independent and serve the society in future.

articleTitle: Application of entangled photons technique in secure communication
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Secure communication is a ultimate target pursued by human being. However, all current methods of secure communication can eventually be broken by faster computing. The method based on entangled photons technique provides a powerful solution for totally secure communication. Because eavesdropping changes the physical nature of information, users in such communication system can easily detect eavesdroppers. We propose an entangled photons-based method and demonstrate in theoretical simulation, this method improves the performance of communication system.

articleTitle: Study on nonlinear regression modeling methods of the Permanent Magnet Drive
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The Permanent Magnet Drive is a new kind of advanced energy-saving products with disc structure. This paper mainly aims at nonlinear regression modeling of the Permanent Magnet Drive with BP neural network, adaptive network-based fuzzy inference system and support vector machine. The sample points for training are the electromagnetic characteristics of the Permanent Magnet Drive and obtained from finite element method simulation. The accuracy, validity and prediction capability of these three modeling methods are verified and compared. Simulation results prove that, all approaches have highly precise, little time consuming for convergence and strong prediction performance, and support vector machine reflects the characteristics of the Permanent Magnet Drive best. The nonlinear models built in this paper provide effective tools for the performance analysis, the control system establishment and the optimization design of the Permanent Magnet Drive.

articleTitle: Research and development of automatic screw -parameters tester
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In this paper the entire process of screw-parameter inspection with vision technique is discussed; along with the proposal of new method of screw-parameter inspection; in special, the problem of measurement resolution is solved by sub-pixel theory.

articleTitle: Low repetition-rate all-normal-dispersion mode locking laser based on SESAM
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In this paper, we describe a compact all-fiber-path picosecond pulse based on Ytterbium doped fiber oscillator. A home-made novel SESAM mounted on fiber is reported, by which stable mode locking is obtained. We observe the appearance of multiple pulsing, and give an explanation with regard to establishment of multiple pulsing. The fiber laser generates 15 ps pulse trains without a dispersive delay line or anomalous dispersion in the cavity. Mode locking pulse with 17 MHz low repetition-rate was produced, with 10 mW average output power at 1064 nm.

articleTitle: Calculating method of small enclosed press crank axle pressure
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The linear model in this paper has been from calculating method which used to check mechanical product. All kinds of calculations are the basic estimating methods of geometrical characteristic parameter. In practical applications, some other calculating methods are always applied to check product's geometrical characteristics besides estimating methods. And there are many kinds of checking methods and multivariate statistics methods. In this paper, we have mainly studied calculating method about small enclosed press crank axle pressure. On the other hand, we also have studied crank moment's calculation, stress calculation. So, we can judge the crank axle's safety correctly.

articleTitle: Transmission spectrum and defect mode of symmetric one-dimensional photonic crystal
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: We investigate transmission spectrum and defect mode position of three symmetric one-dimensional photonic crystal samples A(air/[PbTe/ZnSe]<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sup>/[ZnSe/PbTe]<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sup>/galss), B(air/[ZnSe/PbTe]<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sup>/[PbTe/ZnSe]<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sup>/glass) and C(air/PbTe/ZnSe/PbTe]<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sup>/[PbTe/ZnSe]<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sup>/PbTe/glass) by transfer matrix method. It is found that under a given center wavelength of forbidden band, the defect mode position of sample A, B and C will not change with the number of growth period m and n, but the transmittance of defect mode depends on values of m and n. When m equal to n, that is a completely centrosymmetric structure, the maximum transmittance of defect mode is obtained. Under the same values of m and n, the spectral properties of sample A is better than sample B; with smaller values of m and n, sample C can obtain the same good spectral properties as sample A. In addition, symmetric structure photonic crystal can avoid mode splitting and shift, and can further simplify the preparation process. It is believed that the results given in our paper are of guiding significance for the preparation of one-dimensional photonic crystals to obtain a “hole-digging” spectrum at specific wavelength in order to achieve compatible infrared and laser stealth.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The presupposed reconstruction in teaching based on horizon of the complexity theory
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Novel algorithm for frequency estimation of continuous wave
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: An algorithm for frequency estimation of continuous sinusoidal signal corrupted by complex white Gaussian noise was proposed. Devide the samples evenly and get many sinusoid sequences with the same frequency. Correlation accumulation could decrease the number of the signal samples and increase the output signal-to-noise ratio. Interpolation on Fourier coefficients made it possible to get the optimal frequency estimate. The computer simulation results showed that the performance of proposed method was asymptotic to Cramer-Rao bound.

articleTitle: Research on service-oriented equipment maintenance support
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Equipment maintainability support is the most important influencing factor which affects weapon battle ability. Guided by the theory of visualization of equipment support management, this paper discusses the research content and construction goals of maintenance support visualization management expert system based on equipment maintenance support of weapon design, manufacture, storage and use dept. Based on analysis of equipment maintenance support, maintenance support scenario establishment approach is discussed in paper. The overall framework model of the system is brought forward. Its hardware, software and architecture are analyzed. At last service-oriented software development method is used to develop equipment maintenance expert system. Decision-makers can establish rational maintenance scenario according to evaluation result and arrange maintenance tasks. Weapon equipment development department and army can optimize maintainability support scheme based on evaluation result and maintain equipment.

articleTitle: Characterization of an optical fiber thermometer with cladding mode suppression fiber
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: An optical fiber thermometer based on cladding mode suppression fiber was designed for medical applications in human body, e.g., hyperthermia treatment. In this paper, the basic sensing principle of fiber Bragg grating(FBG) was introduced, and the characteristic of FBG thermometer and the influence of bending curvature were investigated. Calibration of the thermometer was carried out from 34°C to 47°C with a water bath. There was a good linearity between the center wavelength of FBG and the tested temperature. The calibrated FBG thermometer was used to detect the temperature of the water bath with about 0.3°C interval. The standard error between the measured temperatures and the actual temperatures was 0.193°C .There was a little drift at different bending radius. The possible application of the temperature sensor was presented.

articleTitle: Laser-induced fluorescence of high-purity fused silica irradiated by arf excimer laser
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Elucidating the nature of light fluorescence of point defects in laser modified fused silica is important for controlling the evolution of laser damage and for designing an effective damage mitigation procedure in excimer laser applications. Laser-induced fluorescence (LIF) of high-purity irradiated by ArF excimer laser is studied experimentally. LIF bands of high-purity fused silica centered at 281nm, 478nm and 650nm are detected simultaneously. Furthermore, the dependence of intensities of LIF signals of the sample on laser power is presented. LIF signals show a squared dependence on power density, which indicates that laser-induced defects are formed mainly via two-photon absorption processes.

articleTitle: Study on reflection selective structure on near infrared
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The paper bring forward a design of multilayer structure which has a high reflectivity for 1.82μm laser beam and a high absorptivity for 1.48μm laser beam. The experiment reveal that the absorptivity of the film reach to 95% at incidence angle from 0° to 40° for 1.48μm laser beam and has a high reflectivity for 1.82μm high power laser at incidence angle of 30° at laser power density above 500w/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: A novel temperature sensor based on a long period fiber grating with a unique double-cladding layer structure
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: A novel temperature sensor based on long period fiber gratings (LPGs) with a unique double-cladding layer structure, which increases the temperature sensitivity, is presented in this paper. Cladding layer of the LPG is etched properly, and then packaged in stainless tube filled with index-matching fluid of relatively low thermal coefficient. It is observed in experiments that sensitivity of 1.1nm/°C for a temperature range of 15°C achieved for such a LPG sensor, which is about 100 times larger than that of sensors made of traditional fiber Bragg grating. It also has a linearity of 99.89% and small size of Φ:1mm*L:50mm, which shows a good promise for future application.

articleTitle: Development of LD pumped Nd:YAG laser texturing device with high performance
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The development of LD pumped acousto-optically Q-switched Nd:YAG laser with the texturing experiments are mainly introduced in this paper. The chromium rolls are textured by using this laser texturing device in roughen lattice density of 4×4/mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. The result realizes excellent performance that the roughness is adjustable within the scope of 7µm under the frequency of 2.8kHz and the adjustable range is 4.5µm under the frequency of 5.6kHz. It realize successfully the development of LD pumped Nd:YAG laser texturing device with long adjustable roughness range, high efficiency, long life time and low operating cost.

articleTitle: Study on control method of single-phase active power filters
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: As one-cycle controlled single-phase active power filters (APF) only can compensate harmonic and reactive currents simultaneously, this paper uses harmonic currents detecting method based on instantaneous reactive theory as and tracing control circuit based one-cycle control currents. The results of simulation verify that this scheme is effective and flexible.

articleTitle: Synthesis and crystal structure of 9-(3-oxo-1,3-bisarylpropyl) fluorene derivatives catalyzed by alkaline ionic liquid
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: A series of new Michael addition products were synthes-ized by the condensation reaction of chalcones with fluorene in a boiling water bath using alkaline ionic liquids as dual solvent and catalyst. The advantages of this procedure were simple protocol, high yields. The alkaline ionic liquid is environmental friendly and could be reused, the structures of the products were characterized by IR, H NMR, MS and elemental analysis, The crystal structure of 3a was determined by X-ray diffracion analysis.

articleTitle: Conversion system of wind power generator
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: We first describe the AC unstable characteristic which generated by wind power generator in this paper. And we have proposed wind power generator's conversion design. We also have studied controlled rectifier device and uncontrolled rectifier device, and analyzed these two kinds of devices' characteristics which including mechanic rectifier device and electric rectifier device. We have studied the principle and application of three-phase inverter and three-phase bridge inverter. What we have studied can be helpful to fix and maintain small wind power generator.

articleTitle: High-efficiency green phosphorescent organic light-emitting devices
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: We have developed high efficiency green phosphorescent organic light-emitting devices (OLEDs) using a novel green phosphorescent material. An OLED with a simple structure of ITO/2T-NATA/NPB/TCTA/green dopant x wt% in green host/TPBi/LiF/Al.The optimized dopant concentration was found to be 10 wt%, with which realized a maximum power efficiency of 61.4 lm/W at 11.3 cd/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. It was further observed that there was reduced current-efficiency roll-off for the used device. At luminance of 100 cd/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and 1000 cd/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, the power efficiencies are 51.2 lm/W and 33.8 lm/W, respectively. In addition, we have obtained a purer green light using this dopant as guest material.

articleTitle: Mechanical fluid coupler's characteristics which applied in coal mine
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: We have studied fluid coupler's such basic parameters' relationship as M<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">B</inf>, M<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">T</inf>, n<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">B</inf>, n<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">T</inf>, η, and i, and these studies are based upon liquid mechanics and mechanical power's variation rules. We have found the rule about fluid coupler absorbs power from engine and outputs power. We also found the parameters which have direct affection to fluid coupler's characteristics. At last, we have studied mathematical equation and curve which used to prescribe power characteristics. By analyzing mathematical model, what we have studied can be helpful to design mechanical fluid coupler.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The application research of ‘the best military action is winning by the strategy’ in teaching and learning
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Exploration of non-destructive testing of anchorage quality of metal anchored bar system with ultrasonic guided wave
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: This paper manages to perform non-destructive testing of anchored integrity of metal bar in anchored bar system by use of ultrasonic guided wave through theoretical analysis, simulation analysis and experimental study of the properties of guided wave propagating in the metal bar of anchored bar system. The theoretical models of free bar and end anchored bar are established for anchored bar system. In combination with boundary conditions, etc., the time domain response for the displacement, velocity and acceleration of propagation of ultrasonic guided wave are solved and obtained. Based on this model, the parameters that affect the anchorage quality of anchored bar are analyzed. Furthermore, theoretical curve was compared with finite element simulation curve. The two curves are in good agreement, which justifies that the theoretical model can correctly reflect the vibration properties of anchored bar and the propagation law of guided wave. By means of experimental studies, quantitative analysis was performed as to the properties of ultrasonic guided wave propagating in the metal bar of anchorage system, subsequent to which the general law of the wave velocity change and amplitude decay is deduced in respect of longitudinal ultrasonic guided waves of different frequencies propagating in anchored bars of same size or different sizes. Under the same conditions, waves at high frequency propagates faster than ones at low frequency, but the former's energy attenuates quicker than the latter's. And the decay extent of their amplitude can be used to qualitatively determine the anchorage quality of metal anchored bar.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of adaptive flow control by means of magnetohydrodynamic force: Part I
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The flow control technique by means of magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) force, an intensively studied topic in the flow control field, can be well integrated with adaptive algorithm due to its rapid response, thus achieving online optimization. This paper utilizes the adaptive control algorithm which combines the particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm and the extremum seeking control (ESC) for the MHD active flow control. Through numerical simulation of the flow past a circular cylinder under MHD force, the process of the on-line optimization of MHD active flow control is realized.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on the practice teaching of high nursing professional in the innovation and system construction
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Study on obtaining method of original signal of on-line Chinese signature
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Original signature through writing pad and other input devices may lead to noise and other unnecessary information, in order to minimize error, treatment of smoothing and noise reduction is needed. In this paper, corresponding algorithm for noise reduction is proposed. In order to make treated data signal adapt to circuit convolution operation in shift between spline wavelet and dyadic wavelet, curve fitting is made for every stroke so that every stroke become a periodic function, which lay a good foundation for further identification of Chinese signature and design of classifier.

articleTitle: Program developing based on Human- Machine Interface of touching screen
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Touch screen is the lastest input device. In this article the Delta DOP-B07S200 type Human Machine Interface of touching screen (HMI) is used to design the beating-hamster game. The picture editing, component address assigning, the macro program of ON button component, ON holding button, picture starting, picture cycle clock designing and the process of game developing are described detailedly based on HMI

articleTitle: Modeling and analysis on the SSA queue in EPON system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: An EPON (Ethernet Passive Optical Network) system based on SSA (Static Slot Allocation) is discussed in detail. How to create a queue model in upstream scheme of the EPON system based on SSA and how to confirm appropriate parameters in OPNET are also probed. Furthermore, the simulation analysis on the performance of EPON system has been performed. The simulation result shows that the performance of the EPON system based on SSA is better when the load is lower than 0.47. Under the condition of long distance, it is proposed that the SSA algorithm is applied in the EPON system.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of an FPGA-based high-performance improved vector-reduction method
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Vector-reduction operation is the basis of many scientific computations. FPGA-based vector-reduction circuit must use deeply pipelined floating-point IP cores to gain a performance advantage over general-purpose processor (GPP). Improper design of reduction circuit will destroy the benefit from pipelining or impose unrealistic buffer requirements. In this paper, a high-performance improved reduction method is proposed and analyzed for FPGA platform. This design runs in optimal time while requires only four buffers of fixed size and a single pipelined floating-point unit. Using ALTERA Cyclone II EP2C70F896C6 as the target device, we implement vector summation which is most common example of vector-reduction using improved reduction method.

articleTitle: A threshold voltage modeling for ultra-deep sub-micron MOSFETs
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: A threshold voltage modeling for ultra-deep sub-micron (UDSM) MOSFETs is given by the novel accuracy definition, which includes three parts: the first part is semiconductor surface potential, the second is the voltage on the gate oxide layer, and the third is named the flat-band voltage. In the modeling, the voltage on the gate oxide layer considers the effect of the channel charges and includes short-channel effects. By comparing with the model numerical analyzing and the characteristics simulating, the results of the simulation are basically identical with the designed model.

articleTitle: Research on the radiation effect of plane wave to twisted cables
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In this paper, with the electromagnetic software CST, an model of Twisted Cables electromagnetic response excited by plane wave is set up. The response is deeply investigated with different terminal load and different electric field angle. The simulation results show that, with the terminal load improving, the response voltage is bigger, and at last the voltage is steady, the peak point is 1.25 wavelength, with the angle imporving, the response voltage is smaller, at last the voltage is 0, the response have nothing with frequency.

articleTitle: The design of flight control law based on integral separation PID algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The quality of flight control law design is to ensure that an important prerequisite for normal flight the aircraft, This article case of an aircraft, which based on the choice of flight control law, design and implementation of a relatively independent channel flight control law, get a better flight control mode in the simulation.

articleTitle: Study on the wireless transmission performance of the passive pressure sensor
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: A passive pressure sensor based on LC resonance principle is introduced in this paper. The sensor consists of a resonance cavity and induction antenna, and furthermore, it requires neither physical contact nor a battery power supply for signal communication. The design of antenna, inductance and capacitance Parameter and Q-factor is conducted in order to improve sensor reading distance and sensitivity. Through experiment, the sensor has reached 7cm sensing distance and sensitivity has achieved 0.3 MHz/PF in condition of required Q-factor. when guarantee the sensitivity and improve reading distance, wireless measurement of pressure sensor is feasible in practice.

articleTitle: Active compensating method of sensitivity temperature drift of convection-based Tilt sensor
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: When environment temperature is changed, the properties of convection-based tilt sensors are changed, which is so-called sensitivity temperature drift. Methods of sensitivity compensation are introduced according to mechanism of this kind of tilt sensor: temperature distribution induced by the heat source plays a key role in sensing tilt angle. The sensitivity temperature drift was researched, a new method of sensitivity temperature active compensating was proposed, and sensitivity temperature active compensating was accomplished.

articleTitle: A novel tilt sensor with a large measurement range based on long-period fiber grating
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: A novel one-dimensional tilt sensor with a large measurement range is demonstrated by gluing one long-period fiber grating (LPG) at a slanted orientation in a plexi-glass tubular with sucrose solution filled. Experimental results show that resolution of 0.13° has been achieved in the range of -30° to 30°.

articleTitle: An automatic multi-spectral infrared sea surface temperature radiometer
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Sea surface temperature (SST) is an important parameter in many operational and research activities, ranging from weather forecasting to climate research. A multi-spectral infrared sea surface temperature radiometer is a self-calibrating instrument capable of measuring in situ sea surface temperature to an accuracy of better than 0.1 K. This paper describes an instrument with special design features that double channel radiometer with four spectral band pass of 3μm~5μm and 8μm~12μm adapts for autonomous use. The entire instrument infrared optical path is calibrated by viewing two blackbody reference cavities at different temperatures. In this case, the high accuracy of an infrared radiometer is maintained although optical components are moderately contaminated by salt deposition. An newly designed protection shutter that is triggered by a sensitive rain gauge automatically seals the instrument from the external environment in foul weather.

articleTitle: Research and application of steelmaking workplace crane logistics tracking system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Crane logistics system is a complex process for the steel plant logistics and varied cross-operation, etc., suitable for harsh field environment presents the only viable iron and steel material consumption of the whole process of real-time tracking monitoring means to achieve an accurate measurement, on-line monitoring, cost accounting purposes in accordance furnace to improve the operational control level, reducing the consumption of iron and steel materials.

articleTitle: Optimization of trichromatic color temperature tunable white light LEDs
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In this paper, color mixing of extensive arbitrary visible spectra with color temperature tunable trichromatic white LEDs is studied. Within three different peak wavelengths ranges, the results provide combinations which yield white light of desired color temperature, while maximize various objectives such as color rendering index, color quality scale and luminous efficacy. A combination of 463nm, 543nm, 613nm reaches CRI above 85 with average luminous efficacy of 362.9lm/W, and the combination of 457nm, 541nm, 607nm reaches average luminous efficacy of 380.74lm/W with CRI above 80, both within tunable color temperature range from 2800K to 6500K.

articleTitle: Identification of nonlinear dynamic system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: An identification method of nonlinear dynamic system is studied in this paper. First, suppose that the original nonlinear dynamic system is described by Hammerstein model. Then, an intermediate model is generated. Next, Parameters of the intermediate model are obtained using a Bacterial Chemotaxis Optimization (BCO) approach. Finally, through the relationships of the parameters of intermediate model and those of Hammerstein model, we derive the parameters of the system. Consequently, the original nonlinear dynamic system is identified. The feasibility and efficiency of the presented algorithm are demonstrated using numerical simulations.

articleTitle: The collection and analysis of performance parameters in web applications
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: It will lead to the failure of entire development if the software developed cannot satisfy the performance needs. Software performance engineering is an evaluating process which analyzes the performance before completion of software. With the development of internet technology, web application has become the mainstream of modern software development. Currently, the evaluation before development is generally through modeling and simulation, however, which needs parameters to support. The key to performance modeling and evaluation is to collect parameters. Through analysis, the biggest difference between web applications and traditional desktop software is that web applications have a variable number of users. The key factors to influence the performance of web application are the access time of database in multiple users and the response time of various Medias and files. Therefore, in the context, the access time of database in different concurrent number of users need to be collected, then analysis the relationship between parameters and multivariate attributes such as concurrent numbers, keyword numbers and record numbers, sum up and come to the similar function and obtain the performance parameters library which provide a basis for performance modeling and evaluation.

articleTitle: Passive tracking based on three-arrays fusion and particle fitler
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Aiming at the application of multi-target passive tracking, a new multi -target passive tracking method based on three array fusion and particle fitler was proposed. Firstly, the “fake points” could be almost entirely and exactly deleted with the aids of the three-array at the expense of an additional array. Secondly, considered the fact that the measurements gotten from each array were independent in passive tracking system, a novel sequential particle filter with improved distribution was proposed, and the influence of non-linear and non-Gauss could be eliminated by the presented method. The relative performances, as measurement by track lifetime, position tracking error and RMS tracking error are compared with the classical methods. The results show that there is significant improvement in tracking capability over MHEKF and IMM-PD methods.

articleTitle: Multi-user detection technology of CDMA system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: It is Multi - User Detection, MUD that uses the orthogonality of signature among each User to eliminate multi-user mutual interference. Multi-user detection fully utilizes all users' information of signal causing multi-access interference to detect single user's signal which can reduce influence of multi-access interference and near-far effect, reduce the requirement of precision of power control in system, make use of link spectrum resources effectively, remarkably raise the system capacity.

articleTitle: Development of characteristic test sustem for magneto-dependent sensor
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: As a key part of sensor family, the magneto-dependent sensor has been widely utilized in aeronautics and astronautics, biology and medicine, etc. But the comprehensive characteristics test method is still in progress since the lack of suitable magnetic field generator and corresponding testing system. Thus, a standard magnetic field generator with wider frequency and amplitude is designed. And the corresponding characteristic test system is designed and manufactured in this paper. After that, the static and dynamic characteristics of a giant magneto-resistance (GMR) sensor is tested and analyzed. The existing problem of characteristic test system is simply discussed at last.

articleTitle: A target tracking algorithm based on the continuous wavelet transform of spatio-temporal processing block
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: A novel target tracking approach based on the continuous wavelet transform (CWT) is proposed. Three energy densities are used to estimate motion parameters by sequentially optimizing a state vector composed of velocity, position, and size parameters. The practical functional relation is created to reasonably obtain the scale parameter. For the purpose of lowering computational cost, the spatio-temporal processing block for each frame is adopted as the tracking strategy. Both results in the simulation and in the real video data show that our approach is effective and has the advantages of being robust to local illumination variations as well as temporary partial occlusion by processing all the image windows in every built spatio-temporal processing block simultaneously during the tracking.

articleTitle: Initiated damage of laser induced in fused silica at 1064nm and 532nm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The useful lifetime of a laser optic in high power laser system is limited by both laser-induced initiated damage and the subsequent growth. We have studied and measured the initiated damage morphology on fused silica surface in air at 1064nm and 532nm at nanosecond. Results demonstrate a significant dependence of the initiated damage morphology and size on the type, diameter and lodging depth of the surface defects. We will compare the initiated damage morphology for entrance- and exit-surface. Possible reasons for the observed initiated damage behavior are discussed.

articleTitle: The dynamic cancellation research of continuous-wave radar leakage signal
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: This paper introduces cancellation method of continuous-wave (CW) radar leakage signals in principle and implementation method, and it is verified by experiments in the intermediate frequency.

articleTitle: Ensemble forecasting model for geomagnetic disturbance
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Ensemble forecasting has been shown to offer a systematic improvement in the skill of weather and climate prediction with different models. However, little such work has been done for space weather prediction. Referring to the ensemble forecasting technique in weather prediction, a novel geomagnetic disturbance ensemble forecasting (GDEF) model is developed in this paper. This model combines two Kp forecast models, geomagnetic disturbance forecast indicators model and geomagnetic disturbance empirical energy model, with the physics-based parameter of mean solar wind speed. Applying the GDEF model to 132 events, the prediction results show that the absolute error of GDEF model is 11.55, which is obviously smaller than 12.17 and 13.85 from the two single models, respectively. Moreover, the relative error of our model is ≤10% for 28.03% of all events, ≤30% for 75.76%, and ≤50% for 90.15%, which is better than those of the individual models. These results demonstrate that the GDEF model can utilize the advantages of each single model and improve the accuracy of prediction. Thus, developing ensemble forecasting technique is an effective way of improving space weather prediction.

articleTitle: Secondary light distribution design for LED street light
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The secondary optics design is a critical issue for the light distribution and output efficiency of the LED street light. Traditional light distribution methods are simple but difficult to get high energy efficiency and illumination uniformity together. In this paper, the adoption of the unsymmetrical freeform surface lens can obtain a rectangular light distribution pattern just cover the road with little waste of light. In this paper, an unsymmetrical freeform optic lens is designed which is combining with theory of non-imaging optics and freeform surface. The result shows that light energy efficiency and illumination uniformity under the freeform surface lens can reach 81% and 77% respectively.

articleTitle: Research of auto control about biasvoltage of high speed and power electro-optic modulator
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: It is adopted auto control about bias voltage of Electro-optical modulator (EOM) to innovate the traditional manner that gives a constant voltage to the Electro-optical modulator. It takes an advantage that it makes EOM could have good effect in different temperature to acclimate all kinds of environment, because it always works at the half point of the zone of linearity. It uses photoelectric detector and error analysis to authenticate the drift of half-wave voltage of EOM. The PID algorithm is adopted to enhance a high precision auto control for the bias voltage of EOM system. At the end, the EOM with the auto control is experimented at high speed.

articleTitle: The stable state analysis on the single-phase earth fault of small current grounding system based on mathematical model
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The analysis on the single-phase earth fault of small current grounding system is the important basis that carrying on the breakdown route selection as well as taking other relay protection measure; Only complete the single-phase earth fault principle analysis can elaborate systematically the breakdown route selection method based on the principle of the exchange help increasing, this article has carried on the breakdown stable state analysis from the metallic single-phase earth fault and the nonmetallic single-phase earth fault.

articleTitle: Modeling and fabrication of chirped moiré fiber grating
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The chirped moiré fiber grating (CMFG) is numerically analyzed by taking in count of the factors of the initial exposure phase, the refractive index modulation strength and the grating period difference. And several CMFGs with different amounts of transmission peaks are fabricated by dual-exposure with a single chirped phase mask. The CMFG possesses excellent comb-like filtering characteristics including stable wavelength interval and ultra-narrow pass-bands, so it is suitable to serve as wavelength selective element. Moreover, its fabrication method is easy and flexible.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of the laser range-gating imaging synchronization control system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Described a laser range-gating imaging principle, pointed out the key issues in system design, design and implementation of FPGA-based laser range-gating images systems. System uses the rangefinder, adjustable pulsed laser active Illuminating and ICCD technology combined. Pulse characteristics of laser light source, single pulse energy and the strobe imaging device performance will determine the range-gating imaging of the range resolution, detection range properties. FPGA implementation of the synchronization control process to explore in detail the role. Experiment to verify the theoretical analysis of the accuracy and efficiency of the technology of gated confirmed laser range-gating laser technology is to overcome the backscattering enhance-gated imaging system signal to noise ratio of the effective method.

articleTitle: Al superhydrophobic surfaces fabricated with femtosecond laser pulses
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The Al surfaces are scanned with femtosecond laser pulses and the superhydrophobic surfaces are prepared. The topological and chemical changes on Al surfaces after femtosecond laser irradiation are studied. The wettability of Al surface reveals the competition between two different factors, which are hydrophilic trend due to the formation of aluminum oxides and enhanced hydrophobic trend due to increased roughness during laser pulse treatments.

articleTitle: Hyperbolic tangent function based two layers structure neural network
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The objective of image compression is to reduce irrelevance and redundancy of the image data in order to be able to store or transmit data in an efficient form. The best image quality at a given compression rate is the main goal of image compression. In this paper, we present a hyperbolic tangent function based back propagation network to improve the quality of image compression. Hyperbolic tangent function has better properties than sigmoid function as the new back propagation network's activation function for image compression. The new hyperbolic tangent function based back propagation network and it's arithmetic are presented and described in the paper. It has been proved in many examples that the new network gets good results in the compression quality and compression speed at a given compression rate.

articleTitle: Investigation of lubricating grease using terahertz transmission spectroscopy
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: A nondestructive and contactless screening method for selected lubricating grease stored in common plastic box has been examined using the terahertz (THz) time-domain spectroscopy. The THz wave has been transmitted through the commercially available lubricating grease in polystyrene filters. Greases have unique spectral features in the THz range, and the differences in the absorption coefficient and the refractive indices, which reflect the ingredients of organic compounds, suggested that the THz spectroscopy can be used to characterize the type and consistency of lubricating grease.

articleTitle: Design of optical integrated access network based on EPON
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: On the basis of clarified the techniques and composition of EPON system, analysis of EPON-based access network design principles. This paper discussed the geographical characteristic and the bandwidth requirement of user. One kind of EPON-based FTTH design was brought and analyzed network configuration of the design in detail. Specific solution is put forward according to service requirement. The subjects supply all the users with satisfying bandwidth and communication quality and meet the requirement of access network.

articleTitle: Studies on stepping characteristics of traveling-wave ultrasonic motor
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: This paper presents analysis on speed regulation and stepping characteristics of Shinsei USR60 ring-type traveling-wave ultrasonic motors (USM) based on experimental results, and discusses the influence of controlling method and load variation on stepping control. From the experiments the relationship between the variables is revealed, and improvements to the stepping control are proposed. The improvement focuses on correcting the stepping angle deviation with an empirical equation obtained by performing the least square curve fitting on the results from the USM characterizing experiments. The improved controller is able to perform equal distance stepping when the ring-type traveling-wave USM is operating with loads. The proposed stepping control method is capable of realize open-loop positioning control of ring-type traveling-wave USM without position sensors with precision reaching 0.005°.

articleTitle: The research of data mining technology in campus card consumption system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: This thesis establishes a model of data mining technology in campus card consumption system based on OLAP and data mining technology. It also develops an algorithm in this system. In the end, it analysis the procedure of data mining in the system.

articleTitle: Design of temperature and humidity intelligent control system based on C8051F
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In industrial production, temperature and humidity are common main manipulated parameters, especially in heat treatment industry, the temperature control is becoming more and more important. This paper from two aspects that hardware and software introduced single-chip microcomputer (SCM) C8051F intelligent temperature and humidity control system, and described schematic diagram of hardware and software. The design adds the integration of carbon dioxide concentration and light intensity detection and necessary communication function. It is a more humanized and more practical intelligent temperature and humidity measurement and control system.

articleTitle: Thermoelastic behavior in metal films induced by ramp-type heating
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In metal thin film, two effects become dominant. One is the non-Fourier effect in heat conduction, and the other is the coupling effect between the temperature and strain rate. In the present paper, an ultrafast thermoelasticity model utilizing the parabolic two-step heat conduction model and the generalized thermoelastic theory was formulated to describe the thermoelastic behavior of a thin metal film subjected to a ramp-type heating. An analytical-numerical technique based on the Laplace transform was used to solve the governing equations and the time histories of the electron temperature, lattice temperature, displacement and stress in a gold film were analyzed. The influence of the thickness of the film was also analyzed. In addition, the propagation of the stress wave through the film was analyzed.

articleTitle: Discussion on the construction method of ooil exploration and development domain ontology
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Ontology combined with the development of computer technology in all fields produces the research of construction and application for so-called “domain ontology”. This article states from the issues of current computer technology in oil exploration and development domain, gives construction method of oil exploration and development domain ontology based on multi-level business process, and divides oil exploration and development domain into multistage business activity levels, and lists the discussion of construction method for corresponding micro-ontology.

articleTitle: Design of programmable near infrared cold light source
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In the near infrared spectroscopy, detector of Charge-coupled Device requires very high stability for light source. We design the cold light source in the measurement of near infrared spectroscopy. Cold light source consists of high-power op amp OPA549 high current constant current source and proportion integral differential (PID) control algorithm. As is shown in the experimental results, the method is better, the overshoot is very small, the stability is excellent in the process of soft-start. While light intensity was able to meet the requirements of near-infrared instruments to measure.

articleTitle: Relative intensity noise reduction in superfluorescent fiber source based on semi-physical simulation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Relative intensity noise (RIN) is one of the most important factors limiting performance in fiber optic gyroscopes (FOG). In order to suppress RIN in the superfluorescent fiber source (SFS) of FOG effectively, we propose a semi-physical simulation with SFS signal. The semi-physical simulation is of much practical value and can depict guideline for RIN reduction in SFS. We propose and investigate the technique with intensity modulator for suppression of RIN can reduce RIN while increasing the signal to noise ratio, and this technique is effective in improving the performance of FOG.

articleTitle: Image motion compensation for a certain aviation camera based on Lucy-Richardson algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: According to the actual situation, when high quality and high precision are required for the image, both beforehand and afterwards compensation should be used. In this paper, we use Lucy-Richardson algorithm to compensate image motion of a certain aviation camera as an afterwards compensation. Firstly, we analyze the imaging principle of the camera and the reasons that cause image motion. Then we have a brief introduce of the Lucy-Richardson algorithm. At last, in order to show the feasibility of the method, we do some simulation. Through theoretical and practical analysis, experiments and test, we conclude the Lucy-Richardson algorithm can be used to compensate image motion for the certain camera.

articleTitle: Error analysis and experiment for reflective sagnac interferometer-type fiberoptic current sensor
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: A reflective Sagnac interferometer-type fiber-optic current sensor (RS-FOCS) is presented with Y-branch integrated-optics phase modulator and polarization beam splitter. The digital closed-loop fiber gyroscope technology is employed for signal detection and processing. The variation of linear birefringence and Verdet constant of sensing fiber and phase retardation of quarter-wave retarder with temperature is indicated as the primary scale factor error source. The effect of linear birefringence was suppressed by winding the sensing fiber spirally, and the ratio error caused by the temperature dependence of the Verdet constant is reduced by elliptical-core fiber quarter-wave retarder. The performance of RS-FOCS is tested, and the results show that: the error is less 0.1% for high current whereas more than 1% for low current; the maximal variation of scale factor is 0.066% in a month; the scale factor error is less than 0.2% at -40°C~60°C.

articleTitle: Application of intelligent fault diagnosis technology in NC machine tool fault diagnosis
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The paper takes NC machine as object, mainly introduced the reasoning mechanism of NC machine tool fault diagnosis, namely, RBR and CBR coordinated operation diagnosis mechanism. Rules, cases and feature data are separately stored in the database combined with the structure and functions of NC machine tool. Rules are summarized from cases, and take diagnostic reasoning under the help of RBF cloud-neural network, which overcomes the shortcoming of hard access, and rules also as a guider in case reasoning on the other hand, which makes the fault fast positioned, improves the efficiency of diagnosis. At last, the paper takes JSP as development technology, Spring + hibernate + Struts2 as a framework, developed B/S NC machine tool failure diagnosis system, which has better diagnostic capabilities.

articleTitle: Analysis and design for VoIP teleconferencing system based on P2P-SIP technique
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Apart from the Client, the VoIP teleconferencing system based on SIP in traditional C/S mode also requires being equipped with SIP registrar server, location server, redirect server and conferencing server, therefore the cost for construction, management and maintenance of the conferencing system is very high. This paper combines the advantages of both P2P technique and SIP protocol to design a VoIP teleconferencing system based on P2P-SIP, which realizes the user locating and conference operation.

articleTitle: A two-point step size gradient method fornon-negative matrix factorization
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Nonnegative Matrix Factorization (NMF) is a recently developed technique for finding parts-based, linear representations of non-negative data. There are many methods for NMF, such as multiplicative iterative and alternating nonnegative data least squares algorithms (ANLS). Among these methods, the most effective way is alternating nonnegative data least squares algorithms. In this paper, we propose a two-point step size gradient method to solve sub-problems of ANLS. The numerical experiment shows that our algorithm is much more efficient than some existing algorithms.

articleTitle: Vision based steering controller for intelligent vehicles via fuzzy logic
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: This paper presents the design and stability analysis of a steering controller. The objective of the controller is to steer a ground vehicle along a reference line located in the middle of the lane to be followed. An adaptive steering controller for ground vehicles through a closed loop control strategy is proposed. To design the maneuver controller, fuzzy logic is used to imitate human drivers' behavior. Based on the widely used dynamic vehicle model, the stability of the designed controller is proved. Simulation results are presented to illustrate the adaptability of the proposed control strategy for different lane curvature inputs.

articleTitle: An LMI approach to H∞ control for affine nonlinear system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: This paper studies the problem of H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> control for a affine nonlinear system with disturbance. Based on HJI inequation, a sufficient condition is presented in the form of LMI to ensure the nonlinear H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> controller's existence. The nonlinear H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> controller can efficiently attenuate the effect of disturbance on system output. Simultaneously, it can guarantee the closed loop system is globally asymptotically stable at the origin. Using matlab software, it is not easy to solve the LMI problem, therefore the presented method is feasible. Finally, a numerical example simulation is provided to illustrate the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Based on the model of the DQ axis permanent magnet synchronous motor MPC
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: This paper is permanent magnet synchronous motor in the DQ coordinate system completely linearization, below the transfer function of established motor based on prediction model, established under the control algorithm, for permanent magnet synchronous motor speed control method and through matlab simulation, and the results show that the shaft system based on DQ under permanent magnet synchronous motor MPC control method has excellent control effect.

articleTitle: Design of the methane concentrations monitoring system based on labVIEW with infrared absorption sensor
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: According to the relationship between the change of methane concentrations and the light absorption under its characteristics absorption wave, coupled with the analysis of infrared absorption spectrum, this article put forward a kind of methane concentrations detection system design scheme with infrared absorption technology based on differential absorption technique. With a single optical path absorption chamber and dual-wavelength detection technology, the system transmitted the signals to host computer through AD conversion, which are the output of weak signal regulate circuit with the differential amplifying circuit as its core circuit. After FFT transform and digital filtering, the methane concentrations can be obtained from the data. The experiment result shows that this system has high sensitivity and stability in methane concentrations detection, and it has the basis in coal mine application.

articleTitle: The research of space telescope CCD camera image resource simulative system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The equipment that the payload electronic control box matches the satellite Charge-Coupled Device (CCD) camera must be rigorously tested before being put into use. The traditional testing process is to make it with the bulky CCD camera system docking and then to capture a certain image to analyze, this will cause a waste of time and material. In consideration for the above problems, a simulative CCD camera image resource system is proposed in this paper. The control signal of a simulative CCD camera image resource is usually implemented in the Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA), thus increasing the complexity of the hardware language, and stability will fall and making post-adjustment is more trouble. This paper presents a system which is controlled based on the host computer software. It makes complex code integrate into the host computer and sets aside a adjust interface to the software in advance, achieving with the FPGA circuit board to send the picture generated by the system cycle together. Sending images, image display and serial communication are usually for a thread in the general simulative CCD camera image resource system, this will inevitably cause some problems that often appear in the process. However, the system utilizes a three-run thread synchronization mode which makes the system more flexible, very easy to adjust. Extensive tests show that the simulative CCD camera image resource system has been running with satisfactory results. So it can replace CCD camera to test the payload electrical control box, which is stable and reliable test for the project and provides a strong support.

articleTitle: Study on calibration technology of portable coordinate measuring machines
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: By analyzing the traditional portable coordinate measuring machines' calibration method based on 1D master artifact, the problems associated with it is discussed. Based on this conclusion, a new type of PCMM calibration method based on 3D master artifact is introduced. The validity and feasibility of the method is discussed in detail. The method proposed by this paper will be helpful in extending the PCMMs, and may leading to a new standard of calibration.

articleTitle: 64 channels 1Gbit/s ultra-dense WDM PON system based on coherent heterodyne receiver
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In this paper, we present a new structure of PON system based on coherent heterodyne receivers. The coherent detection enables a filterless ultra-dense WDM system. We simulated a 64 channel system with 10GHz channel spacing, offering symmetrical 1 Gbit/s sustained data rate per user both downlink and uplink by single fiber. The quadrature phase-shift keying (QPSK) modulation format is applied to downstream data for higher spectrum efficiency, while we use Amplitude Modulation (AM) on upstream data to reduce the system cost.

articleTitle: Design of the fiber Detonation velocity measuring system based on the FPGA
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: A new fiber Detonation velocity measuring system is proposed. The fiber is used as the sensor. By using FPGA to process the signals, the measuring precision of this system is enhanced and the system debug is simplified. At the same time, this paper elaborates the system design of the soft hardware and compares the existed instrument measuring Detonation velocity with this system by testing plastic detonating cord. The test demonstrates the advantages of the system such like the resistance electromagnetic interference, the high measuring precision and the simple manipulation.

articleTitle: The simulated technology research of DC motor load
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The paper mainly demonstrates a kind of the method of the DC motor's equivalent circuit. The equivalent circuit can be used to simulate DC motor. The circuit can replace DC motor as simulated load of the amplifier in some ageing test. It will cause the increasing of the design cost. Meanwhile the equivalent circuit can also be extended to other DC motor of excitation mode.

articleTitle: Research on network security based on IPv6 architecture
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Today, the issue of network security has been one of the most important issues more and more pressing during informatization construction.
