Given the fact that IPv6 technology has been defined by IETF as the standard of next generation for IPv4, which is an indispensable link of future network development, this paper bases on the status quo and issues of network security, comprehensively analyzes the fundamental reason for network security, and carries out analysis from basic principle, significant characters, security mechanism, security issues introduced from IPv6 and other aspects for network based on IPv6 architecture, studies and discusses on the security issues of network based on IPv6.

articleTitle: GC-MS analysis of volatile oil content for brasenia schreberi
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The volatile oil of tender leaves from brasenia schreberi was extracted through water vapour distillation method and the chemical composition was analyzed with GC-MS method. 55 separated and identified components took up 96.89% of the peak area, which consisted of compounds of phenol,alkane, aldehyde, acid and alcohol, including methy-leugenol (25%), heptacosane (8.8%), 5-methyl furfural (8.0%), eucazulen (6.01%), carbamult (5.98%), cedrol (5.31%), π terpieol (3.77%), 4-terpineol (3.61%), cis-farnesol (3.36%), n-decanoic acid (3.35%), palmitic acid (3.01%), cis-6-dodecen-4-oli-de (2.8%), ethyl acetate (2.21%), eucalyptol (1.94%), f.

articleTitle: Flow field's Laplace equation and analysis
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In this paper, we have studied flow field's Laplace equation mathematical mode and physical process and built Laplace equation by means of infinitesimal method. We also have analyzed Laplace equation and its parameters, analyzed the process when we built Laplace equation. At last, we have discussed the methods about modify Laplace equation and described some important characteristics about field.

articleTitle: Theoretical design of single-polarization single-mode photonic-crystal fiber
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The single-polarization single-mode photonic-crystal fiber is proposed and numerically analyzed by using a full vector finite element method with anisotropic perfectly matched layers. The cutoff wavelength of two linearly polarized states can be controlled artificially by varying the structure parameters of photonic crystal fiber. The confinement loss are also numerically calculated and optimized at 650nm communication wavelength of polymer optical fiber. From the numerical results it is confirmed that the proposed fiber is low-loss single-polarization single-mode photonic-crystal fiber within the wavelengths range from 0.57 μm to 0.66 μm, where only the slow-axis mode exists and the confinement loss is less than 0.05 dB/m.

articleTitle: Stabilization of dipole solitons in nonlocal thermal media through an incoherent coupling
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The stabilization of dipole solitons is investigated numerically in nonlocal thermal media through an incoherent coupling. Results show that such vector solitons are possible, and they could propagate stably at some existence threshold.

articleTitle: Multi-user detection based on improved-KICA
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In this paper Improved kernel independent component analysis (KICA) algorithm is proposed for detection of direct sequence code division multiple access (DS-CDMA) signals and compared with KICA and FastICA algorithms. ICA based technique is based on independence of source signals and these conditions are satisfied in multi-user CDMA environment. The aim is to recover a set of unknown mutually independent source signals from their observed mixtures without knowledge of the mixing coefficients. KICA which is advanced recently is a non-linear method for blind source separation (BSS). Combining a KICA element to conventional signal detection reduces multiple access interference (MAI) and enables a robust, computationally efficient structure. For traditional KICA algorithm is influenced by kernel function and also ignores noise, in this paper Improved-KICA algorithm using optimal kernel function and considering the noise is proposed for multi-user DS-CDMA signal. In this paper bit error rate simulations of these algorithms has been given for different number of users, SNR and compared. The results show that the proposed Improved-KICA is more effective compared with traditional algorithms and performs better at separating the source signals from the mixed CDMA signals with noise.

articleTitle: ECC algorithm and the realization of the VHDL for high-capacity solid-state storage
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In order to ensure the reliability of data, ECC is increasingly used in large-capacity data Nand type Flash storage. This paper describes the ECC algorithm, and designs a special error correction method for a radar recorder. The VHDL language description of the ECC algorithm is achieved and successfully embedded into the original program recorder, needs the actual data only on clock, not requires to calculate the additional timing, and occupies less system resources when running. It can correct one bit error and detect two bit errors, become an important way in data protection, and have the significant practical application value.

articleTitle: Exploration of computer-principle virtual laboratory
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: This paper introduces the concept and classification of virtual laboratory, and expounds the basic way and process of the construction of it on the base of the examples of computer-principle virtual laboratory. And at the same time, the fundamental use of UML Modeling method in the construction of virtual laboratory is analyzed; furthermore, the author analyzed the experimental teaching and the developmental prospects.

articleTitle: Flux density measurements of 23 pulsars
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: This paper reports the flux density measurements of 23 pulsar sat radio frequencies centered at 1540 and 4850~MHz, using the new pulsar observing system PDFB (Pulsar Digital Filter Banks) mounted at the 25-m radio telescope at Xinjiang Astronomical Observatory. The new de-dispersion system PDFB is described and the method of calibration for pulsar intensity measurements are introduced. Spectra indices of these pulsars were given based on our measurement combined with previously published data at other frequencies.

articleTitle: The research on application of photoelectronic technology in the new clock spring
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The paper introduce a kind of new method to solve the existing question of the traditional clock spring used in the air bag, which transmit signal by wire. The new clock spring designed in the paper improve the inner structure of the traditional clock spring and use photoelectronic technology realize the function of the traditional clock spring. The method overcome the drawback of the traditional clock spring, such as the wire breakage or snap, and it offers a reference for the future improvement of clock spring.

articleTitle: Comparison research for attribution reduction based on information entropy and distribution consistent set
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Rough set is a valid theory to deal with imprecise, uncertain, and vague information. For different aim in application, there are different definitions for the attribution reduction which were called attribution reduction based on positive region, information entropy, HU's discernibility matrix and distribution consistent set, respectively. In this paper, the relationships of the attribute reductions based on information entropy and distribution consistent set are studied. A new conclusion is deduced that the attribute reduction based on information entropy is equal to that based on distribution consistent set.

articleTitle: Study and development of spectral responsibility testing system for visible-near infrared band
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: This paper introduces mainly the structures and the functions of the instrument for analyzing rapidly soil composition based on spectral measuring techniques. This measuring system can be used to measure soil spectral properties with a response range from 400 to 2900nm. The main technical problems emphasized on measuring accuracy and stability of system were solved. On the basis of these, we studies the reflective spectrum of soil moisture and evaluates primarily the repeatability and stability of the system in the practical measuring. The testing results show that the system has good qualities of stability and easy operation.

articleTitle: Switched linear system model and simulation analysis of the electronic ballast
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: This paper casts systematic insight into the electronic ballasts which are functionally made-up by three cascade stages, i.e., input, PFC and output. Simulation results utilizing the semi-theoretical model indicate that the fluorescent lamp operating at high frequencies is approximately a voltage dependent resistor. Further numeric analysis simplifies the lamp load network as a resistor-inductor series branch. The electrical characteristics of the output stage are revealed and described by a switched RL load. Employing the system equivalent circuit, we derive the model of the electronic ballast. And the state-space descriptions (line current, capacitor voltage, and load current are states variables) illustrate that the electronic ballast driving the fluorescent lamp is a switched linear system of third-order and four-mode.

articleTitle: Research on optical fiber sensor based on nanoparticles-modified
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: This article makes a study on optical fiber sensor with metal nanostructure based on the properties of optical fiber sensing technology and the optical performances of metal nanoparticles. Moreover, star-sha ped gold nanoparticles which mean diameter is from 60 to 80 nm were obtained by the Seed-mediated growth method. Then these nanoparticles were used as the sensitive part of the optical fiber sensor and were modified to the tapered fiber surface as a surface Raman enhanced substrate. Finally, transmission spectrum and Raman spectra were carried out in different concentration alcohol solution. The experiments show that the extinction spectra of gold nanoparticles is very sensitive to the dielectric properties of the surrounding medium and the nanoparticles fiber-taper-excited SERS (Surface-enhanced Raman scattering) substrates exhibit a significant enhancement of the Raman spectra.

articleTitle: Effects of localized CO2 laser damage repair on downstream beam qualities
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The diffraction patterns as a function of propagation distance from different parameters of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> laser repair cater are calculated by using a fast-Fourier-transform beam propagation code. The results show that the outer rim of sites leads to laser focusing and causes the more intense downstream modulation, the depth of cater affect the intensity of peaks slightly, and the diameter of cater has no influence on the intensity of peaks. By controlling the rim structure of the mitigation sites, downstream modulation introduced by CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> laser repair cater can be declined and decreases the optics damage risk effectively.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research about college students' life cognitive dimensions in dormitory
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The responsiveness of intangible cultural heritage tourism from the perspective of tourist experience
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Diopter measurement method based on retina image processing
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In order to solve the problem of border blur between dark background and bright ring image, a geometrical plane parameter measurement method based on retina images processing has been proposed in this paper. The key technique is to locate the image edge points by Gauss curve fitting and curvature filtering. Firstly, annular reflecting images are obtained by auto refractometer measurement system. Secondly, the coordinates of sub-pixel edge points are acquired through Gauss curve fitting method. Thirdly by curvature filtering method the noisy points are eliminated. Finally, the geometrical plane parameters of retina image are calculated after fitting ellipse track with the least-squares method. Thus human eye diopter can be calculated. The experimental results demonstrate the accuracy, stability and validity of the retina image processing method.

articleTitle: Improved speech recognition using discriminative integration of multiple local classifiers in lattice rescoring
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Model combination is a popular technique to integrate several knowledge sources into automatic speech recognition for better system accuracy. In this paper, we report our recent work on the integration of the hidden Markov model based acoustic model, the multi-layer perceptron based phoneme classifier and Gaussian mixture model based tone classifier in lattice rescoring. Moreover, we use discriminative model weight training to tune the impact of the heterogeneous models according to different phonetic contexts for better model interpolation. Experimental results on continuous mandarin speech recognition show a 8.2% improvement can be obtained using the combination of the three models. We have also evaluated four context dependent weighting schemes using discriminative trained scaling factors. It is also shown by introducing left final dependent contexts, a 4.1% further recognition error reduction can be further obtained.

articleTitle: Calculation on three-component magnetic field of current wire based on the coordinate transformation method
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In the degaussing process, the three-component magnetic field of induced magnetic field brings by degaussing coils in a given coordinate system (such as the ship coordinate system) is always one of the key issues. The problem ends in calculating the three-component magnetic field in a given coordinate system of the current wire. The paper presents a simple and straightforward method that can quickly and easily solve the problem, as more as easy to program and practical.

articleTitle: The design of the color Image acquisition system in hardware platforms based on FPGA
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Image acquisition processing system is design AD9945 as analog front end and ICX640UKM as CCD image sensor in this paper. It introduces the hardware design and the hardware type selection and the interface design based on the FPGA chip chosen as the hardware design platform in detail, gives connection diagram and realizing method of hardware circuit, the reliable video signal of output is captured by experiment. The circuit has a design simple structure and debugging or modification easier and processing speed and output image quality, and for video surveillance and civilian product development.

articleTitle: Focal properties of an aberration-free fiber micro-lens
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The focusing properties of an aberration-free fiber micro-lenses are studied. The simulation results show that the focal spot size (radius of the waist) is no changed with micro-lenses clad radius for a given focal length when the micro-lenses clad radius is larger than twice the fiber core radius, and the empirical formulas are given for computing focal shift and spot size respectively, it provide convenient means to make sure the location and size of the waist of the beam emerging from the fiber micro-lenses. The proposed formulas cover the range of parameter range of beam Fresnel number Nw<2 and Nr>4Nw.

articleTitle: The simulation and analysis on the radiation fence of D-D neutron generator by Monte Carlo Method
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: This paper simulates and analyses the irradiation fence around D-D neutron generator by a method, which combines Monte Carlo and practical measurement. Setting up the model of MCNP(the analog Monte Carlo method for Neutron and Proton's transport) and analyzing the results are introduced. The energy of neutron from neutron generator is 2.5 MeV. Water has been used as the material of neutron fence. We use the MCNP procedure to simulate them and find the relation between the thickness of the fence material and the quantity of neutron injection. We take the result as a basis for designing the rapied analyzer of cement raw meal using D-D neutron generator. The results approve that Monte Carlo can be used in radiation protection analysis and optimum design of radiation source shield.

articleTitle: Optical birefringence and polarization dependent loss of elliptical-hole rectangular lattice photonic crystal fibers based on polymer
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: We explore the polarization properties of elliptical-hole rectangular lattice photonic crystal fibers (PCFs) with elliptic fiber core based on polymer. The optical birefringence and polarization-dependent leakage loss are studied numerically based on the full-vector finite element method. Numerical results show that by using the proposed structure, a heightened modal birefringence of the order of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup> has been obtained, and the leakage loss is reduced to 0.12 dB/m at wavelength of 0.65 μm when the PCF has 10 rings of elliptical air-holes. So this PCFs may be useful as high birefringence polarization-maintaining PCFs in practical applications.

articleTitle: Pavement image denoising based on shearlet treansform
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: A novel pavement image denoising method based on shearlet transform is proposed in this paper. Because that the pavement crack has continuous liner geometrical feature which can be captured by shearlets very efficiently with more directions than wavelets, the pavement image denoising method based on the shearlet transform can obtain a great improvement than traditional method. Background fitting is used to deal with the low frequency component of the image, which can balance the energy distribution of the pavement image. Then coarse scale coefficients of shearlet are selected under multiple thresholds. The coefficients obtained by low threshold is used for reconstruction of the main parts of cracks, and the coefficients obtained by high threshold is employed to extract crack position and direction information, which is fused with the threshold at fine scale to distinguish the noise and fine parts of cracks. The experimental results show that this method can smooth the most of noisy spots but keep the cracks details well and have less pseudo-Gibbs artifacts.

articleTitle: Constructing evidence-driven model in science education
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The paper focuses on constructing evidence-driven models in science education in order to facilitate curriculum and pedagogy. It reflects the relationship between science education and science education research in our country. Then analyze the new tendency which is learning progressions in international science education research. At last we try to create an evidence-driven model in science education.

articleTitle: A five-zone binary phase filter applied to increase the recording depth of near-field SIL optical storage system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: A novel filter with five-zone binary phase pupil function is designed for improving the recording depth of near-field hemispheric solid immersion lens optical storage system. Numerical results show that with the increase of the distance from the air-disk interface the variations of the spot size and intensity of the recording spot are slower with the design filter than that without any filters. This illustrates that the designed filter can evidently increase the recording depth of near-field hemispheric solid immersion lens optical storage system.

articleTitle: A research into the issues of sports film production
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Collect and watch over 100 sports films, and select 8 of them as case study samples for the common rules of sports film production by the methods of case study, comparative analysis, graphics and visual works analysis and semantic analysis of dialogue etc,. The basic pattern of sports film production provides a framework of macro analysis, while all elements are developed with sports clue, as an important characteristic of sports film's evolution into an individual type of film. The general rule of sports film production is a special pattern of aesthetics, expressed the unique characteristic by story design, initial data origin, appropriate actors, story climax, educational video, film ideology, design for both beginning and end, poster design. The limitations of this research work are inevitable, mainly affected by recognition of film ontology, the representativeness of the sample selection and different sports film styles.

articleTitle: Research of three-dimensional surface detection method based on grating projection
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In tiny instrument structure design and treating, it is hotspot that three-dimensional surface of diffuse reflection is detected in recent years. Common Measurement method include: One is phase shift micro interference method. It has high measures accuracy to reaches nm lever. Its structure is complicated and measure range is small. Only it fits in tiny face of specula detecting. The other is projection method of computer optesthesia integration. This method is simple, convenient operation, big measurement range. But measurement accuracy is low, only be 0.1 mm lever. And the grating and the CCD repetition calibrate are difficult. A measuring 3-D diffuse reflection tiny instrument surface basing on grating projection method has been studied in this article. Measurement principle is triangle laser method. Using parallel light irradiate spatial light modulator (SLM) to produce amplitude grating with random period, through projection optics system's image produces clear deform grating stripe. It is set up the mathematical model between three-dimensional tiny surfaces and deform grating stripe. It is processed the receive image and calculated three-dimensional information and regained three dimensional topography. Taking a tiny shape as example, the detecting method is validated though experimenting. Measure accuracy is one pixel. Using SLM to produce amplitude grating In this method, It is easy changing grating period or replacing different type amplitude grating, It isn't need to calibrate grating repeat. This method has effectively resolved the grating difficult to repeat calibration. And it is true speedy real time online detecting.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Minority areas in Yunnan Province Longchuan children orphaned by AIDS experience of discrimination
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: On the reform of the approaches of teaching Japanese intensive reading aided with multimedia technology
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: As one of the chief subjects in the required courses for the undergraduate Japanese majors, Japanese intensive reading performs a task of fully training students' basic linguistic skills and comprehensive qualities. Thus, the teaching method of this course directly affects whether the teaching task can be fulfilled or not, and whether the teaching targets and professional training targets will be realized or not. Thus some creative methods of teaching this subject in different stages of study are explored based on such some aspects as teaching contents, teaching approaches, teaching techniques, etc.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of interleave encoder based on FPGA
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Presents a design method of 192bit per frame interleave encoder, and the ALTERA Cyclone devices EP2C8QC208 FPGA is used to achieve the design. Simulation and testing results show that the interleaver has a small additional delay and high reliability and can be used for anti-burst interference in data communications systems.

articleTitle: Heuristic algorithm for a multiple item inventory system with uncertain demands and probabilistic resource constraints
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Multiple item inventory system with uncertain demands was considered in this paper, a probabilistic constraint was applied to multiple item (Q,R) ordering policy based on previous research on single period multiple item inventory system with linear constraints, and a heuristic algorithm was developed to improves warehouse and capital management. The results of the proposed approach show that over 20% of inventory cost s is saved compared with other methods for the same purpose without further resoure consumption, the proposed approach is very effective and competitive.

articleTitle: Aqueous synthesis and photoluminescence properties of CdSe/CdS core/shell quantum dots
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Thiol-capped CdSe/CdS core/shell quantum dots which show high luminescence quantum yield are synthesized in aqueous solution with the application of ultrasonic irradiation. A combination of X-ray diffraction (XRD), UV-Vis absorption spectroscopy and photoluminescence spectroscopy are employed to analyze the QDs and determine their crystal structures and optical characters. Photostabilities of bare CdSe and CdSe/CdS core/shell QDs are compared under UV irradiation.

articleTitle: The comparison of fabricating colorful patterns on stainless steel with femtosecond and nanosecond laser pulses
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The colorful patterns are produced on stainless steel by irradiating with scanning femtosecond and nanosecond laser pulses. The SEM images show that the surface of the colorful patterns fabricated by femtosecond laser pulses are covered with laser-induced periodic surface structures (NC-LIPSS), and the surface structures have characteristics that are similar to gratings, which can exhibit enhanced colors in ambient white light. However, the colorful patterns fabricated by nanosecond laser pulses only have more floccus structures are generated, and only appear golden yellow in different degree. The reflectance analysis demonstrates the total reflectance of patterns fabricated by femtosecond laser pulses is greater than that of being fabricated by nanosecond laser pulses in the UV, Visible, and IR regions.

articleTitle: Calibration method of infrared detector based on entangled photons
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Calibration of radiometric detector is the foundation technique to ensure precisions and values of remote sensing data. Current methods for calibration of infrared detectors need to establish transfer chain of standard, the precision of standard will be reduced by extension of the chain. A new absolute calibration method without transfer chain can be realized by using entangled photons. The theory of calibration is demonstrated in this paper. We propose a scheme for calibrating quantum efficiency of infrared detectors, here. The advantages of this method are mentioned.

articleTitle: Ultrafast rising of output electric impulse of high gain semi-insulated GaAs PCSS
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: For the high gain semi-insulated Gallium arsenide (GaAs) photoconductive switches (PCSS), the output current pulse has ultra-fast rise character, the rise time can be even less than that of the trigger laser pulse. So PCSS is the most promising generation of THz radiation because of its character of ultra-fast and high peak power. The experiments result show that the high gain electrical pulse whose rise time is 1.086ns is obtained from GaAs PCSS. The streamer mode is proposed to explain the ultra-fast rise character. The electrical field distortion caused by optically activated charge domain and avalanche impact ionization are the key factors for the streamer formation and propagation. The paper hold the fast propagation of streamer built up the ultra-fast rise character of these switches.

articleTitle: Quality analysis of class a surface and research on smoothing optimization methods
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: This paper based on CAD/CAM technology discusses the analysis methods of auto body surface quality, the Class A surface evaluation criteria, the smoothness criteria of auto body surface, as well as the smoothing optimization methods of auto body surface. From the internal quality of the auto body surface, the patches grading criteria of auto body surface, the adjacent continuous relationship between surfaces, and as well how to effectively use of surface analysis and optimization tools, to explore ways and means about how to optimize the automotive body surface. In the Class A surface standard constraints for the basic surface of the internal quality and continuity, and internal quality and continuity of the transition surfaces are discussed; at same time, the key points of Class A surface structure formation process has been studied.

articleTitle: Focusing characteristics of light beam passing through birefringent film
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The properties of circularly polarized beams tightly focusing through a uniaxial crystal film are investigated by using the angular spectrum method of plane waves. The numerical results show that, for the positive crystal, the focus is closed to lens with the birefringence increasing. However, for the negative crystal, the focus shifts away from the lens and the size of the optical spot increases. With the increasing of the positive and negative crystal thickness, the focus is close to lens. However, the thickness of positive crystal increases the same as the thickness of negative crystal, the focus for the positive crystal film shifts more obviously than that for the negative crystal film. The closer the positive and negative crystal gets, the closer the focus is. When the film shifts rapidly, however, the intensity for the positive crystal film decreases more rapidly than that for the negative crystal film.

articleTitle: Numerical study on the mode and dispersion properties of tapered microstructure optical fibers
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The effective normalized frequency, the power fraction in the core and the group velocity dispersion of tapered microstructure optical fibers(TMOFs) are investigated by the full-vector effective index method for different values of index α. The index α determinates the shape of TMOFs. It is found that the shape and structure of TMOFs have an important influence on the effective normalized frequency, and the group velocity dispersion.

articleTitle: A high sensitivity refractometer based on a partial liquid-filled hollow-core photonic bandgap fiber
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: A novel and high sensitivity refractometer is realized by using a short partial liquid-filled hollow-core photonic bandgap fiber (HC-PBGF). Since the liquid filled into partial air-holes of HC-PBGF forms an asymmetric waveguide structure, the confinement loss of the partial filled HC-PBGF is high sensitive to the refractive index of the filled liquid when the wavelength of the input light on Y polarization mode is fixed at the band gap edge. The proposed refractometer can realize a trace measurement by filling the tested liquid into HC-PBGF partially with 1 mm length and the refractive index sensitivity in theory is as high as 1.5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−8</sup> at approximately 1.333.

articleTitle: Output data study about mathematical model's simulation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: According to mathematical model, we have mainly studied some methods about mathematical model's simulating output data. And we have analyzed some basic key points about transient simulation and static simulation. We also have analyzed the mathematical model's performance measuring and estimating which includes point estimation and interval estimation. And we have gotten the prescribed precise confidence interval. What have studied must be helpful to study computer simulation output data which based on mathematical model.

articleTitle: Growth of Co thin films by magnetron sputtering method and its performance analysis
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In the present paper, the Co film has been prepared successfully by magnetron sputtering method. The thin film character of surface, the structure characteristic and magnetism characteristic have been analyzed. The results have been analyzed and discussed.

articleTitle: Investigation of the effect of the ESD to the transient voltage suppressor
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The transient voltage suppressor (TVS) is commonly used in circuit in order to protect the circuit from the Electrostatic Discharge (ESD). In this paper, the turn on voltage and the clamping voltage of the TVS device is tested to figure the capability of the device. The test shows the clamping voltage increase as the test voltage increase. After injected the BMM pulses, the internal of device was damaged. Both the turn on voltage and the clamping voltage of the TVS device would increase, and the protect capability of the TVS device decreased.

articleTitle: The designing of intelligent fan-induced ventilation control system based on nRF905
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The paper introduces the designing of intellectual fan-induced ventilation system which can dilute CO gas in time, save energy and reduce energy consumption. The intellectual fan-induced ventilation system is composed of the centralized controller the induced fan controller and the induced fan. The paper introduces the designing of system's hardware. The software flowchart of the centralized controller and the induced fan controller is drawn in the paper. The paper describes work state and procession of intellectual fan-induced ventilation system.

articleTitle: Study on Millisecond and Nanosecond laser-induced damage of TiO2/SiO2 anti-reflectors
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: The laser induced damage threshold (LIDT) of TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> anti-reflectors (AR) acted by 10ns–1064nm and 1ms–1064nm lasers are investigated. The LITD at 10ns and 1ms pulse duration are 2.9J/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and 290J/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, respectively. The damaged morphologies are observed by metallographic microscope. It is found that the damage during 10ns and 1ms pulse duration are film damage and substrate damage, respectively. Analysis of laser-induced damage on AR coatings is carried out by temperature field calculation. Theoretical results show that 1ms laser induced damage depth is deeper than that of the 10ns and meet experimental well.

articleTitle: Multi-objects tracking research of human body motion based on feature center
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: It is widely used to track the moving human body by Kalman filtering technology in intelligent video surveillance system. But in fact multi-human bodies' motions often appear and when one is sheltered by another the object is lost. This paper mainly discusses this problem and solves it by means of extracting the features of moving human bodies and utilizing the technology of self-adaptive Kalman filtering. It takes the human feature centre prediction as an aided method to achieve the continuous tracking to moving multi-human bodies and avoid the object's losing while two moving human bodies separate from the fixed objects. It improves the effectiveness and robustness in tracking system.

articleTitle: A numerical analysis of acoustooptic diffraction efficiency in TeO2 crystal using multiple scattering theory
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: In order to improve the diffraction efficiency of acousto-optic devices, parameters must be elaborately chosen. The well-known multiple plane wave scattering theory developed by Korpel and Poon is utilized to analyze the diffraction efficiency in TeO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> crystal. The analysis results show that when the electrical driving power increases, the diffraction efficiency shows a sine-function-shaped change and the peak to peak value will decline; when the length of piezoelectric transducer increases, the diffraction efficiency gradually increases to the peak value and becomes stable. It is also found that the obtained diffraction efficiency becomes higher when the incident angle approaches to the Bragg angle.

articleTitle: Electron optical system and image processing
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: High-resolution transmission electron microscope provides a powerful tool to study the materials structure down to atomic level. However, as an electron optical system, the condition of obtaining projected structure image of examined samples is severe because of the lens aberration effect. A posterior image processing technique, the image deconvolution, can restore the image distortion due to the lens aberrations and enhance the image resolution up to the information limit of the microscope. The principle of the image deconvolution technique is briefly presented. The results of application to the study of hetero-interfacial defects at atomic level are given.

articleTitle: Manufacture of laser-assisted monitoring system for day and night
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2011 International Conference on Electronics and Optoelectronics
abstract: With CCD as photodetectors pieces, matching with optical lens, and using the laser as assist illume, a section of economical practical monitoring system for day and night is designed. Monitoring system composition structures and working principles are given, at the Same Time, rationality and economy of this system are demonstrated.

Author Keywords: laser monitoring system for day and night
